```python
0120 | def build_dynamic_feature_vector(
0121 |     visicalc_report: dict,
0122 |     metrics: Dict[str, float],
0123 |     metric_names: List[str],
0124 |     problem_id: Optional[str] = None
0125 | ) -> np.ndarray:
0126 |     """
0127 |     Build [VisiCalc 8] + [dynamic metrics] feature vector.
0128 | 
0129 |     - visicalc_report: full VisiCalc report dict
0130 |     - metrics: dict of metric_name -> value (from HRM/SICQL/Tiny/etc.)
0131 |     - metric_names: ordered list of metric keys to pull from metrics
0132 |     - problem_id: optional identifier for logging
0133 | 
0134 |     Missing metrics are filled with 0.0.
0135 |     """
0136 |     start_time = datetime.now()
0137 |     problem_context = f" for {problem_id}" if problem_id else ""
0138 |     
0139 |     log.debug(f"🔧 Building dynamic feature vector{problem_context}")
0140 |     log.debug(f"📊 Input metrics dict has {len(metrics)} total metrics")
0141 |     log.debug(f"🎯 Target metric names: {len(metric_names)} core metrics")
0142 | 
0143 |     # 1) VisiCalc structural features (8 dims)
0144 |     log.debug("🔄 Extracting VisiCalc structural features...")
0145 |     try:
0146 |         v_feats = extract_tiny_features(visicalc_report).astype(np.float32)
0147 |         log.debug(f"✅ VisiCalc features extracted: shape={v_feats.shape}, dtype={v_feats.dtype}")
0148 |         log.debug(f"   VisiCalc feature stats: min={v_feats.min():.3f}, max={v_feats.max():.3f}, mean={v_feats.mean():.3f}")
0149 |     except Exception as e:
0150 |         log.error(f"❌ Failed to extract VisiCalc features: {e}")
0151 |         # Create fallback VisiCalc features
0152 |         v_feats = np.zeros(8, dtype=np.float32)
0153 |         log.warning("⚠️  Using zero-filled VisiCalc features as fallback")
0154 | 
0155 |     # 2) Dynamic metric features (N dims)
0156 |     log.debug("🔄 Processing dynamic metric features...")
0157 |     m_vals = []
0158 |     missing_metrics = []
0159 |     available_metrics = []
0160 |     
0161 |     for i, name in enumerate(metric_names):
0162 |         if name in metrics:
0163 |             try:
0164 |                 value = float(metrics[name])
0165 |                 m_vals.append(value)
0166 |                 available_metrics.append((i, name, value))
0167 |             except (ValueError, TypeError):
0168 |                 log.warning(f"⚠️  Metric '{name}' has non-float value: {metrics[name]} - using 0.0")
0169 |                 m_vals.append(0.0)
0170 |                 missing_metrics.append(name)
0171 |         else:
0172 |             m_vals.append(0.0)
0173 |             missing_metrics.append(name)
0174 |     
0175 |     m_feats = np.asarray(m_vals, dtype=np.float32)
0176 |     
0177 |     # Log detailed metrics information
0178 |     log.debug(f"📈 Dynamic metrics: {len(available_metrics)} available, {len(missing_metrics)} missing")
0179 |     
0180 |     if available_metrics:
0181 |         # Log first few available metrics for debugging
0182 |         sample_metrics = available_metrics[:3]
0183 |         sample_str = ", ".join([f"{name}={value:.3f}" for _, name, value in sample_metrics])
0184 |         log.debug(f"🔢 Sample available metrics: {sample_str}")
0185 |         
0186 |         # Log statistics of available metrics
0187 |         if available_metrics:
0188 |             available_values = [val for _, _, val in available_metrics]
0189 |             log.debug(f"📊 Available metrics stats: min={min(available_values):.3f}, "
0190 |                      f"max={max(available_values):.3f}, mean={np.mean(available_values):.3f}")
0191 |     
0192 |     if missing_metrics:
0193 |         log.debug(f"❌ Missing metrics ({len(missing_metrics)}): {missing_metrics[:5]}{'...' if len(missing_metrics) > 5 else ''}")
0194 |         if len(missing_metrics) > 10:
0195 |             log.debug(f"   ... and {len(missing_metrics) - 5} more missing metrics")
0196 | 
0197 |     # 3) Concatenate → [8 + N]
0198 |     log.debug("🔗 Concatenating VisiCalc and dynamic metrics...")
0199 |     try:
0200 |         combined_features = np.concatenate([v_feats, m_feats], axis=-1)
0201 |         
0202 |         duration = (datetime.now() - start_time).total_seconds()
0203 |         log.debug(f"✅ Feature vector built successfully in {duration:.3f}s")
0204 |         log.debug(f"📐 Final feature vector: shape={combined_features.shape}, "
0205 |                  f"dtype={combined_features.dtype}")
0206 |         log.debug(f"📊 Combined stats: min={combined_features.min():.3f}, "
0207 |                  f"max={combined_features.max():.3f}, mean={combined_features.mean():.3f}")
0208 |         
0209 |         # Log feature composition
0210 |         log.debug(f"🧩 Feature composition: {v_feats.shape[0]} VisiCalc + {m_feats.shape[0]} dynamic = {combined_features.shape[0]} total")
0211 |         
0212 |         return combined_features
0213 |         
0214 |     except Exception as e:
0215 |         log.error(f"❌ Failed to concatenate features: {e}")
0216 |         log.error(f"   VisiCalc features shape: {v_feats.shape}, dtype: {v_feats.dtype}")
0217 |         log.error(f"   Dynamic features shape: {m_feats.shape}, dtype: {m_feats.dtype}")
0218 |         raise

0221 | def build_dynamic_feature_vectors_batch(
0222 |     visicalc_reports: List[dict],
0223 |     metrics_list: List[Dict[str, float]],
0224 |     metric_names: List[str], 
0225 |     problem_ids: Optional[List[str]] = None
0226 | ) -> np.ndarray:
0227 |     """
0228 |     Build dynamic feature vectors for a batch of examples.
0229 |     
0230 |     Args:
0231 |         visicalc_reports: List of VisiCalc report dicts
0232 |         metrics_list: List of metric dictionaries
0233 |         metric_names: Ordered list of metric keys
0234 |         problem_ids: Optional list of problem identifiers for logging
0235 |         
0236 |     Returns:
0237 |         np.ndarray: Batch of feature vectors [batch_size, 8 + len(metric_names)]
0238 |     """
0239 |     log.info(f"🏭 Building batch of {len(visicalc_reports)} dynamic feature vectors")
0240 |     log.info(f"🎯 Using {len(metric_names)} core metrics")
0241 |     
0242 |     if problem_ids is None:
0243 |         problem_ids = [f"example_{i}" for i in range(len(visicalc_reports))]
0244 |     
0245 |     if len(visicalc_reports) != len(metrics_list):
0246 |         log.error(f"❌ Mismatched batch sizes: {len(visicalc_reports)} reports vs {len(metrics_list)} metrics")
0247 |         raise ValueError("visicalc_reports and metrics_list must have same length")
0248 |     
0249 |     if len(visicalc_reports) != len(problem_ids):
0250 |         log.error(f"❌ Mismatched batch sizes: {len(visicalc_reports)} reports vs {len(problem_ids)} problem_ids")
0251 |         raise ValueError("visicalc_reports and problem_ids must have same length")
0252 |     
0253 |     batch_features = []
0254 |     successful = 0
0255 |     failed = 0
0256 |     
0257 |     for i, (report, metrics, problem_id) in enumerate(zip(visicalc_reports, metrics_list, problem_ids)):
0258 |         try:
0259 |             features = build_dynamic_feature_vector(
0260 |                 visicalc_report=report,
0261 |                 metrics=metrics,
0262 |                 metric_names=metric_names,
0263 |                 problem_id=problem_id
0264 |             )
0265 |             batch_features.append(features)
0266 |             successful += 1
0267 |             
0268 |             # Log progress for large batches
0269 |             if (i + 1) % 50 == 0:
0270 |                 log.info(f"📦 Processed {i + 1}/{len(visicalc_reports)} examples")
0271 |                 
0272 |         except Exception as e:
0273 |             log.error(f"❌ Failed to build features for {problem_id}: {e}")
0274 |             failed += 1
0275 |             # Create zero vector as fallback
0276 |             fallback_features = np.zeros(8 + len(metric_names), dtype=np.float32)
0277 |             batch_features.append(fallback_features)
0278 |     
0279 |     if batch_features:
0280 |         batch_array = np.stack(batch_features, axis=0)
0281 |         log.info(f"✅ Batch feature construction complete: {successful} successful, {failed} failed")
0282 |         log.info(f"📦 Final batch shape: {batch_array.shape}")
0283 |         log.info(f"📊 Batch stats - min: {batch_array.min():.3f}, max: {batch_array.max():.3f}, "
0284 |                 f"mean: {batch_array.mean():.3f}, std: {batch_array.std():.3f}")
0285 |         return batch_array
0286 |     else:
0287 |         log.error("❌ No features were successfully built")
0288 |         raise ValueError("Failed to build any feature vectors")

0291 | def validate_core_metrics_coverage(
0292 |     metrics_list: List[Dict[str, float]],
0293 |     metric_names: List[str],
0294 |     sample_size: int = 10
0295 | ) -> Dict[str, float]:
0296 |     """
0297 |     Validate how many core metrics are actually available in the data.
0298 |     
0299 |     Returns coverage statistics for debugging data quality issues.
0300 |     """
0301 |     log.info("🔍 Validating core metrics coverage in dataset...")
0302 |     
0303 |     if not metrics_list:
0304 |         log.warning("⚠️  No metrics data provided for validation")
0305 |         return {}
0306 |     
0307 |     # Sample a subset for analysis
0308 |     sample_metrics = metrics_list[:sample_size] if len(metrics_list) > sample_size else metrics_list
0309 |     
0310 |     coverage_stats = {}
0311 |     total_possible = len(metric_names) * len(sample_metrics)
0312 |     total_found = 0
0313 |     
0314 |     for metric_name in metric_names:
0315 |         metric_found = 0
0316 |         for metrics_dict in sample_metrics:
0317 |             if metric_name in metrics_dict:
0318 |                 try:
0319 |                     float(metrics_dict[metric_name])
0320 |                     metric_found += 1
0321 |                     total_found += 1
0322 |                 except (ValueError, TypeError):
0323 |                     pass
0324 |         
0325 |         coverage = metric_found / len(sample_metrics)
0326 |         coverage_stats[metric_name] = coverage
0327 |         
0328 |         if coverage < 0.5:
0329 |             log.debug(f"⚠️  Low coverage for {metric_name}: {coverage:.1%}")
0330 |     
0331 |     overall_coverage = total_found / total_possible if total_possible > 0 else 0
0332 |     log.info(f"📊 Core metrics coverage: {overall_coverage:.1%} "
0333 |             f"({total_found}/{total_possible} expected metrics found)")
0334 |     
0335 |     # Log best and worst covered metrics
0336 |     if coverage_stats:
0337 |         sorted_coverage = sorted(coverage_stats.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
0338 |         best_metrics = sorted_coverage[:3]
0339 |         worst_metrics = sorted_coverage[-3:] if len(sorted_coverage) >= 3 else sorted_coverage
0340 |         
0341 |         log.info(f"🏆 Best covered metrics: {', '.join([f'{name}({cov:.1%})' for name, cov in best_metrics])}")
0342 |         log.info(f"🔻 Worst covered metrics: {', '.join([f'{name}({cov:.1%})' for name, cov in worst_metrics])}")
0343 |     
0344 |     return coverage_stats
0345 |

0347 | def extract_tiny_features(report):
0348 |     # 1. Overall stability (less variation = better)
0349 |     region_values = [region["mean_frontier_value"] for region in report["regions"]]
0350 |     stability = np.std(region_values)
0351 |     
0352 |     # 2. Middle region dip (more negative = worse)
0353 |     middle_dip = region_values[2] - min(region_values[0], region_values[3])
0354 |     
0355 |     # 3. Standard deviation (lower = better consistency)
0356 |     std_dev = report["global"]["std"]
0357 |     
0358 |     # 4. Sparsity (lower = more meaningful signal)
0359 |     sparsity = report["global"]["sparsity_level_e3"]
0360 |     
0361 |     # 5. Entropy (higher = more diverse reasoning)
0362 |     entropy = report["global"]["entropy"]
0363 |     
0364 |     # 6. Trend pattern (positive = improving)
0365 |     trend = region_values[-1] - region_values[0]
0366 |     
0367 |     # 7. Mid-bad ratio (how much worse is middle vs average)
0368 |     mid_bad_ratio = region_values[2] / np.mean(region_values)
0369 |     
0370 |     # 8. Frontier band utilization (even if 0, the pattern matters)
0371 |     frontier_util = report["global"]["frontier_frac"]
0372 |     
0373 |     return np.array([stability, middle_dip, std_dev, sparsity, 
0374 |                     entropy, trend, mid_bad_ratio, frontier_util])# stephanie/scoring/metrics/dynamic_features.py

0516 |     log.debug("🔄 Processing dynamic metric features...")
0517 |     m_vals = []
0518 |     missing_metrics = []
0519 |     available_metrics = []
0520 |     
0521 |     for i, name in enumerate(metric_names):
0522 |         if name in metrics:
0523 |             try:
0524 |                 value = float(metrics[name])
0525 |                 m_vals.append(value)
0526 |                 available_metrics.append((i, name, value))
0527 |             except (ValueError, TypeError):
0528 |                 log.warning(f"⚠️  Metric '{name}' has non-float value: {metrics[name]} - using 0.0")
0529 |                 m_vals.append(0.0)
0530 |                 missing_metrics.append(name)
0531 |         else:
0532 |             m_vals.append(0.0)
0533 |             missing_metrics.append(name)
0534 |     
0535 |     m_feats = np.asarray(m_vals, dtype=np.float32)
0536 |     
0537 |     # Log detailed metrics information
0538 |     log.debug(f"📈 Dynamic metrics: {len(available_metrics)} available, {len(missing_metrics)} missing")
0539 |     
0540 |     if available_metrics:
0541 |         # Log first few available metrics for debugging
0542 |         sample_metrics = available_metrics[:3]
0543 |         sample_str = ", ".join([f"{name}={value:.3f}" for _, name, value in sample_metrics])
0544 |         log.debug(f"🔢 Sample available metrics: {sample_str}")
0545 |         
0546 |         # Log statistics of available metrics
0547 |         if available_metrics:
0548 |             available_values = [val for _, _, val in available_metrics]
0549 |             log.debug(f"📊 Available metrics stats: min={min(available_values):.3f}, "
0550 |                      f"max={max(available_values):.3f}, mean={np.mean(available_values):.3f}")
0551 |     
0552 |     if missing_metrics:
0553 |         log.debug(f"❌ Missing metrics ({len(missing_metrics)}): {missing_metrics[:5]}{'...' if len(missing_metrics) > 5 else ''}")
0554 |         if len(missing_metrics) > 10:
0555 |             log.debug(f"   ... and {len(missing_metrics) - 5} more missing metrics")
0556 | 
0557 |     # 3) Concatenate → [8 + N]
0558 |     log.debug("🔗 Concatenating VisiCalc and dynamic metrics...")
0559 |     try:
0560 |         combined_features = np.concatenate([v_feats, m_feats], axis=-1)
0561 |         
0562 |         duration = (datetime.now() - start_time).total_seconds()
0563 |         log.debug(f"✅ Feature vector built successfully in {duration:.3f}s")
0564 |         log.debug(f"📐 Final feature vector: shape={combined_features.shape}, "
0565 |                  f"dtype={combined_features.dtype}")
0566 |         log.debug(f"📊 Combined stats: min={combined_features.min():.3f}, "
0567 |                  f"max={combined_features.max():.3f}, mean={combined_features.mean():.3f}")
0568 |         
0569 |         # Log feature composition
0570 |         log.debug(f"🧩 Feature composition: {v_feats.shape[0]} VisiCalc + {m_feats.shape[0]} dynamic = {combined_features.shape[0]} total")
0571 |         
0572 |         return combined_features
0573 |         
0574 |     except Exception as e:
0575 |         log.error(f"❌ Failed to concatenate features: {e}")
0576 |         log.error(f"   VisiCalc features shape: {v_feats.shape}, dtype: {v_feats.dtype}")
0577 |         log.error(f"   Dynamic features shape: {m_feats.shape}, dtype: {m_feats.dtype}")
0578 |         raise
0579 | 
0580 | 
0581 | def build_dynamic_feature_vectors_batch(
0582 |     visicalc_reports: List[dict],
0583 |     metrics_list: List[Dict[str, float]],
0584 |     metric_names: List[str], 
0585 |     problem_ids: Optional[List[str]] = None
0586 | ) -> np.ndarray:
0587 |     """
0588 |     Build dynamic feature vectors for a batch of examples.
0589 |     
0590 |     Args:
0591 |         visicalc_reports: List of VisiCalc report dicts
0592 |         metrics_list: List of metric dictionaries
0593 |         metric_names: Ordered list of metric keys
0594 |         problem_ids: Optional list of problem identifiers for logging
0595 |         
0596 |     Returns:
0597 |         np.ndarray: Batch of feature vectors [batch_size, 8 + len(metric_names)]
0598 |     """
0599 |     log.info(f"🏭 Building batch of {len(visicalc_reports)} dynamic feature vectors")
0600 |     log.info(f"🎯 Using {len(metric_names)} core metrics")
0601 |     
0602 |     if problem_ids is None:
0603 |         problem_ids = [f"example_{i}" for i in range(len(visicalc_reports))]
0604 |     
0605 |     if len(visicalc_reports) != len(metrics_list):
0606 |         log.error(f"❌ Mismatched batch sizes: {len(visicalc_reports)} reports vs {len(metrics_list)} metrics")
0607 |         raise ValueError("visicalc_reports and metrics_list must have same length")
0608 |     
0609 |     if len(visicalc_reports) != len(problem_ids):
0610 |         log.error(f"❌ Mismatched batch sizes: {len(visicalc_reports)} reports vs {len(problem_ids)} problem_ids")
0611 |         raise ValueError("visicalc_reports and problem_ids must have same length")
0612 |     
0613 |     batch_features = []
0614 |     successful = 0
0615 |     failed = 0
0616 |     
0617 |     for i, (report, metrics, problem_id) in enumerate(zip(visicalc_reports, metrics_list, problem_ids)):
0618 |         try:
0619 |             features = build_dynamic_feature_vector(
0620 |                 visicalc_report=report,
0621 |                 metrics=metrics,
0622 |                 metric_names=metric_names,
0623 |                 problem_id=problem_id
0624 |             )
0625 |             batch_features.append(features)
0626 |             successful += 1
0627 |             
0628 |             # Log progress for large batches
0629 |             if (i + 1) % 50 == 0:
0630 |                 log.info(f"📦 Processed {i + 1}/{len(visicalc_reports)} examples")
0631 |                 
0632 |         except Exception as e:
0633 |             log.error(f"❌ Failed to build features for {problem_id}: {e}")
0634 |             failed += 1
0635 |             # Create zero vector as fallback
0636 |             fallback_features = np.zeros(8 + len(metric_names), dtype=np.float32)
0637 |             batch_features.append(fallback_features)
0638 |     
0639 |     if batch_features:
0640 |         batch_array = np.stack(batch_features, axis=0)
0641 |         log.info(f"✅ Batch feature construction complete: {successful} successful, {failed} failed")
0642 |         log.info(f"📦 Final batch shape: {batch_array.shape}")
0643 |         log.info(f"📊 Batch stats - min: {batch_array.min():.3f}, max: {batch_array.max():.3f}, "
0644 |                 f"mean: {batch_array.mean():.3f}, std: {batch_array.std():.3f}")
0645 |         return batch_array
0646 |     else:
0647 |         log.error("❌ No features were successfully built")
0648 |         raise ValueError("Failed to build any feature vectors")
0649 | 
0650 | 
0651 | def validate_core_metrics_coverage(
0652 |     metrics_list: List[Dict[str, float]],
0653 |     metric_names: List[str],
0654 |     sample_size: int = 10
0655 | ) -> Dict[str, float]:
0656 |     """
0657 |     Validate how many core metrics are actually available in the data.
0658 |     
0659 |     Returns coverage statistics for debugging data quality issues.
0660 |     """
0661 |     log.info("🔍 Validating core metrics coverage in dataset...")
0662 |     
0663 |     if not metrics_list:
0664 |         log.warning("⚠️  No metrics data provided for validation")
0665 |         return {}
0666 |     
0667 |     # Sample a subset for analysis
0668 |     sample_metrics = metrics_list[:sample_size] if len(metrics_list) > sample_size else metrics_list
0669 |     
0670 |     coverage_stats = {}
0671 |     total_possible = len(metric_names) * len(sample_metrics)
0672 |     total_found = 0
0673 |     
0674 |     for metric_name in metric_names:
0675 |         metric_found = 0
0676 |         for metrics_dict in sample_metrics:
0677 |             if metric_name in metrics_dict:
0678 |                 try:
0679 |                     float(metrics_dict[metric_name])
0680 |                     metric_found += 1
0681 |                     total_found += 1
0682 |                 except (ValueError, TypeError):
0683 |                     pass
0684 |         
0685 |         coverage = metric_found / len(sample_metrics)
0686 |         coverage_stats[metric_name] = coverage
0687 |         
0688 |         if coverage < 0.5:
0689 |             log.debug(f"⚠️  Low coverage for {metric_name}: {coverage:.1%}")
0690 |     
0691 |     overall_coverage = total_found / total_possible if total_possible > 0 else 0
0692 |     log.info(f"📊 Core metrics coverage: {overall_coverage:.1%} "
0693 |             f"({total_found}/{total_possible} expected metrics found)")
0694 |     
0695 |     # Log best and worst covered metrics
0696 |     if coverage_stats:
0697 |         sorted_coverage = sorted(coverage_stats.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
0698 |         best_metrics = sorted_coverage[:3]
0699 |         worst_metrics = sorted_coverage[-3:] if len(sorted_coverage) >= 3 else sorted_coverage
0700 |         
0701 |         log.info(f"🏆 Best covered metrics: {', '.join([f'{name}({cov:.1%})' for name, cov in best_metrics])}")
0702 |         log.info(f"🔻 Worst covered metrics: {', '.join([f'{name}({cov:.1%})' for name, cov in worst_metrics])}")
0703 |     
0704 |     return coverage_stats
0705 | 
0706 | 
0707 | def extract_tiny_features(report):
0708 |     # 1. Overall stability (less variation = better)
0709 |     region_values = [region["mean_frontier_value"] for region in report["regions"]]
0710 |     stability = np.std(region_values)
0711 |     
0712 |     # 2. Middle region dip (more negative = worse)
0713 |     middle_dip = region_values[2] - min(region_values[0], region_values[3])
0714 |     
0715 |     # 3. Standard deviation (lower = better consistency)
0716 |     std_dev = report["global"]["std"]
0717 |     
0718 |     # 4. Sparsity (lower = more meaningful signal)
0719 |     sparsity = report["global"]["sparsity_level_e3"]
0720 |     
0721 |     # 5. Entropy (higher = more diverse reasoning)
0722 |     entropy = report["global"]["entropy"]
0723 |     
0724 |     # 6. Trend pattern (positive = improving)
0725 |     trend = region_values[-1] - region_values[0]
0726 |     
0727 |     # 7. Mid-bad ratio (how much worse is middle vs average)
0728 |     mid_bad_ratio = region_values[2] / np.mean(region_values)
0729 |     
0730 |     # 8. Frontier band utilization (even if 0, the pattern matters)
0731 |     frontier_util = report["global"]["frontier_frac"]
0732 |     
0733 |     return np.array([stability, middle_dip, std_dev, sparsity, 
0734 |                     entropy, trend, mid_bad_ratio, frontier_util])
```

```python
0009 | 
0010 | log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
0011 | 
0012 | 
0013 | class FrontierLensFeature(BaseFeature):
0014 |     """
0015 |     Lightweight per-row FrontierLens feature.
0016 | 
0017 |     Runs AFTER metrics are computed and attaches a small summary:
0018 |         - frontier_lens_report  (frontier metric + value + metric count)
0019 | 
0020 |     Full episode-level FrontierLens analysis (report + features + VPM)
0021 |     is handled by FrontierLensGroupFeature or by dedicated Critic/Nexus
0022 |     agents using FrontierLensTool.apply_rows().
0023 |     """
0024 | 
0025 |     # New, stable name for config + registry
0026 |     name = "frontier_lens_basic"
0027 | 
0028 |     def __init__(self, cfg, memory, container, logger):
0029 |         super().__init__(cfg, memory, container, logger)
0030 |         self.tool = FrontierLensTool(cfg, memory, container, logger)
0031 |         self.enabled = bool(cfg.get("enabled", True))
0032 | 
0033 |     async def apply(
0034 |         self,
0035 |         scorable,
0036 |         acc: Dict[str, Any],
0037 |         context: Dict[str, Any],
0038 |     ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
0039 |         """
0040 |         Expects:
0041 |             acc["metrics_columns"]
0042 |             acc["metrics_values"]
0043 | 
0044 |         Produces (if metrics exist):
0045 |             acc["frontier_lens_report"] : Dict[str, Any]
0046 |         """
0047 |         if not self.enabled:
0048 |             return acc
0049 | 
0050 |         cols = acc.get("metrics_columns") or []
0051 |         vals = acc.get("metrics_values") or []
0052 | 
0053 |         if not cols or not vals:
0054 |             log.debug("[FrontierLensFeature] no metrics for row; skipping")
0055 |             return acc
0056 | 
0057 |         # Delegate to the tool’s per-row FrontierLens summary
0058 |         acc = await self.tool.apply(scorable, acc, context)
0059 |         return acc
```

```python
0002 | from __future__ import annotations
0003 | 
0004 | import logging
0005 | from typing import Any, Dict, List
0006 | 
0007 | import numpy as np
0008 | 
0009 | from stephanie.scoring.metrics.feature.base_group_feature import \
0010 |     BaseGroupFeature
0011 | from stephanie.tools.frontier_lens_tool import FrontierLensTool
0012 | 
0013 | log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
0014 | 
0015 | 
0016 | class FrontierLensGroupFeature(BaseGroupFeature):
0017 |     """
0018 |     Batch FrontierLens feature.
0019 | 
0020 |     - Consumes rows with metrics_columns / metrics_values
0021 |     - Runs FrontierLensTool.apply_rows() once per batch
0022 |     - Attaches a shared 'frontier_lens_report' and (optionally) the
0023 |       global FrontierLens feature vector to each row.
0024 |     """
0025 | 
0026 |     name = "frontier_lens_group"
0027 |     requires = ["metric_filter"]  # keep the dependency ordering
0028 | 
0029 |     def __init__(self, cfg, memory, container, logger):
0030 |         super().__init__(cfg, memory, container, logger)
0031 |         self.tool = FrontierLensTool(cfg, memory, container, logger)
0032 |         self.enabled = bool(self.cfg.get("enabled", True))
0033 |         self.episode_id = self.cfg.get("episode_id", "frontier_lens:default")
0034 | 
0035 |         # Optional: attach the same global features to each row
0036 |         self.store_per_row_features = bool(self.cfg.get("store_per_row_features", False))
0037 | 
0038 |         # debug/telemetry fields so .report() never crashes
0039 |         self._quality: float | None = None
0040 |         self._kept_cols: int = 0
0041 |         self._rows_in: int = 0
0042 |         self._rows_used: int = 0
0043 |         self._error: str | None = None
0044 | 
0045 |     async def apply(self, rows: List[Dict[str, Any]], context: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
0046 |         if not self.enabled:
0047 |             return rows
0048 | 
0049 |         self._error = None
0050 |         self._rows_in = len(rows)
0051 | 
0052 |         if not rows:
0053 |             return rows
0054 | 
0055 |         # Use pipeline_run_id when available, fall back to static
0056 |         episode_id = context.get("pipeline_run_id") or self.episode_id
0057 | 
0058 |         try:
0059 |             out = self.tool.apply_rows(
0060 |                 episode_id=episode_id,
0061 |                 rows=rows,
0062 |                 meta={"n_rows": len(rows)},
0063 |             )
0064 |         except Exception as e:
0065 |             # Fail-closed: keep rows untouched and record why
0066 |             self._quality = None
0067 |             self._kept_cols = 0
0068 |             self._rows_used = 0
0069 |             self._error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
0070 |             log.warning("[FrontierLensGroupFeature] skipped: %s", self._error)
0071 |             return rows
0072 | 
0073 |         report = out.get("report")
0074 |         vpm = out.get("vpm")
0075 |         feats = out.get("features")
0076 |         names = out.get("feature_names") or []
0077 | 
0078 |         q = out.get("quality")
0079 |         self._quality = float(q) if isinstance(q, (int, float)) else None
0080 |         self._kept_cols = len(names)
0081 |         self._rows_used = int(vpm.shape[0]) if isinstance(vpm, np.ndarray) else 0
0082 | 
0083 |         # attach per-row artifacts (lightweight)
0084 |         rep_dict = report.to_dict() if hasattr(report, "to_dict") else (report or {})
0085 | 
0086 |         # If we decide to expose features, it’s one global vector (3M+3),
0087 |         # not per-row. Attach as-is or leave None.
0088 |         if isinstance(feats, np.ndarray):
0089 |             global_feats = feats.astype(float).tolist()
0090 |         else:
0091 |             global_feats = None
0092 | 
0093 |         for r in rows:
0094 |             r.setdefault("frontier_lens_report", rep_dict)
0095 |             r.setdefault("frontier_lens_feature_names", names)
0096 |             if self.store_per_row_features:
0097 |                 r.setdefault("frontier_lens_features", global_feats)
0098 |             else:
0099 |                 r.setdefault("frontier_lens_features", None)
0100 | 
0101 |         return rows
0102 | 
0103 |     def report(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
0104 |         ok = (self._error is None) and (self._quality is None or self._quality >= 0.5)
0105 |         return {
0106 |             "feature": self.name,
0107 |             "ok": ok,
0108 |             "quality": self._quality,
0109 |             "rows_in": self._rows_in,
0110 |             "rows_used": self._rows_used,
0111 |             "kept_metric_cols": self._kept_cols,
0112 |             "error": self._error,
0113 |             "summary": (
0114 |                 f"rows={self._rows_used}/{self._rows_in}; "
0115 |                 f"kept_cols={self._kept_cols}; quality={self._quality}"
0116 |             ),
0117 |         }
```

```python
0362 |     def _resolve_always_include(self, names_union: List[str]) -> List[str]:
0363 |         """
0364 |         Map self.always_include (which may be bare names or alias-prefixed)
0365 |         to actual column names present in names_union.
0366 | 
0367 |         - If an entry already exists in names_union, use it.
0368 |         - Else try to match by alias-stripped stem.
0369 |         - Log a warning for anything that can't be resolved.
0370 |         """

0373 | 
0374 |         union_set = set(names_union)

0376 |         # Build stem -> [full names] index from the universe

0380 |             stem_to_full.setdefault(stem, []).append(n)

0382 |         resolved: List[str] = []
0383 |         for raw in self.always_include:
0384 |             # 1) Exact match
0385 |             if raw in union_set:
0386 |                 resolved.append(raw)
0387 |                 continue
0388 | 
0389 |             # 2) Match by stem

0391 |             candidates = stem_to_full.get(stem)
0392 |             if candidates:
0393 |                 # Pick a stable representative (first occurrence)

0395 |             else:

0398 |                     raw,
0399 |                 )

0402 |         seen: set[str] = set()
0403 |         out: List[str] = []
0404 |         for n in resolved:
0405 |             if n not in seen:
0406 |                 seen.add(n)
0407 |                 out.append(n)
0408 |         return out
0409 | 
0410 |     def _order_core_first(self, selected_names: List[str], core_names: List[str]) -> List[str]:
0411 |         """
0412 |         Ensure core_names appear first (in the order given), and preserve
0413 |         the relative ordering of the remaining names.
0414 |         """
0415 |         core_set = set(core_names)
0416 |         core_block: List[str] = []
0417 |         other_block: List[str] = []
0418 | 
0419 |         for n in selected_names:
0420 |             if n in core_set:
0421 |                 core_block.append(n)
0422 |             else:
0423 |                 other_block.append(n)
0424 | 
0425 |         # Make sure any core_names not in selected_names (but resolved from universe)
0426 |         # are still included at the very front, in the order of core_names.
0427 |         final_core: List[str] = []
0428 |         seen = set()
0429 |         for n in core_names:
0430 |             if n not in seen:
0431 |                 seen.add(n)
0432 |                 final_core.append(n)
0433 |         # Now merge with any that came from selected_names but weren't in core_names order
0434 |         for n in core_block:
0435 |             if n not in seen:
0436 |                 seen.add(n)
0437 |                 final_core.append(n)
0438 | 
0439 |         return final_core + [n for n in other_block if n not in seen]
```

```python
0142 |         # Fallback: heuristics if vector still empty (keeps pipeline alive)
0143 |         if not vector:
0144 |             vector = self._fallback_heuristics((scorable.text or ""))
0145 | 
0146 |         # Deterministic ordering + stash
0147 |         cols = sorted(vector.keys())
0148 |         vals = [float(vector[c]) for c in cols]
0149 | 
0150 |         acc["metrics_vector"]  = vector
0151 |         acc["metrics_columns"] = cols
0152 |         acc["metrics_values"]  = vals
0153 | 
0154 |         # Diagnostics & optional observe/persist
0155 |         self._bump_diag(cols, vals)
0156 | 
0157 |         # try:
0158 |         #     self.metric_observer.observe(
0159 |         #         metrics=dict(zip(cols, vals)),
0160 |         #         run_id=context.get("run_id", "unknown_run"),
0161 |         #         cohort=context.get("cohort", "default"),
0162 |         #         is_correct=(getattr(scorable, "meta", {}) or {}).get("is_correct"),
0163 |         #     )
0164 |         # except Exception:
0165 |         #     pass  # never block pipeline on telemetry
0166 | 
0167 |         return acc
0168 | 
0169 |     # -------------------------------------------------------------
0170 |     def report(self) -> FeatureReport:
0171 |         if self._num_rows == 0 or not self._col_minmax:
0172 |             return FeatureReport(
0173 |                 name=self.name, kind="row", ok=True, quality=None,
0174 |                 summary="no metrics collected yet (num_rows=0)",
0175 |             )
0176 | 
0177 |         total_cols = len(self._col_minmax)
0178 |         oob = {k: (lo, hi) for k, (lo, hi) in self._col_minmax.items() if (hi > 1.001) or (lo < -0.001)}
0179 |         nan_cols = {k: c for k, c in self._nan_counts.items() if c > 0}
0180 |         var_proxy = {k: (s / max(self._num_rows, 1)) for k, s in self._sum_sq.items()}
0181 |         var_top = dict(sorted(var_proxy.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])[:20])
0182 | 
0183 |         bad_cols = len(oob) + len(nan_cols)
0184 |         quality = float(max(0.0, 1.0 - (bad_cols / max(total_cols, 1))))
0185 | 
0186 |         return FeatureReport(
0187 |             name=self.name,
0188 |             kind="row",
0189 |             ok=(bad_cols == 0),
0190 |             quality=quality,
0191 |             summary=f"{total_cols} metrics across {self._num_rows} rows; out_of_bounds={len(oob)}; NaN_cols={len(nan_cols)}",
0192 |             details={
0193 |                 "out_of_bounds_examples": dict(list(oob.items())[:10]),
0194 |                 "nan_columns": nan_cols,
0195 |                 "variance_proxy_top": var_top,
0196 |             },
0197 |             warnings=(
0198 |                 (["Found metrics outside [0,1]"] if oob else [])
0199 |                 + (["Found NaNs in metrics"] if nan_cols else [])
0200 |             ),
0201 |         )
0202 | 
0203 |     # -------------------------------------------------------------
0204 |     # internals
0205 |     def _fallback_heuristics(self, text: str) -> Dict[str, float]:
0206 |         t = text.strip()
0207 |         n_chars = len(t)
0208 |         n_tokens = len(t.split())
0209 |         digit_ratio = (sum(c.isdigit() for c in t) / max(n_chars, 1))
0210 |         upper_ratio = (sum(c.isupper() for c in t) / max(n_chars, 1))
0211 |         punct_ratio = (sum(c in ".,?!;:()[]{}\"'" for c in t) / max(n_chars, 1))
0212 | 
0213 |         # crude entropy → squash to [0,1]
0214 |         counts = {}
0215 |         for c in t:
0216 |             counts[c] = counts.get(c, 0) + 1
0217 |         total = sum(counts.values()) or 1
0218 |         ent = -sum((c/total) * np.log((c/total) + 1e-12) for c in counts.values())
0219 |         ent_norm = float(np.tanh(ent / 5.0))
0220 | 
0221 |         len_norm = float(np.tanh(n_tokens / 200.0))
0222 | 
0223 |         return {
0224 |             "heuristics.length.score": _clip01(len_norm),
0225 |             "heuristics.entropy.score": _clip01(ent_norm),
0226 |             "heuristics.digit_ratio.score": _clip01(digit_ratio),
0227 |             "heuristics.upper_ratio.score": _clip01(upper_ratio),
0228 |             "heuristics.punct_ratio.score": _clip01(punct_ratio),
0229 |         }
0230 | 
0231 |     def _bump_diag(self, cols: List[str], vals: List[float]) -> None:
0232 |         if not cols or not vals:
0233 |             return
0234 |         self._num_rows += 1
0235 |         for k, v in zip(cols, vals):
0236 |             if v is None or not np.isfinite(v):
0237 |                 self._nan_counts[k] = self._nan_counts.get(k, 0) + 1
0238 |                 continue
0239 |             v = float(v)
0240 |             lo, hi = self._col_minmax.get(k, (v, v))
0241 |             if v < lo: lo = v
0242 |             if v > hi: hi = v
0243 |             self._col_minmax[k] = (lo, hi)
0244 |             self._sum_sq[k] = self._sum_sq.get(k, 0.0) + v * v
```

```python
0134 |                         context_text=context_text,
0135 |                         candidate_text=blog_text,
0136 |                         candidate_id=str(candidate_id),
0137 |                     )
0138 |                 except Exception as e:
0139 |                     self._error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
0140 |                     log.warning(
0141 |                         "[RubricJudgeGroupFeature] Judge failed for group=%r row_index=%r: %s",
0142 |                         group_id,
0143 |                         row_index,
0144 |                         self._error,
0145 |                     )
0146 |                     continue
0147 | 
0148 |                 self._rows_judged += 1
0149 |                 any_judged = True
0150 | 
0151 |                 # Attach overall and per-criterion fields
0152 |                 row[self.overall_key] = result.overall_score
0153 |                 # Each criterion becomes judge_<name>_score and judge_<name>_rationale
0154 |                 for name, crit in result.criteria.items():
0155 |                     row[f"{self.prefix}{name}_score"] = crit.score
0156 |                     row[f"{self.prefix}{name}_rationale"] = crit.rationale
0157 | 
0158 |             if any_judged:
0159 |                 self._groups_with_judgements += 1
0160 | 
0161 |         return rows
0162 | 
0163 |     # ------------------------------------------------------------------
0164 |     # Helpers
0165 |     # ------------------------------------------------------------------
0166 | 
0167 |     def _resolve_context_text(
0168 |         self,
0169 |         group_rows: List[Dict[str, Any]],
0170 |         pipeline_context_text: str,
0171 |     ) -> str:
0172 |         """
0173 |         Priority:
0174 |           1. First non-empty row[context_text_column] if configured.
0175 |           2. pipeline-level judge_context.
0176 |           3. Empty string.
0177 |         """
0178 |         if self.context_text_column:
0179 |             for r in group_rows:
0180 |                 ctx = r.get(self.context_text_column)
0181 |                 if isinstance(ctx, str) and ctx.strip():
0182 |                     return ctx
0183 |         return pipeline_context_text
0184 | 
0185 |     def _valid_rank(self, value: Any) -> bool:
0186 |         """
0187 |         Is this a valid rank for judging? (non-None, int, >= 0)
0188 |         """
0189 |         try:
0190 |             if value is None:
0191 |                 return False
0192 |             v = int(value)
0193 |             return v >= 0
0194 |         except Exception:
0195 |             return False
0196 | 
0197 |     def _reset_telemetry(self, rows_in: int) -> None:
0198 |         self._rows_in = rows_in
0199 |         self._rows_judged = 0
0200 |         self._groups_seen = 0
0201 |         self._groups_with_judgements = 0
0202 |         self._error = None
0203 | 
0204 |     def report(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
0205 |         ok = self._error is None
0206 |         return {
0207 |             "feature": self.name,
0208 |             "ok": ok,
0209 |             "rows_in": self._rows_in,
0210 |             "rows_judged": self._rows_judged,
0211 |             "groups_seen": self._groups_seen,
0212 |             "groups_with_judgements": self._groups_with_judgements,
0213 |             "error": self._error,
0214 |             "summary": (
0215 |                 f"rows_judged={self._rows_judged}/{self._rows_in}; "
0216 |                 f"groups_with_judgements={self._groups_with_judgements}/"
0217 |                 f"{self._groups_seen}"
0218 |             ),
0219 |         }
```

```python
0001 | # stephanie/scoring/plugins/entailment_plugin.py
0002 | from __future__ import annotations
0003 | 
0004 | import logging
0005 | import math
0006 | from typing import Any, Dict
0007 | 
0008 | import torch
0009 | 
0010 | from .registry import register
0011 | 
0012 | log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
0013 | 
0014 | @register("entailment")
0015 | class EntailmentPlugin:
0016 |     """
0017 |     Computes entailment probability between goal and reply using the host scorer's model.
0018 |     Uses teacher-forced likelihood estimation: P(reply | goal) → maps to [0,1].
0019 | 
0020 |     This plugin is designed to work with HuggingFaceScorer and leverages its
0021 |     loaded model/tokenizer. It does NOT load a new model.
0022 | 
0023 |     Outputs:
0024 |         entailment.score01: float ∈ [0,1] — higher = more entailed
0025 |         entailment.risk01:  float ∈ [0,1] — 1 - score01 (for risk alignment)
0026 | 
0027 |     Usage in HallucinationContext:
0028 |         entailment = lambda p, h: tap_output.attributes.get("entailment.score01", 0.5)
0029 |     """
0030 | 
0031 |     def __init__(
0032 |         self,
0033 |         container=None,
0034 |         logger=None,
0035 |         host=None,
0036 |         *,
0037 |         threshold: float = 0.35,  # for risk01 mapping
0038 |         use_logprob: bool = True,  # if False, uses cosine similarity fallback
0039 |     ):
0040 |         self.container = container
0041 |         self.logger = logger
0042 |         self.host = host
0043 |         self.threshold = float(threshold)
0044 |         self.use_logprob = bool(use_logprob)
0045 | 
0046 |         # Validate: host must be HuggingFaceScorer
0047 |         if not hasattr(self.host, "_ll_stats") or not hasattr(self.host, "tok"):
0048 |             raise ValueError(
0049 |                 "EntailmentPlugin requires host to be a HuggingFaceScorer instance"
0050 |             )
0051 | 
0052 |     def post_process(self, *, tap_output: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, float]:
0053 |         """
0054 |         Post-process hook: computes entailment from goal and reply.
0055 |         Uses host's model to compute P(reply | goal) via teacher-forced logprob.
0056 |         """
0057 |         goal_text = tap_output.get("goal_text", "")
0058 |         reply_text = tap_output.get("resp_text", "")
0059 | 
0060 |         if not goal_text.strip() or not reply_text.strip():
0061 |             return {
0062 |                 "entailment.score01": 0.5,
0063 |                 "entailment.risk01": 0.5,
0064 |             }
0065 | 
0066 |         try:
0067 |             # Use the host's tokenizer and model (already loaded)
0068 |             tok = self.host.tok
0069 |             model = self.host.model
0070 | 
0071 |             # Tokenize goal and reply
0072 |             enc_goal = tok(goal_text, return_tensors="pt", add_special_tokens=False)
0073 |             enc_reply = tok(reply_text, return_tensors="pt", add_special_tokens=False)
0074 | 
0075 |             # Concatenate: [goal] [SEP] [reply]
0076 |             sep_token_id = tok.sep_token_id or tok.eos_token_id or 0
0077 |             input_ids = torch.cat(
0078 |                 [
0079 |                     enc_goal["input_ids"],
0080 |                     torch.tensor([[sep_token_id]]),
0081 |                     enc_reply["input_ids"],
0082 |                 ],
0083 |                 dim=1,
0084 |             ).to(model.device)
0085 |             attention_mask = torch.ones_like(input_ids)
0086 | 
0087 |             # Truncate if needed
0088 |             max_seq_len = getattr(self.host, "max_seq_len", 4096)
0089 |             if input_ids.shape[1] > max_seq_len:
0090 |                 cut = input_ids.shape[1] - max_seq_len
0091 |                 input_ids = input_ids[:, cut:]
0092 |                 attention_mask = attention_mask[:, cut:]
0093 | 
0094 |             # Forward pass
0095 |             with torch.no_grad():
0096 |                 out = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
0097 |                 logits = out.logits  # [1, T, V]
0098 | 
0099 |             # Shift for teacher forcing: predict next token
0100 |             shift_logits = logits[:, :-1, :]
0101 |             shift_labels = input_ids[:, 1:]
0102 | 
0103 |             # Extract only the reply portion (after SEP)
0104 |             sep_pos = (input_ids[0] == sep_token_id).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
0105 |             if len(sep_pos) == 0:
0106 |                 return {"entailment.score01": 0.5, "entailment.risk01": 0.5}
0107 | 
0108 |             sep_idx = sep_pos[0].item()
0109 |             reply_start = sep_idx + 1
0110 |             reply_logits = shift_logits[:, reply_start:, :]
0111 |             reply_labels = shift_labels[:, reply_start:]
0112 | 
0113 |             if reply_labels.numel() == 0:
0114 |                 return {"entailment.score01": 0.5, "entailment.risk01": 0.5}
0115 | 
0116 |             # Compute mean log probability of reply given goal
0117 |             logprobs = torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(reply_logits, dim=-1)
0118 |             chosen_lp = torch.gather(
0119 |                 logprobs, dim=-1, index=reply_labels.unsqueeze(-1)
0120 |             ).squeeze(-1)
0121 |             mean_logprob = float(chosen_lp.mean().item())
0122 | 
0123 |             # Map mean_logprob → [0,1] using logistic transform (same as before)
0124 |             # We calibrate: mean_logprob ~ -1.0 to +0.5 → map to [0,1]
0125 |             k = 3.0
0126 |             x0 = -0.3
0127 |             entail_score = 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-k * (mean_logprob - x0)))
0128 |             entail_score = max(0.0, min(1.0, entail_score))
0129 | 
0130 |             return {
0131 |                 "entailment.score01": entail_score,
0132 |                 "entailment.risk01": 1.0 - entail_score,
0133 |             }
0134 | 
0135 |         except Exception as e:
0136 |             if self.logger:
0137 |                 log.warning(
0138 |                     "EntailmentPlugin failed; returning neutral score", extra={"error": str(e)}
0139 |                 )
0140 |             return {"entailment.score01": 0.5, "entailment.risk01": 0.5}
```

```python
0001 | # stephanie/scoring/plugins/factory.py
0002 | from __future__ import annotations
0003 | 
0004 | import importlib
0005 | from typing import Any, Dict, List
0006 | 
0007 | from .registry import get as get_registered
0008 | 
0009 | 
0010 | def _import_by_path(path: str):
0011 |     # Support "package.module:ClassName"
0012 |     if ":" in path:
0013 |         mod, cls = path.split(":", 1)
0014 |         m = importlib.import_module(mod)
0015 |         return getattr(m, cls)
0016 |     # Or "package.module.ClassName"
0017 |     parts = path.split(".")
0018 |     mod, cls = ".".join(parts[:-1]), parts[-1]
0019 |     m = importlib.import_module(mod)
0020 |     return getattr(m, cls)
0021 | 
0022 | def build_plugins(
0023 |     *,
0024 |     cfg: Dict[str, Any],
0025 |     container,
0026 |     logger,
0027 |     host_scorer,                # the scorer instance (optional for plugins that use host internals)
0028 | ) -> List[Any]:
0029 |     """
0030 |     Reads cfg['plugins'] and instantiates enabled plugins.
0031 | 
0032 |     Accepted forms:
0033 |       plugins:
0034 |         scm:
0035 |           enabled: true
0036 |           class: "stephanie.scoring.plugins.scm_service_plugin:SCMServicePlugin"  # optional if registered
0037 |           params: { model_alias: "hf_hrm", topk: 0 }
0038 |         readability:
0039 |           enabled: false
0040 |           class: "stephanie.scoring.plugins.readability_plugin:ReadabilityPlugin"
0041 |           params: {}
0042 |     Or with registry names:
0043 |         scm:
0044 |           enabled: true
0045 |           params: { model_alias: "hf_hrm" }
0046 | 
0047 |     Each plugin ctor should accept: (container=None, logger=None, host=None, **params)
0048 |     """
0049 |     plugs_cfg: Dict[str, Any] = dict(cfg.get("plugins", {}))
0050 |     out: List[Any] = []
0051 |     for name, spec in plugs_cfg.items():
0052 |         if not isinstance(spec, dict):
0053 |             continue
0054 |         if not spec.get("enabled", False):
0055 |             continue
0056 | 
0057 |         cls = None
0058 |         if "class" in spec:
0059 |             cls = _import_by_path(str(spec["class"]))
0060 |         else:
0061 |             cls = get_registered(name)
0062 |             if cls is None:
0063 |                 if logger:
0064 |                     logger.log("PluginMissingClass", {"plugin": name})
0065 |                 continue
0066 | 
0067 |         params = dict(spec.get("params", {}))
0068 |         try:
0069 |             plugin = cls(container=container, logger=logger, host=host_scorer, **params)
0070 |             out.append(plugin)
0071 |         except Exception as e:
0072 |             if logger:
0073 |                 logger.log("PluginInitError", {"plugin": name, "error": str(e)})
0074 |     return out
```

```python
0010 | class VPMTapPlugin:

0012 |     After each tick, write a single VPM row to DB and (optionally) push to ZeroModel timeline.

0030 |         ]

0036 |             metric_names=metrics,
0037 |             values=values,
0038 |             extra={"tick": int(tick)}
0039 |         )
0040 | 
0041 |         # append to ZeroModel timeline (for GIFs)
0042 |         if zm:
0043 |             if not self._timeline_open:
0044 |                 zm.timeline_open(self.run_id, metrics=metrics)
0045 |                 self._timeline_open = True
0046 |             zm.timeline_append_row(self.run_id, metrics_columns=metrics, metrics_values=values)
0047 | 
0048 |     def on_shutdown(self, **_):
0049 |         try:
0050 |             zm = self.container.get("zeromodel-service-v2")
0051 |             if self._timeline_open and zm:
0052 |                 # finalize asynchronously if your runtime allows; otherwise, call without await in sync context
0053 |                 asyncio.create_task(zm.timeline_finalize(self.run_id, out_path="data/vpms"))
0054 |         except Exception:
0055 |             pass
```

```python
0001 | # stephanie/scoring/plugins/scm_service_plugin.py

0010 | @register("scm")
0011 | class SCMServicePlugin:
0012 |     """
0013 |     Computes SCM features from existing LL stats in tap_output.attributes.
0014 |     Falls back to host._ll_stats(goal, resp) only if attrs are missing.
0015 |     Mirrors scm.{dim}.score01 into {alias}.{dim}.* without touching base vector.
0016 |     """
0017 |     def __init__(self, container=None, logger=None, host=None,
0018 |                  model_alias: Optional[str]=None, topk: int = 0,
0019 |                  ppl_low: float = 5.0, ppl_high: float = 40.0):
0020 |         self.container = container
0021 |         self.logger = logger
0022 |         self.host = host
0023 |         self.alias = model_alias or getattr(host, "model_alias", getattr(host, "model_type", "model"))
0024 |         self.topk = int(topk or 0)
0025 |         self.ppl_low = float(ppl_low)
0026 |         self.ppl_high = float(ppl_high)
0027 |         try:
0028 |             self.scm_svc = container.get("scm_service")
0029 |         except Exception:
0030 |             self.scm_svc = None
0031 | 
0032 |     def post_process(self, *, tap_output: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, float]:
0033 |         attrs = (tap_output.get("attributes") or {})
0034 |         goal  = tap_output.get("goal_text", "") or ""
0035 |         resp  = tap_output.get("resp_text", "") or ""
0036 | 
0037 |         # 1) Pull LL stats from attributes first (no recompute).
0038 |         stats = {}
0039 |         for k in ("mean_logprob", "ppl", "entropy_mean", "len_tokens",
0040 |                   "len_chars", "bytes_len", "sum_nll_nats", "bpb"):
0041 |             if k in attrs and self._finite(attrs[k]):
0042 |                 stats[k] = float(attrs[k])
0043 | 
0044 |         # 2) If absent, use host._ll_stats(goal, resp) as fallback (HF scorer path).
0045 |         if (not stats) and self.host is not None and hasattr(self.host, "_ll_stats"):
0046 |             try:
0047 |                 stats = self.host._ll_stats(goal, resp) or {}
0048 |             except Exception as e:
0049 |                 stats = {}
0050 |                 if self.logger:
0051 |                     self.logger.log("SCMPlugin_ll_stats_error", {"error": str(e)})
0052 | 
0053 |         if not stats or not self.scm_svc:
0054 |             # Nothing to add.
0055 |             return {}
0056 | 
0057 |         # 3) Derive SCM from stats via service (single source of truth).
0058 |         try:
0059 |             vocab_size = None
0060 |             try:
0061 |                 # Best-effort vocab probe for HF scorers
0062 |                 if getattr(self.host, "tok", None) is not None:
0063 |                     vocab_size = getattr(self.host.tok, "vocab_size", None)
0064 |                     if vocab_size is None and hasattr(self.host.tok, "get_vocab"):
0065 |                         vocab_size = len(self.host.tok.get_vocab() or {})
0066 |             except Exception:
0067 |                 pass
0068 | 
0069 |             scm = self.scm_svc.derive_scm_from_ll(
0070 |                 stats,
0071 |                 ppl_low=self.ppl_low,
0072 |                 ppl_high=self.ppl_high,
0073 |                 vocab_size=vocab_size
0074 |             )
0075 |         except Exception as e:
0076 |             if self.logger:
0077 |                 self.logger.log("SCMServiceError", {"error": str(e)})
0078 |             return {}
0079 | 
0080 |         # (Optional) top-k token payload hook; keep out of vector
0081 |         if self.topk > 0 and hasattr(self.host, "token_topk"):
0082 |             try:
0083 |                 _ = self.host.token_topk(goal, resp, k=self.topk)
0084 |             except Exception:
0085 |                 pass
0086 | 
0087 |         # 4) Mirror per-dim scores under alias.* so downstream selectors find them.
0088 |         out: Dict[str, float] = {}
0089 |         out.update({k: float(v) for k, v in scm.items() if self._finite(v)})
0090 | 
0091 |         for dim in ("reasoning", "knowledge", "clarity", "faithfulness", "coverage"):
0092 |             k = f"scm.{dim}.score01"
0093 |             if k in scm and self._finite(scm[k]):
0094 |                 v = float(scm[k])
0095 |                 out[f"{self.alias}.{dim}.score01"]  = v
0096 |                 out[f"{self.alias}.{dim}.score100"] = round(v * 100.0, 4)
0097 |                 out[f"{self.alias}.{dim}"]          = v
0098 | 
0099 |         return out

0101 |     @staticmethod
0102 |     def _finite(x) -> bool:
0103 |         try:
0104 |             return math.isfinite(float(x))
0105 |         except Exception:
0106 |             return False
```

```python
0031 | @register("vpm_energy")
0032 | class VPMEnergyPlugin:
0033 |     """
0034 |     Reptilian-style boundary/threat scoring for VPM embeddings.
0035 |     - Reads:  attributes["vpm_embedding"]
0036 |     - Optional proto source:
0037 |          1) params.core_prototype (list/np)
0038 |          2) container.memory.vpms.get_core_prototype()
0039 |     - Outputs:
0040 |         vpm.cosine
0041 |         vpm.energy01           = (1 - cosine)/2
0042 |         reptilian.threat01     = σ(gain*energy + bias)
0043 |         reptilian.compat01     = 1 - energy
0044 |     """
0045 |     def __init__(
0046 |         self,
0047 |         container=None,
0048 |         logger=None,
0049 |         host=None,
0050 |         *,
0051 |         gain: float = 3.0,
0052 |         bias: float = -1.0,
0053 |         ema_update: bool = True,
0054 |         ema_decay: float = 0.95,
0055 |         core_prototype: Optional[Any] = None,
0056 |     ):
0057 |         self.container = container
0058 |         self.logger = logger
0059 |         self.host = host
0060 |         self.gain = float(gain)
0061 |         self.bias = float(bias)
0062 |         self.ema_update = bool(ema_update)
0063 |         self.ema_decay = float(ema_decay)
0064 |         self._proto = _to_vec(core_prototype) if core_prototype is not None else None
0065 | 
0066 |         # Memory/VPM store (optional)
0067 |         self.mem = getattr(container, "memory", None) if container else None
0068 |         self.vpms = getattr(self.mem, "vpms", None) if self.mem else None
0069 | 
0070 |     def _get_proto(self) -> Optional[np.ndarray]:
0071 |         if self._proto is not None:
0072 |             return self._proto
0073 |         try:
0074 |             if self.vpms and hasattr(self.vpms, "get_core_prototype"):
0075 |                 p = self.vpms.get_core_prototype()
0076 |                 if p is not None:
0077 |                     self._proto = _to_vec(p)
0078 |                     return self._proto
0079 |         except Exception as e:
0080 |             if self.logger:
0081 |                 self.logger.log("VPMEnergy.get_proto.error", {"error": str(e)})
0082 |         return None
0083 | 
0084 |     def _ema_update_proto(self, x: np.ndarray):
0085 |         if not self.ema_update:
0086 |             return
0087 |         try:
0088 |             p = self._get_proto()
0089 |             if p is None:
0090 |                 self._proto = _to_vec(x)
0091 |             else:
0092 |                 self._proto = _to_vec(self.ema_decay * p + (1.0 - self.ema_decay) * _to_vec(x))
0093 |             # best-effort persistence
0094 |             if self.vpms and hasattr(self.vpms, "set_core_prototype"):
0095 |                 self.vpms.set_core_prototype(self._proto.tolist())
0096 |         except Exception as e:
0097 |             if self.logger:
0098 |                 self.logger.log("VPMEnergy.ema.error", {"error": str(e)})
0099 | 
0100 |     def post_process(self, *, tap_output: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, float]:
0101 |         attrs = tap_output.get("attributes") or {}
0102 |         emb = attrs.get("vpm_embedding")
0103 |         if emb is None:
0104 |             return {}
0105 | 
0106 |         x = _to_vec(emb)
0107 |         proto = self._get_proto() or x  # self-compat if no proto yet
0108 |         cos = cosine(x, proto)
0109 |         energy = (1.0 - cos) * 0.5               # [0,1]
0110 |         compat = 1.0 - energy
0111 |         threat = 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-(self.gain * energy + self.bias)))  # σ
0112 | 
0113 |         # keep proto fresh
0114 |         self._ema_update_proto(x)
0115 | 
0116 |         return {
0117 |             "vpm.cosine": cos,
0118 |             "vpm.energy01": float(energy),
0119 |             "reptilian.compat01": float(compat),
0120 |             "reptilian.threat01": float(threat),
0121 |         }
```

```python
0032 | @register("vpm_pattern")
0033 | class VPMPatternPlugin:
0034 |     """
0035 |     Mammalian-style pattern & valence from VPM embedding.
0036 |     - Reads:  attributes["vpm_embedding"]
0037 |     - Optional sources:
0038 |         * weight,bias (params) OR container.memory.vpms.get_pattern_head()
0039 |         * valence_axis (params) OR container.memory.vpms.get_valence_axis()
0040 |         * zeromodel-service-v2 (optional): can be used to derive weights/axes centrally
0041 |     - Outputs:
0042 |         mammalian.pattern_conf01 ∈ [0,1]
0043 |         mammalian.valence        ∈ [-1,1]
0044 |         mammalian.valence01      ∈ [0,1]
0045 |     """
0046 |     def __init__(
0047 |         self,
0048 |         container=None,
0049 |         logger=None,
0050 |         host=None,
0051 |         *,
0052 |         weight: Optional[Any] = None,
0053 |         bias: float = 0.0,
0054 |         valence_axis: Optional[Any] = None,
0055 |         use_zero_model: bool = False,
0056 |     ):
0057 |         self.container = container
0058 |         self.logger = logger
0059 |         self.host = host
0060 | 
0061 |         self.w = _to_vec(weight) if weight is not None else None
0062 |         self.b = float(bias)
0063 |         self.axis = _to_vec(valence_axis) if valence_axis is not None else None
0064 |         self.use_zero_model = bool(use_zero_model)
0065 | 
0066 |         # Optional stores/services
0067 |         self.mem = getattr(container, "memory", None) if container else None
0068 |         self.vpms = getattr(self.mem, "vpms", None) if self.mem else None
0069 | 
0070 |         try:
0071 |             self.zm = container.get("zeromodel-service-v2") if (container and use_zero_model and hasattr(container, "get")) else None
0072 |         except Exception:
0073 |             self.zm = None
0074 | 
0075 |     def _load_head_lazy(self):
0076 |         if self.w is not None:
0077 |             return
0078 |         try:
0079 |             if self.vpms and hasattr(self.vpms, "get_pattern_head"):
0080 |                 data = self.vpms.get_pattern_head()  # {"weight":[...], "bias":float}
0081 |                 if data and isinstance(data, dict):
0082 |                     if "weight" in data:
0083 |                         self.w = _to_vec(data["weight"])
0084 |                     if "bias" in data:
0085 |                         self.b = float(data["bias"])
0086 |         except Exception as e:
0087 |             if self.logger:
0088 |                 self.logger.log("VPMPattern.head.load.error", {"error": str(e)})
0089 | 
0090 |     def _load_axis_lazy(self):
0091 |         if self.axis is not None:
0092 |             return
0093 |         try:
0094 |             if self.vpms and hasattr(self.vpms, "get_valence_axis"):
0095 |                 a = self.vpms.get_valence_axis()
0096 |                 if a is not None:
0097 |                     self.axis = _to_vec(a)
0098 |         except Exception as e:
0099 |             if self.logger:
0100 |                 self.logger.log("VPMPattern.axis.load.error", {"error": str(e)})
0101 | 
0102 |     def _pattern_score(self, x: np.ndarray) -> float:
0103 |         self._load_head_lazy()
0104 |         if self.w is None:
0105 |             # very gentle default head; dimension-agnostic
0106 |             rng = max(1, x.size)
0107 |             self.w = np.ones((rng,), dtype=np.float32) / float(rng)
0108 |             self.b = 0.0
0109 |         margin = float(np.dot(x, self.w) + self.b)
0110 |         return _sigmoid(margin)
0111 | 
0112 |     def _valence(self, x: np.ndarray) -> float:
0113 |         self._load_axis_lazy()
0114 |         if self.axis is None or self.axis.size != x.size:
0115 |             return 0.0
0116 |         v = float(np.clip(np.dot(x, self.axis), -1.0, 1.0))
0117 |         return v
0118 | 
0119 |     def post_process(self, *, tap_output: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, float]:
0120 |         attrs = tap_output.get("attributes") or {}
0121 |         emb = attrs.get("vpm_embedding")
0122 |         if emb is None:
0123 |             return {}
0124 | 
0125 |         x = _to_vec(emb)
0126 |         conf = self._pattern_score(x)          # [0,1]
0127 |         val  = self._valence(x)                # [-1,1]
0128 |         val01 = 0.5 * (val + 1.0)              # to [0,1]
0129 | 
0130 |         return {
0131 |             "mammalian.pattern_conf01": float(conf),
0132 |             "mammalian.valence": float(val),
0133 |             "mammalian.valence01": float(val01),
0134 |         }
```

```python
0249 |                 svc = self.container.get(service_name)
0250 |             except Exception as e:
0251 |                 log.error("ScoringPluginContainerError: service '%s' not found (%s)", service_name, e)
0252 |                 continue
0253 | 
0254 |             # Must implement post_process(tap_output=...)
0255 |             post = getattr(svc, "post_process", None)
0256 |             if not callable(post):
0257 |                 log.error(
0258 |                     "ScoringPluginTypeError: service '%s' does not implement post_process(tap_output=...)", service_name
0259 |                 )
0260 |                 continue
0261 | 
0262 |             # Hand the scorer to the service (so it can use model/tok/max_seq_len)
0263 |             try:
0264 |                 if hasattr(svc, "set_host") and callable(getattr(svc, "set_host")):
0265 |                     svc.set_host(self)
0266 |                 else:
0267 |                     setattr(svc, "host", self)
0268 |             except Exception as e:
0269 |                 log.warning("PluginHostAttachWarning: %s (svc=%s)", e, service_name)
0270 | 
0271 |             # Stash plugin options on the service
0272 |             try:
0273 |                 setattr(svc, "_plugin_opts", dict(opts or {}))
0274 |             except Exception:
0275 |                 pass
0276 | 
0277 |             plugins.append(svc)
0278 |             log.debug("ScoringPluginLoaded(service): %s -> %s", service_name, type(svc).__name__)
0279 | 
0280 |         return plugins
0281 | 
0282 |     # ===== Model health / self-test =====
0283 |     def check_model_health(
0284 |         self,
0285 |         *,
0286 |         dimension: str,
0287 |         model_name: str,
0288 |         model,
0289 |         load_audit: Optional[LoadAudit] = None,
0290 |         model_id: Optional[str] = None,
0291 |     ) -> dict:
0292 |         return self.model_health.check_loaded_model(
0293 |             scorer_name=self.__class__.__name__,
0294 |             dimension=dimension,
0295 |             model_name=model_name,
0296 |             model=model,
0297 |             load_audit=load_audit,
0298 |             model_id=model_id,
0299 |         )
```

```python
0001 | """

0039 | class PreferenceRanker(nn.Module):

0044 |     def __init__(self, embedding_dim: int = 1024, hidden_dim: int = 256):
0045 |         super().__init__()

0047 |             nn.Linear(embedding_dim, hidden_dim),
0048 |             nn.ReLU(),

0050 |             nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),

0053 |             nn.Linear(hidden_dim * 2, hidden_dim),
0054 |             nn.ReLU(),

0056 |         )

0058 |     def forward(self, emb_a: torch.Tensor, emb_b: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
0059 |         """
0060 |         emb_a/b: (B, D) tensors already scaled/normalized as per training.
0061 |         Returns logits (B,) where higher means "a preferred over b".
0062 |         """
0063 |         feat_a = self.encoder(emb_a)
0064 |         feat_b = self.encoder(emb_b)
0065 |         combined = torch.cat([feat_a, feat_b], dim=1)
0066 |         return self.comparator(combined).squeeze(1)

0069 | class ContrastiveRankerScorer(BaseScorer):
0070 |     """

0072 |

0108 |     def _prep_pair_tensor(

0116 |         apply the joblib scaler, return as (1, D) float32 tensor on self.device.
0117 |         """

0125 |         return np.asarray(vec, dtype=np.float32)

0180 |                 })

0182 |             except Exception as e:

0185 |     def _get_context_embedding(self, context: Optional[dict]) -> np.ndarray:

0208 |     # ---------- scoring API ---------- #
0209 | 
0210 |     def _score_core(self, context: dict, scorable: Scorable, dimensions: List[str]) -> ScoreBundle:
0211 |         """
0212 |         Absolute scoring by baseline comparison:
0213 |         For each dimension d:
0214 |         - build [ctx||doc] vs [ctx||baseline_d]
0215 |         - run model(doc, baseline) → raw logit
0216 |         - calibrate via RegressionTuner → tuned_score

0248 |             attributes = {

0251 |                 "final_score": final,

0253 |             }

0255 |             results[dim] = ScoreResult(
0256 |                 dimension=dim,
0257 |                 score=final,

0261 |                 attributes=attributes,
0262 |             )
0263 | 
0264 |         return ScoreBundle(results=results)
0265 | 
0266 |     def compare(
0267 |         self,
0268 |         context: Optional[dict],
0269 |         a: Scorable,
0270 |         b: Scorable,
0271 |         dimensions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
0272 |     ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
0273 |         """
0274 |         Native pairwise compare A vs B under the (possibly goal-conditioned) context.
0275 | 
0276 |         Returns:
0277 |             {
0278 |               "winner": "a"|"b",
0279 |               "score_a": float,  # mean preference P(A>B) across used dims
0280 |               "score_b": float,
0281 |               "mode": "pairwise",
0282 |               "scorer": "contrastive_ranker",
0283 |               "per_dimension": [
0284 |                  {"dimension": dim, "p_ab": ..., "p_ba": ..., "pref_a": ..., "raw_ab": ..., "raw_ba": ...},
0285 |                  ...
0286 |               ]
0287 |             }
0288 |         """
0289 |         ctx_emb = self._get_context_embedding(context)
0290 |         a_emb = self._safe_embed(a.text)
0291 |         b_emb = self._safe_embed(b.text)
0292 | 
0293 |         dims = dimensions or getattr(self, "dimensions", None) or list(self.models.keys())
0294 |         per_dim: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
0295 |         pref_sum = 0.0
0296 |         used = 0
0297 | 
0298 |         for dim in dims:
0299 |             if dim not in self.models:
0300 |                 self.logger.log("ContrastiveRankerMissingDim", {"dimension": dim})
0301 |                 continue
0302 | 
0303 |             scaler, model = self.models[dim]
0304 |             model.eval()
0305 | 
0306 |             t_a = self._prep_pair_tensor(scaler, ctx_emb, a_emb)
0307 |             t_b = self._prep_pair_tensor(scaler, ctx_emb, b_emb)
0308 | 
0309 |             with torch.no_grad():
0310 |                 raw_ab = float(model(t_a, t_b).item())  # logit “A over B”
0311 |                 raw_ba = float(model(t_b, t_a).item())  # logit “B over A”
0312 | 
0313 |             p_ab = self._sigmoid(raw_ab)               # P(A > B)
0314 |             p_ba = self._sigmoid(raw_ba)               # P(B > A)
0315 |             # symmetric preference (robust to slight antisymmetry violations)
0316 |             pref_a = 0.5 * (p_ab + (1.0 - p_ba))
0317 | 
0318 |             per_dim.append({
0319 |                 "dimension": dim,
0320 |                 "p_ab": round(p_ab, 6),
0321 |                 "p_ba": round(p_ba, 6),
0322 |                 "pref_a": round(pref_a, 6),
0323 |                 "raw_ab": round(raw_ab, 6),
0324 |                 "raw_ba": round(raw_ba, 6),
0325 |             })
0326 |             pref_sum += pref_a
0327 |             used += 1
0328 | 
0329 |         pref_a_mean = float(pref_sum / used) if used else 0.5
0330 |         winner = "a" if pref_a_mean >= 0.5 else "b"
0331 | 
0332 |         result = {
0333 |             "winner": winner,
0334 |             "score_a": pref_a_mean,
0335 |             "score_b": float(1.0 - pref_a_mean),
0336 |             "mode": "pairwise",
0337 |             "scorer": self.model_type,
0338 |             "per_dimension": per_dim,
0339 |         }
0340 |         if self.logger:
0341 |             self.logger.log("ContrastivePairwiseDecision", result)
0342 |         return result
```

```python
0131 |                 "entropy": entropy,
0132 |                 "advantage": advantage,
0133 |             }
0134 | 
0135 |             results[dim] = ScoreResult(
0136 |                 dimension=dim,
0137 |                 score=final_score,
0138 |                 source=self.model_type,
0139 |                 rationale=rationale,
0140 |                 weight=1.0, 
0141 |                 attributes=attributes,
0142 |             )
0143 | 
0144 |         return ScoreBundle(results=results)
```

```python
0153 |     ) -> ScoreBundle:

0155 |         Scores a PlanTrace using the trained Epistemic Plan HRM model(s).
0156 | 
0157 |         Args:
0158 |             trace: A PlanTrace object (or dict) representing the reasoning process to evaluate.
0159 |                 This is the primary input for the Epistemic Plan HRM.
0160 |             dimensions: A list of dimension names. The scorer will produce a result for
0161 |                         each dimension it has a trained model for *and* that is requested.
0162 | 
0163 |         Returns:
0164 |             ScoreBundle: Contains ScoreResults for each applicable dimension.
0165 |                         The score represents the 'epistemic quality' of the trace.
0166 |         """
0167 |         # Note: No 'goal: dict' or 'scorable: Scorable' args, as they are not the primary input.
0168 | 
0169 |         results = {}
0170 | 
0171 |         # Check if trace is valid
0172 |         if not plan_trace or not plan_trace.execution_steps:
0173 |             self.logger.log(

0184 |             )
0185 |             x_input = (

0190 |                     dimensions=dimensions,
0191 |                 )

0196 |         except Exception as e:

0200 |             )
0201 | 
0202 |         for dimension in dimensions:
0203 |             model = self.models.get(dimension)
0204 |             if not model:
0205 |                 self.logger.log(
0206 |                     "EpistemicPlanHRMScorerError",
0207 |                     {
0208 |                         "message": f"HRM model not found for dimension '{dimension}'"
0209 |                     },
0210 |                 )
0211 |                 continue
0212 | 
0213 |             try:
0214 |                 with torch.no_grad():
0215 |                     y_pred, intermediate_states = model(x_input)
0216 |                 raw_score = y_pred.squeeze().item()
0217 | 
0218 |                 rationale = f"HRM[{dimension}] score={round(raw_score, 4)}"
0219 | 
0220 |                 attributes = {
0221 |                     "raw_score": round(raw_score, 4),
0222 |                 }
0223 | 
0224 |                 result = ScoreResult(
0225 |                     dimension=dimension,
0226 |                     score=raw_score,
0227 |                     rationale=rationale,
0228 |                     weight=1.0,
0229 |                     source=self.model_type,
0230 |                     attributes=attributes,
0231 |                 )
0232 |                 results[dimension] = result
0233 | 
0234 |             except Exception as e:
0235 |                 self.logger.log(

0237 |                     {"dimension": dimension, "error": str(e)},
0238 |                 )
0239 | 
0240 |         return ScoreBundle(results=results)
```
