0143 |             db_scores = self._compute_db_proximity(target_text)
0144 | 
0145 |         metrics = {
0146 |             # Embedding stats
0147 |             "avg_similarity": {
0148 |                 "score": avg_sim,
0149 |                 "rationale": f"Average pairwise similarity across {pair_count} pairs.",
0150 |                 "weight": 1.2,
0151 |                 "attributes": {"pair_count": pair_count},
0152 |             },
0153 |             "max_similarity": {
0154 |                 "score": max_sim,
0155 |                 "rationale": "Strongest semantic overlap between any two hypotheses.",
0156 |                 "weight": 1.0,
0157 |             },
0158 |             "min_similarity": {
0159 |                 "score": min_sim,
0160 |                 "rationale": "Weakest semantic overlap (outlier detection).",
0161 |                 "weight": 0.5,
0162 |             },
0163 |             "similarity_variance": {
0164 |                 "score": sim_var,
0165 |                 "rationale": "Variance of similarity scores (spread/uncertainty).",
0166 |                 "weight": 0.7,
0167 |             },
0168 |             "avg_topk_similarity": {
0169 |                 "score": avg_topk,
0170 |                 "rationale": f"Average similarity among top-{self.max_pairs} pairs.",
0171 |                 "weight": 1.1,
0172 |             },
0173 |             "graft_pair_count": {
0174 |                 "score": graft_count,
0175 |                 "rationale": f"Number of pairs ≥ {self.similarity_threshold}.",
0176 |                 "weight": 0.9,
0177 |                 "attributes": {"graft_pairs": graft_pairs},
0178 |             },
0179 |             # Cluster / diversity
0180 |             "cluster_density": {
0181 |                 "score": cluster_density,
0182 |                 "rationale": "Fraction of pairs above threshold (cluster tightness).",
0183 |                 "weight": 1.0,
0184 |             },
0185 |             "redundancy_index": {
0186 |                 "score": redundancy_index,
0187 |                 "rationale": "High top-k similarity → risk of redundancy.",
0188 |                 "weight": 0.8,
0189 |             },
0190 |             "novelty_index": {
0191 |                 "score": novelty_index,
0192 |                 "rationale": "Encourages new hypotheses (low overlap).",
0193 |                 "weight": 0.9,
0194 |             },
0195 |         }
0196 | 
0197 |         # Merge DB metrics if available
0198 |         metrics.update(db_scores)
0199 |         return metrics
0200 | 
0201 |     def _compute_db_proximity(self, target_text):
0202 |         """Compute database match metrics for hypothesis proximity."""
0203 |         matches = self.memory.embedding.search_related_scorables(
0204 |             target_text, top_k=self.top_k_db
0205 |         )
0206 |         if not matches:
0207 |             return {
0208 |                 "db_match_score": {
0209 |                     "score": 0.0,
0210 |                     "rationale": "No DB matches found.",
0211 |                     "weight": 1.0,
0212 |                 },
0213 |                 "db_overlap_count": {
0214 |                     "score": 0,
0215 |                     "rationale": "No overlaps above threshold.",
0216 |                     "weight": 0.7,
0217 |                 },
0218 |                 "db_diversity": {
0219 |                     "score": 0.0,
0220 |                     "rationale": "No DB diversity measurable.",
0221 |                     "weight": 0.6,
0222 |                 },
0223 |             }
0224 | 
0225 |         scores = [m.get("score") for m in matches]
0226 |         avg_match = float(np.mean(scores))
0227 |         overlap_count = sum(1 for s in scores if s >= self.similarity_threshold)
0228 |         db_div = float(np.std(scores))  # diversity from DB history
0229 | 
0230 |         return {
0231 |             "db_match_score": {
0232 |                 "score": avg_match,
0233 |                 "rationale": f"Average similarity to top-{self.top_k_db} DB matches.",
0234 |                 "weight": 1.0,
0235 |             },
0236 |             "db_overlap_count": {
0237 |                 "score": overlap_count,
0238 |                 "rationale": f"Count of DB matches ≥ {self.similarity_threshold}.",
0239 |                 "weight": 0.7,
0240 |             },
0241 |             "db_diversity": {
0242 |                 "score": db_div,
0243 |                 "rationale": "Spread of DB match similarities (diversity).",
0244 |                 "weight": 0.6,

0073 |     # ------------------------------------------------------------------    
0074 |     async def _predict_async(self, question: str, context: str) -> Tuple[float, Tuple[float, float], str]:
0075 |         """

0078 |         # Prefer service (it has domain + MemCube thresholds)

0092 |             domain = await DomainCalibratedRiskPredictor._fallback_domain_resolver(question or "")  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
0093 | 
0094 |         risk, (low, high) = await self._predictor.predict_risk(question or "", context or "")  # type: ignore[union-attr]
0095 |         return float(risk), (float(low), float(high)), str(domain)

0097 |     def _predict_blocking(self, question: str, context: str) -> Tuple[float, Tuple[float, float], str]:
0098 |         """
0099 |         Best-effort sync wrapper for environments that call scorers synchronously.
0100 |         """
0101 |         try:
0102 |             loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
0103 |         except RuntimeError:
0104 |             loop = None
0105 | 
0106 |         if loop and loop.is_running():
0107 |             # We are already in an event loop: run task and wait
0108 |             fut = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(self._predict_async(question, context), loop)
0109 |             return fut.result()
0110 |         else:
0111 |             return asyncio.run(self._predict_async(question, context))
0112 | 
0113 |     # ------------------------------------------------------------------

0115 |         """

0117 |         sync call to the async predictor so existing pipelines work unchanged.

0127 |             # Fail-soft: neutral risk with defaults

0129 | 
0130 |         band = "low" if risk < low else ("medium" if risk < high else "high")

0157 |             # band one-hot for topology

0159 |             "risk.band.medium": 1.0 if band == "medium" else 0.0,

0186 | # Small async util
0187 | # ------------------------
0188 | def _isawaitable(x) -> bool:
0189 |     try:
0190 |         import inspect
0191 |         return inspect.isawaitable(x)
0192 |     except Exception:
0193 |         return False
0194 | 
0195 | def awaitable_getattr(obj, name: str):
0196 |     """
0197 |     If obj has attribute 'name' and it's awaitable, await it (best-effort).
0198 |     Otherwise return value or None.
0199 |     """
0200 |     try:
0201 |         val = getattr(obj, name, None)
0202 |         if _isawaitable(val):
0203 |             try:
0204 |                 loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
0205 |             except RuntimeError:
0206 |                 loop = None
0207 |             if loop and loop.is_running():
0208 |                 fut = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(val, loop)
0209 |                 return fut.result()
0210 |             else:
0211 |                 return asyncio.run(val)
0212 |         return val
0213 |     except Exception:
0214 |         return None

0017 | class ScorableRanker(BaseScorer):
0018 |     """

0020 |     Integrates with the standard BaseScorer API:

0022 |       - rank(query, candidates, extra_signals) → List[EvaluationORM]

0024 | 
0025 |     def __init__(self, cfg, memory, container, logger):

0067 |                 },
0068 |             },

0103 |     def _diversity(

0112 |             self.memory.embedding.get_or_create(s.text) for s in selected

0116 |         # Handle potential embedding retrieval failures
0117 |         if cand_emb is None or not selected_embs:
0118 |             return 1.0
0119 | 
0120 |         similarities = cosine_similarity([cand_emb], selected_embs)[0]
0121 |         max_sim = float(max(similarities))
0122 | 
0123 |         # Diversity = 1 - max similarity to selected
0124 |         return 1.0 - max_sim

0128 |         # Extract available tools from context
0129 |         available_tools = context.get("available_tools", [])
0130 | 
0131 |         # Get tools used in this scorable (if it's a plan trace)
0132 |         used_tools = []
0133 |         if hasattr(scorable, "meta") and scorable.meta:
0134 |             used_tools = scorable.meta.get("tools", [])

0138 |         if not used_tools:

0142 |             set(used_tools)

0145 |     def _score_core(

0147 |     ) -> dict:

0150 |         Returns a dict with rank_score + component scores.

0156 |         # Component signals

0159 |             "reward": self._reward(scorable),

0161 |             "adaptability": self._adaptability(scorable, context=context),
0162 |         }

0164 |         rank_score = sum(

0202 |             components = {

0204 |                 "value": self._value(

0209 |             }
0210 | 
0211 |             scored.append((cand, components))

0213 |         if not scored:

0382 |     def _value(self, scorable: Scorable) -> float:
0383 |         return self.memory.scores.get_value_signal_for_target(
0384 |             target_id=str(scorable.id),
0385 |             target_type=scorable.target_type,
0386 |             prefer=("hrm", "HRM", "rank_score"),
0387 |             normalize=True,
0388 |             default=0.0,
0389 |         )
0390 | 
0391 |     def _calculate_rank_score(self, components: dict) -> float:
0392 |         """Calculate final rank score with proper weighting"""
0393 |         return (
0394 |             self.weights["similarity"] * components.get("similarity", 0.0)
0395 |             + self.weights["value"] * components.get("value", 0.0)
0396 |             + self.weights["recency"] * components.get("recency", 0.0)
0397 |             + self.weights["diversity"] * components.get("diversity", 0.0)
0398 |             + self.weights["adaptability"]
0399 |             * components.get("adaptability", 0.0)
0400 |         )
0401 | 
0402 |     def _recency(self, scorable: Scorable) -> float:
0403 |         """
0404 |         Exponential decay with a configurable half-life.
0405 |         Tries scorable.created_at → PlanTrace.created_at → latest Evaluation.created_at.
0406 |         Returns (0,1], ~1 for very recent, ~0 for very old; 0.5 if unknown.
0407 |         """
0408 |         halflife_days = self.cfg.get("recency_halflife_days", 30)
0409 | 
0410 |         created_at = self.memory.evaluations.get_latest_timestamp_for_target(
0411 |             scorable_id=str(scorable.id),
0412 |             scorable_type=scorable.target_type,
0413 |         )
0414 |         if created_at is None:
0415 |             return 0.5  # neutral
0416 |         try:
0417 |             age_sec = time.time() - created_at.timestamp()
0418 |         except Exception:
0419 |             return 0.5
0420 | 
0421 |         tau = (halflife_days * 24 * 3600) / math.log(2)  # half-life
0422 |         return math.exp(-age_sec / tau)

0041 |     def _score_core(self, context: dict, scorable: Scorable, dimensions: list[str]) -> ScoreBundle:
0042 |         goal = context.get(GOAL, {})
0043 |         goal_text = goal.get(GOAL_TEXT, "")

0045 |         doc_emb = np.asarray(self.memory.embedding.get_or_create(scorable.text))

0048 |         results = {}

0050 |             if dim not in self.models:

0052 |                 continue
0053 |             scaler, model = self.models[dim]
0054 |             tuner = self.tuners[dim]
0055 |             meta = self.metas.get(dim, {"min_value": 0, "max_value": 100})
0056 | 
0057 |             scaled_input = scaler.transform(input_vec)
0058 |             raw_score = model.predict(scaled_input)[0]
0059 |             tuned_score = tuner.transform(raw_score)

0061 |             # Clip to min/max
0062 |             final_score = max(min(tuned_score, meta["max_value"]), meta["min_value"])

0064 |                 dimension=dim,
0065 |                 score=final_score,
0066 |                 rationale=f"SVM raw={round(raw_score, 4)}",
0067 |                 weight=1.0,
0068 |                 source=self.model_type,
0069 |             )

0071 |         return ScoreBundle(results=results)

0556 |     Provides balanced diagnostic coverage including confidence estimates,

0573 |         out["aux3_p_mid"]  = float(p[..., 1].mean().item())
0574 |         out["aux3_p_good"] = float(p[..., 2].mean().item())

0576 | 
0577 |     # Calibration and temperature signals

0579 |

0583 |         log.debug("Using ood_hat01 for OOD detection")
0584 |     elif "ood_hat" in aux:  # backward compatibility
0585 |         out["ood_hat01"] = float(_tf(aux["ood_hat"]))
0586 |         log.debug("Using ood_hat (legacy) for OOD detection")
0587 | 
0588 |     # Robustness and sensitivity measures

0592 |

0596 |     log.debug("Extracted reconstruction and disagreement signals")
0597 | 
0598 |     # Length normalization (prefer 0..1 normalized version)

0600 |         out["length_norm01"] = float(_tf(aux["length_norm01"]))
0601 |         log.debug("Using length_norm01 for length effect")

0607 |             log.debug("Derived length_norm01 from len_effect")

0660 | # === SCM mapping from Tiny aux → aligned scm.* columns =======================
0661 | 
0662 | def _build_scm_from_tiny_attrs(attrs: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, float]:
0663 |     """
0664 |     Convert TRM attributes to Shared Core Metrics format.
0665 |     
0666 |     Maps TRM's internal diagnostic signals to the standardized 5-dimensional
0667 |     SCM format using learned weighting patterns. This enables direct
0668 |     comparison with HRM and other evaluation systems.
0669 |     
0670 |     The mapping uses TRM's diagnostic patterns to infer dimension scores:
0671 |     - Reasoning: Emphasizes consistency, low uncertainty, agreement
0672 |     - Knowledge: Focuses on in-distribution signals and reconstruction
0673 |     - Clarity: Uses token quality and length normalization
0674 |     - Faithfulness: Based on reconstruction and consistency
0675 |     - Coverage: Considers concept activity and distribution alignment
0676 |     
0677 |     Args:
0678 |         attrs: TRM attributes dictionary
0679 |         
0680 |     Returns:
0681 |         Dictionary of SCM-formatted scores in [0,1] range
0682 |     """
0683 |     log.debug("Building SCM from TRM attributes")
0684 |     
0685 |     # Extract and clamp core diagnostic signals
0686 |     certainty = float(attrs.get("certainty01", 0.5))
0687 |     unc01     = 1.0 - max(0.0, min(1.0, certainty))
0688 |     cons01    = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(attrs.get("consistency_hat", 0.5))))
0689 |     ood01     = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(attrs.get("ood_hat01", attrs.get("ood_hat", 0.0)))))
0690 |     len01     = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(attrs.get("len_effect", 0.0))))
0691 |     temp01    = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(attrs.get("temp01", 0.0))))
0692 |     agree01   = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(attrs.get("agree01", 0.5))))
0693 | 
0694 |     # Extract additional diagnostic signals
0695 |     recon_sim      = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(attrs.get("recon_sim", 0.5))))
0696 |     concept_sparse = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(attrs.get("concept_sparsity", 0.5))))
0697 |     p_bad          = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(attrs.get("aux3_p_bad", 0.5))))
0698 |     token_ok       = 1.0 - p_bad  # clarity proxy: lower bad probability → clearer
0699 | 
0700 |     log.debug(f"Core signals - uncertainty: {unc01:.3f}, consistency: {cons01:.3f}, OOD: {ood01:.3f}")
0701 | 
0702 |     # Dimension-specific scoring using diagnostic patterns
0703 |     dim_scores: Dict[str, float] = {}
0704 |     
0705 |     # Reasoning: weighted toward stability, consistency, and confidence
0706 |     dim_scores["reasoning"] = 0.60*cons01 + 0.30*(1.0-unc01) + 0.10*agree01
0707 |     log.debug(f"Reasoning score: {dim_scores['reasoning']:.3f}")
0708 |     
0709 |     # Knowledge: emphasizes distribution alignment and comprehension
0710 |     dim_scores["knowledge"] = 0.50*(1.0-ood01) + 0.30*recon_sim + 0.20*(1.0-unc01)
0711 |     log.debug(f"Knowledge score: {dim_scores['knowledge']:.3f}")
0712 |     
0713 |     # Clarity: based on token quality and brevity
0714 |     dim_scores["clarity"] = 0.50*token_ok + 0.30*(1.0-len01) + 0.20*cons01
0715 |     log.debug(f"Clarity score: {dim_scores['clarity']:.3f}")
0716 |     
0717 |     # Faithfulness: reconstruction quality and stability
0718 |     dim_scores["faithfulness"] = 0.50*recon_sim + 0.30*cons01 + 0.20*(1.0-unc01)
0719 |     log.debug(f"Faithfulness score: {dim_scores['faithfulness']:.3f}")
0720 |     
0721 |     # Coverage: concept activity and confidence
0722 |     dim_scores["coverage"] = 0.40*concept_sparse + 0.40*(1.0-unc01) + 0.20*(1.0-ood01)
0723 |     log.debug(f"Coverage score: {dim_scores['coverage']:.3f}")
0724 | 
0725 |     # Ensure all scores are in valid [0,1] range
0726 |     for k in dim_scores:
0727 |         v = dim_scores[k]
0728 |         dim_scores[k] = float(min(1.0, max(0.0, v)))
0729 |     log.debug("Applied score clamping to [0,1] range")
0730 | 
0731 |     # Build final SCM dictionary
0732 |     scm: Dict[str, float] = {
0733 |         f"scm.{k}.score01": dim_scores[k]
0734 |         for k in ("reasoning", "knowledge", "clarity", "faithfulness", "coverage")
0735 |     }
0736 |     scm["scm.aggregate01"]   = float(sum(dim_scores.values())/5.0)
0737 |     scm["scm.uncertainty01"] = float(unc01)
0738 |     scm["scm.ood_hat01"]     = float(ood01)
0739 |     scm["scm.consistency01"] = float(cons01)
0740 |     scm["scm.length_norm01"] = float(len01)
0741 |     scm["scm.temp01"]        = float(temp01)
0742 |     scm["scm.agree_hat01"]   = float(agree01)
0743 | 
0744 |     log.debug(f"SCM construction complete - aggregate: {scm['scm.aggregate01']:.3f}")
0745 |     return scm

0069 |             with torch.no_grad():

0089 |                         source="vpm_transformer",

0091 |                     )

0099 |                     source="vpm_transformer",
0100 |                     meta={"dimension_weights": w, "dimension_order": order}
0101 |                 )

0105 |         except Exception as e:

0107 |             return self._fallback(dimensions)

0109 |     # ---------- helpers ----------
0110 |     def _to_tensor(self, scorable: Scorable) -> torch.Tensor:
0111 |         arr = scorable.get_image_array()
0112 |         if isinstance(arr, list):
0113 |             arr = np.array(arr)
0114 | 
0115 |         # Accept HxW, HxWx1, HxWx3, uint8 or float
0116 |         if arr.ndim == 2:
0117 |             arr = arr[..., None]
0118 |         if arr.dtype != np.float32:
0119 |             arr = arr.astype(np.float32)
0120 |         if arr.max() > 1.0:
0121 |             arr = arr / 255.0
0122 | 
0123 |         # Binary friendly: keep exact 0/1 if already binary
0124 |         uniq = np.unique(arr)
0125 |         if uniq.size <= 3 and set(np.round(uniq, 3)).issubset({0.0, 1.0}):
0126 |             arr = (arr > 0.5).astype(np.float32)
0127 | 
0128 |         # Up/Downscale to model size
0129 |         x = torch.from_numpy(arr).permute(2, 0, 1).unsqueeze(0)  # (1,C,H,W)
0130 |         if x.shape[-2:] != (self.img_size, self.img_size):
0131 |             mode = (scorable.meta or {}).get("resize_method", "bilinear")
0132 |             x = torch.nn.functional.interpolate(x, size=(self.img_size, self.img_size),
0133 |                                                 mode=mode, align_corners=False if mode=="bilinear" else None)
0134 |         # Adapt channels (binary maps often 1-channel)
0135 |         if x.shape[1] == 1 and self.in_channels == 3:
0136 |             x = x.repeat(1, 3, 1, 1)
0137 |         if x.shape[1] != self.in_channels:
0138 |             # Last resort: project to expected channels
0139 |             if self.in_channels == 1:
0140 |                 x = x.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
0141 |             else:
0142 |                 x = x.repeat(1, self.in_channels // x.shape[1], 1, 1)[:, :self.in_channels]
0143 | 
0144 |         return x.clamp(0, 1)

0146 |     def _apply_importance(self, base: Dict[str, float], weights: Dict[str, float], order: List[str]) -> Dict[str, float]:
0147 |         """Apply per-dimension weights and (optional) order decay."""
0148 |         if not weights and not order:
0149 |             return base
0150 | 
0151 |         # Order decay: earlier dims in order list get multiplicative bonus
0152 |         decay = {}
0153 |         if order:
0154 |             # geometric decay (e.g., 1.0, 0.9, 0.81, ...)
0155 |             gamma = 0.9
0156 |             for i, d in enumerate(order):
0157 |                 decay[d] = gamma ** i
0158 | 
0159 |         adjusted = {}
0160 |         for d, s in base.items():
0161 |             w = weights.get(d, 1.0) * decay.get(d, 1.0)
0162 |             adjusted[d] = float(np.clip(s * w, 0.0, 1.0))
0163 |         return adjusted
0164 | 
0165 |     def _composite(self, adjusted: Dict[str, float], weights: Dict[str, float], order: List[str]) -> float:
0166 |         if not adjusted:
0167 |             return 0.5
0168 |         # Normalize weights (after order decay)
0169 |         w = {d: weights.get(d, 1.0) for d in adjusted}
0170 |         if order:
0171 |             gamma = 0.9
0172 |             for i, d in enumerate(order):
0173 |                 if d in w:
0174 |                     w[d] *= gamma ** i
0175 |         total = sum(w.values()) or 1.0
0176 |         return float(np.clip(sum(adjusted[d] * w[d] for d in adjusted) / total, 0.0, 1.0))
0177 | 
0178 |     def _rationale(self, dim: str, score: float) -> str:
0179 |         if dim == "clarity":
0180 |             return ("High" if score > 0.8 else "Moderate" if score > 0.6 else "Low") + " clarity pattern."
0181 |         if dim == "novelty":
0182 |             return ("Strongly novel" if score > 0.8 else "Some novelty" if score > 0.6 else "Familiar pattern.")
0183 |         if dim == "confidence":
0184 |             return ("Confident signal" if score > 0.8 else "Mixed certainty" if score > 0.6 else "Weak signal.")
0185 |         if dim == "contradiction":
0186 |             return ("Conflicts present" if score > 0.8 else "Some conflicts" if score > 0.6 else "Consistent signal.")
0187 |         return f"{dim.capitalize()} estimated."
0188 | 
0189 |     def _fallback(self, dimensions: List[str]) -> ScoreBundle:
0190 |         results = {d: ScoreResult(d, 0.5, "Fallback VPM score.", "vpm_transformer_fallback") for d in dimensions}
0191 |         return ScoreBundle(results=results)
0192 | 
0193 | 
0194 | def create_vpm_transformer_scorer(cfg, memory, container, logger):
0195 |     return VPMScorer(cfg, memory, container, logger)

0043 |         goal_weights = {
0044 |             "separability": scorable.meta.get("goal_separability", 1.0),
0045 |             "bridge_proxy": scorable.meta.get("goal_bridge_proxy", 0.0),
0046 |             "symmetry": scorable.meta.get("goal_symmetry", 0.0),
0047 |             "spectral_gap": scorable.meta.get("goal_spectral_gap", 0.0),
0048 |         }
0049 |         g = np.array([goal_weights["separability"], goal_weights["bridge_proxy"],
0050 |                       goal_weights["symmetry"], goal_weights["spectral_gap"]], dtype=np.float32)
0051 |         g_t = torch.from_numpy(g).unsqueeze(0).to(self.device)
0052 | 
0053 |         with torch.no_grad():
0054 |             op_logits, param_mean, _, value = self.model(vpm_t, g_t)
0055 | 
0056 |         op_idx = int(torch.argmax(op_logits, dim=1).item())
0057 |         params = param_mean[0].cpu().numpy().tolist()
0058 |         score = float(torch.sigmoid(value.squeeze()).item())
0059 | 
0060 |         # Return a compact bundle
0061 |         return ScoreBundle(results={
0062 |             "thought_value": ScoreResult("thought_value", score, "Predicted utility of the next visual step.", "vpm_thought"),
0063 |             "op_index":     ScoreResult("op_index", float(op_idx), "Argmax op type (0..K-1).", "vpm_thought",
0064 |                                         attributes={"params": params}),
0065 |         })

0015 | 
0016 | 
0017 | class VPMViTScorer(BaseScorer):
0018 |     """
0019 |     Inference wrapper for VPM-ViT.
0020 |     Expects either scorable.get_image_array() or scorable.meta['vpm_path'].
0021 |     """
0022 |     def __init__(self, cfg: Dict[str, Any], memory, container, logger=None):
0023 |         super().__init__(cfg, memory, container, logger)
0024 |         self.weights = cfg.get("weights_path", "models/vpm_vit_final.pth")
0025 |         ckpt = torch.load(self.weights, map_location="cpu")
0026 | 
0027 |         params = ckpt.get("config", {"in_ch": 1})
0028 |         self.dims = ckpt.get("dims", ["reasoning","knowledge","clarity","faithfulness","coverage"])
0029 |         self.risk_labels = ckpt.get("risk_labels", ["OK","WATCH","RISK"])
0030 | 
0031 |         self.model = VPMViT(**params)
0032 |         self.model.load_state_dict(ckpt["state_dict"], strict=True)
0033 |         self.model.eval()
0034 | 
0035 |         self.device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
0036 |         self.model.to(self.device)
0037 | 
0038 |     def _load_img(self, scorable: Scorable, in_ch: int) -> np.ndarray:
0039 |         arr = getattr(scorable, "get_image_array", lambda: None)()
0040 |         if arr is None:
0041 |             p = (scorable.meta or {}).get("vpm_path")
0042 |             if not p:
0043 |                 raise ValueError("VPMViTScorer requires image array or meta['vpm_path']")
0044 |             img = Image.open(p)
0045 |             if in_ch == 1:
0046 |                 img = img.convert("L")
0047 |                 arr = np.array(img, dtype=np.float32)[None, ...]
0048 |             else:
0049 |                 img = img.convert("RGB")
0050 |                 arr = np.transpose(np.array(img, dtype=np.float32), (2,0,1))
0051 |         if arr.ndim == 2:
0052 |             arr = arr[None, ...]
0053 |         if arr.max() > 1.0:
0054 |             arr = arr / 255.0
0055 |         if arr.shape[0] == 1 and self.model.patch_embed.proj.in_channels == 3:
0056 |             arr = np.repeat(arr, 3, axis=0)
0057 |         return arr.astype(np.float32)
0058 | 
0059 |     def _score_core(self, context: dict, scorable: Scorable, dimensions: List[str]) -> ScoreBundle:
0060 |         with torch.no_grad():
0061 |             x = torch.from_numpy(self._load_img(scorable, self.model.patch_embed.proj.in_channels)).unsqueeze(0)
0062 |             x = x.to(self.device)
0063 |             out = self.model(x, mask=None)
0064 |             reg = out.get("reg")
0065 |             cls = out.get("cls")
0066 | 
0067 |         results: Dict[str, ScoreResult] = {}
0068 |         if reg is not None:
0069 |             vec = reg.squeeze(0).cpu().numpy().tolist()
0070 |             for i, d in enumerate(self.dims):
0071 |                 if d in dimensions:
0072 |                     results[d] = ScoreResult(
0073 |                         dimension=d, score=float(np.clip(vec[i], 0.0, 1.0)),
0074 |                         rationale=f"VPM-ViT regression for {d}.",
0075 |                         source="vpm_vit"
0076 |                     )
0077 | 
0078 |         if cls is not None and ("risk" in dimensions or "risk_label" in dimensions):
0079 |             pred = int(cls.argmax(dim=-1).item())
0080 |             prob = torch.softmax(cls, dim=-1)[0, pred].item()
0081 |             results["risk"] = ScoreResult(
0082 |                 dimension="risk", score=float(prob),
0083 |                 rationale=f"Risk class={self.risk_labels[pred]} ({prob:.2f})",
0084 |                 source="vpm_vit",
0085 |                 attributes={"class_index": pred, "label": self.risk_labels[pred]},
0086 |             )
0087 | 
0088 |         # Optional overall
0089 |         if "vpm_overall" in dimensions:
0090 |             vals = [results[d].score for d in self.dims if d in results]
0091 |             overall = float(np.mean(vals)) if vals else 0.5
0092 |             results["vpm_overall"] = ScoreResult(
0093 |                 dimension="vpm_overall", score=overall,
0094 |                 rationale="Mean of regression targets.", source="vpm_vit"
0095 |             )
0096 | 
0097 |         return ScoreBundle(results=results)

```python
0001 | # stephanie/scoring/scorer/vpm_zero_scorer.py
0002 | from __future__ import annotations
0003 | 
0004 | import math
0005 | from typing import Any, Dict, List
0006 | 
0007 | import numpy as np
0008 | 
0009 | from stephanie.data.score_bundle import ScoreBundle
0010 | from stephanie.data.score_result import ScoreResult
0011 | from stephanie.scoring.scorable import Scorable
0012 | from stephanie.scoring.scorer.base_scorer import BaseScorer
0013 | from stephanie.scoring.vpm_scorable import VPMScorable
0014 | from stephanie.utils.similarity_utils import cosine
0015 | 
0016 | 
0017 | class ZeroScorer(BaseScorer):
0018 |     """
0019 |     VPM scorer that:
0020 |       - Respects metric order + per-metric weights (provided via VPMScorable)
0021 |       - Delegates image/timeline rendering to ZeroModelService (container)
0022 |       - Computes cognitive dimensions from the weighted vector and memory
0023 |     Config (example):
0024 |       dimensions: ["clarity","coherence","alignment","confidence","novelty","contradiction","complexity","vpm_overall"]
0025 |       dimension_weights:
0026 |         clarity: 1.25
0027 |         coherence: 1.15
0028 |         alignment: 1.10
0029 |         confidence: 1.00
0030 |       order_decay: 0.92          # position i weight = order_decay**i (if scorable doesn't supply)
0031 |       alignment_metrics: ["scm.alignment01","alignment","policy_align"]
0032 |       contradiction_pairs:
0033 |         - ["scm.consistency01","scm.uncertainty01"]
0034 |     """
0035 | 
0036 |     def __init__(self, cfg: Dict[str, Any], memory, container, logger=None):
0037 |         super().__init__(cfg, memory, container, logger)
0038 |         self.dimensions = cfg.get("dimensions", [
0039 |             "clarity","coherence","alignment","confidence","novelty","contradiction","complexity","vpm_overall"
0040 |         ])
0041 |         self.dim_w = {k: float(v) for k, v in (cfg.get("dimension_weights") or {}).items()}
0042 |         self.order_decay = float(cfg.get("order_decay", 1.0))
0043 |         self.align_keys = list(cfg.get("alignment_metrics", []) or [])
0044 |         self.contra_pairs = list(cfg.get("contradiction_pairs", []) or [])
0045 |         self.novelty_window = int(cfg.get("novelty_window", 20))
0046 |         self.max_ref_rows = int(cfg.get("max_ref_rows", 100))
0047 | 
0048 |     # --- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------
0049 |     @staticmethod
0050 |     def _safe01(x: float) -> float:
0051 |         return float(min(1.0, max(0.0, x)))
0052 | 
0053 |     @staticmethod
0054 |     def _entropy01(vec: np.ndarray) -> float:
0055 |         v = vec.astype(np.float64)
0056 |         v = np.clip(v, 1e-9, None)
0057 |         p = v / np.sum(v)
0058 |         H = -np.sum(p * np.log(p))
0059 |         Hmax = math.log(len(v) + 1e-9)
0060 |         return float(H / (Hmax + 1e-9))
0061 | 
0062 |     @staticmethod
0063 |     def _top_mass01(vec: np.ndarray, frac: float = 0.25) -> float:
0064 |         k = max(1, int(round(len(vec) * float(frac))))
0065 |         v = np.sort(vec)[::-1]
0066 |         top = float(np.sum(v[:k]))
0067 |         tot = float(np.sum(v) + 1e-9)
0068 |         return min(1.0, max(0.0, top / tot))
0069 | 
0070 |     def _alignment_score(self, names: List[str], vec: np.ndarray) -> float:
0071 |         if not self.align_keys:
0072 |             return float(np.mean(vec))
0073 |         idx = [i for i, n in enumerate(names) if any(key.lower() in n.lower() for key in self.align_keys)]
0074 |         if not idx:
0075 |             return float(np.mean(vec))
0076 |         return float(np.mean(vec[idx]))
0077 | 
0078 |     def _contradiction_score(self, names: List[str], vec: np.ndarray) -> float:
0079 |         # If pairs provided: high when paired dimensions diverge strongly
0080 |         if not self.contra_pairs:
0081 |             # fallback: contradiction ~ 1 - coherence
0082 |             return 0.0
0083 |         scores = []
0084 |         low = [n.lower() for n in names]
0085 |         for a_key, b_key in self.contra_pairs:
0086 |             try:
0087 |                 ia = next(i for i, n in enumerate(low) if a_key.lower() in n)
0088 |                 ib = next(i for i, n in enumerate(low) if b_key.lower() in n)
0089 |                 scores.append(abs(vec[ia] - vec[ib]))
0090 |             except StopIteration:
0091 |                 continue
0092 |         if not scores:
0093 |             return 0.0
0094 |         return float(np.clip(np.mean(scores), 0.0, 1.0))
0095 | 
0096 |     def _novelty_score(self, sc: VPMScorable, weighted_vec: np.ndarray) -> float:
0097 |         # Compare against recent history from memory.vpm_store
0098 |         if not hasattr(self.memory, "vpms"):
0099 |             return 0.5
0100 |         names, mat = self.memory.vpms.matrix_for_run(sc.run_id, n=min(self.max_ref_rows, self.novelty_window))
0101 |         if not mat:
0102 |             return 0.5
0103 |         # align to shared width
0104 |         mat = np.asarray(mat, dtype=np.float32)
0105 |         d = min(mat.shape[1], weighted_vec.size)
0106 |         R = mat[:, :d]
0107 |         v = weighted_vec[:d]
0108 |         sims = [cosine(v, R[i]) for i in range(R.shape[0])]
0109 |         # novelty ↑ when similarity ↓
0110 |         return float(np.clip(1.0 - np.mean(sims), 0.0, 1.0))
0111 | 
0112 |     # --- main ------------------------------------------------------------
0113 |     def score(self, context: dict, scorable: Scorable, dimensions: List[str]) -> ScoreBundle:
0114 |         if not isinstance(scorable, VPMScorable):
0115 |             # try to adapt common dict form
0116 |             m = getattr(scorable, "metadata", {}) or {}
0117 |             metric_names = m.get("metric_names") or []
0118 |             values = m.get("values") or []
0119 |             run_id = m.get("run_id") or "unknown"
0120 |             step = int(m.get("step") or 0)
0121 |             order_w = None
0122 |             metric_w = m.get("metric_weights")
0123 |             scorable = VPMScorable(
0124 |                 id=str(getattr(scorable, "id", "vpm")),
0125 |                 run_id=run_id,
0126 |                 step=step,
0127 |                 metric_names=metric_names,
0128 |                 values=values,
0129 |                 order_weights=order_w,
0130 |                 metric_weights=metric_w,
0131 |                 meta=m,
0132 |             )
0133 | 
0134 |         # If the scorable didn't provide order weights, synthesize from order_decay
0135 |         if (not scorable.order_weights.size) and self.order_decay not in (None, 1.0):
0136 |             ow = np.asarray([self.order_decay ** i for i in range(len(scorable.values))], dtype=np.float32)
0137 |             scorable.order_weights = ow
0138 | 
0139 |         # weighted & normalized vector
0140 |         wvec = scorable.get_metric_vector()
0141 |         names = scorable.get_names()
0142 | 
0143 |         # Dimension primitives
0144 |         entropy = self._entropy01(wvec)                 # 0..1 (high = complex/diffuse)
0145 |         clarity = self._top_mass01(wvec, 0.25)          # 0..1 (high = concentrated)
0146 |         confidence = float(np.mean(wvec))               # 0..1 (average intensity)
0147 |         coherence = float(1.0 - entropy)                # 0..1 (low entropy == coherent)
0148 |         alignment = self._alignment_score(names, wvec)  # 0..1
0149 |         novelty = self._novelty_score(scorable, wvec)   # 0..1
0150 |         contradiction = self._contradiction_score(names, wvec)  # 0..1
0151 |         complexity = float(entropy)                     # 0..1
0152 | 
0153 |         # Aggregate
0154 |         dims_all = {
0155 |             "clarity": clarity,
0156 |             "coherence": coherence,
0157 |             "alignment": alignment,
0158 |             "confidence": confidence,
0159 |             "novelty": novelty,
0160 |             "contradiction": contradiction,
0161 |             "complexity": complexity,
0162 |         }
0163 |         # overall as a weighted sum (only of requested dims if present)
0164 |         overall = 0.0
0165 |         wsum = 0.0
0166 |         for d, val in dims_all.items():
0167 |             if d in dimensions:
0168 |                 w = float(self.dim_w.get(d, 1.0))
0169 |                 overall += w * val
0170 |                 wsum += w
0171 |         vpm_overall = overall / (wsum + 1e-9)
0172 | 
0173 |         # results
0174 |         results: Dict[str, ScoreResult] = {}
0175 |         for d in dimensions:
0176 |             if d == "vpm_overall":
0177 |                 results[d] = ScoreResult(dimension=d, score=self._safe01(vpm_overall),
0178 |                                          rationale="Weighted aggregate over VPM dimensions (order-aware).",
0179 |                                          source="vpm_zero")
0180 |             elif d in dims_all:
0181 |                 results[d] = ScoreResult(dimension=d, score=self._safe01(dims_all[d]),
0182 |                                          rationale=f"{d} computed from weighted VPM vector.",
0183 |                                          source="vpm_zero")
0184 |             else:
0185 |                 results[d] = ScoreResult(dimension=d, score=0.5,
0186 |                                          rationale="Unknown dimension; neutral score.",
0187 |                                          source="vpm_zero")
0188 | 
0189 |         # Optional: kick ZeroModel to render/run side effects (no blocking needed)
0190 |         try:
0191 |             zm = self.container.get("zeromodel")
0192 |             if zm:  # best-effort — e.g., render summary once per run
0193 |                 # don’t render per row here; keep fast. You can hook timeline_finalize elsewhere.
0194 |                 _ = zm.health_check()
0195 |         except Exception:
0196 |             pass
0197 | 
0198 |         return ScoreBundle(results=results)
0199 | 
0200 | # factory for registry
0201 | def create_zero_scorer(cfg, memory, container, logger):
0202 |     return ZeroScorer(cfg, memory, container, logger)
```

0129 |     # ----------------------------- Dataloader (generic: ctx/output/score) -----------------------------
0130 |     def _create_dataloader(self, samples: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> DataLoader | None:

0170 |     def _calculate_policy_metrics(self, logits: List[float]) -> Tuple[float, float]:
0171 |         probs = F.softmax(torch.tensor(logits, dtype=torch.float32), dim=-1)
0172 |         entropy = float(-(probs * torch.log(probs + 1e-8)).sum())
0173 |         stability = float(probs.max())

0190 |     # ----------------------------- Numerics -----------------------------
0191 |     def _as_1d_list(self, x):
0192 |         if isinstance(x, torch.Tensor): return x.detach().cpu().view(-1).tolist()
0193 |         if isinstance(x, np.ndarray):

0195 |         if isinstance(x, (int, float)):
0196 |             return [x]
0197 |         try:
0198 |             return list(x)
0199 |         except Exception:
0200 |             return [x]

0202 |     def _as_np_1d(self, x):
0203 |         if isinstance(x, torch.Tensor):
0204 |             return x.detach().cpu().view(-1).numpy()
0205 |         if isinstance(x, np.ndarray):
0206 |             return x.reshape(-1)
0207 |         if isinstance(x, (list, tuple)):
0208 |             return np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float32).reshape(-1)
0209 |         return np.asarray([x], dtype=np.float32)

0211 |     def _spearmanr(self, a, b):
0212 |         a = np.asarray(a)
0213 |         b = np.asarray(b)
0214 |         ra = a.argsort().argsort().astype(np.float64)
0215 |         rb = b.argsort().argsort().astype(np.float64)
0216 |         ra = (ra - ra.mean()) / (ra.std() + 1e-9)
0217 |         rb = (rb - rb.mean()) / (rb.std() + 1e-9)
0218 |         return float(np.clip(np.mean(ra * rb), -1.0, 1.0))
0219 | 
0220 |     # ----------------------------- Metrics (reg + cls) -----------------------------
0221 |     def regression_metrics(self, preds, acts):
0222 |         preds_v = self._as_np_1d(preds)
0223 |         acts_v  = self._as_np_1d(acts)
0224 |         n = min(len(preds_v), len(acts_v))
0225 |         if n == 0:
0226 |             return dict(count=0, mae=math.nan, mse=math.nan, rmse=math.nan, r2=math.nan,
0227 |                         pearson_r=math.nan, spearman_rho=math.nan,
0228 |                         within1=math.nan, within2=math.nan, within5=math.nan,
0229 |                         pred_mean=math.nan, pred_std=math.nan)
0230 | 
0231 |         p = preds_v[:n].astype(np.float64)
0232 |         y = acts_v[:n].astype(np.float64)
0233 |         d = p - y
0234 | 
0235 |         mae = float(np.mean(np.abs(d)))
0236 |         mse = float(np.mean(d*d))
0237 |         rmse = float(np.sqrt(mse))
0238 |         var = float(np.var(y))
0239 |         r2 = float(1.0 - (np.sum(d**2) / (np.sum((y - y.mean())**2) + 1e-9))) if var > 1e-12 else float("nan")
0240 |         pearson = float(np.corrcoef(p, y)[0,1]) if (np.std(p) > 1e-12 and np.std(y) > 1e-12) else float("nan")
0241 |         spearman = self._spearmanr(p, y)
0242 | 
0243 |         # --- auto-scale within deltas ---
0244 |         vmax = float(max(np.max(np.abs(p)), np.max(np.abs(y))))
0245 |         if vmax <= 1.5:
0246 |             d1, d2, d5 = 0.01, 0.02, 0.05  # 1/2/5 percentage points in 0..1
0247 |         else:
0248 |             d1, d2, d5 = 1.0, 2.0, 5.0     # original 0..100 behavior
0249 | 
0250 |         within1 = float(np.mean(np.abs(d) <= d1))
0251 |         within2 = float(np.mean(np.abs(d) <= d2))
0252 |         within5 = float(np.mean(np.abs(d) <= d5))
0253 | 
0254 |         return dict(count=int(n), mae=mae, mse=mse, rmse=rmse, r2=r2,
0255 |                     pearson_r=pearson, spearman_rho=spearman,
0256 |                     within1=within1, within2=within2, within5=within5,
0257 |                     pred_mean=float(np.mean(p)), pred_std=float(np.std(p)))
0258 | 
0259 |     @torch.no_grad()
0260 |     def collect_preds_targets(self, model, dataloader, device, head: str = "q", apply_sigmoid: bool = False):
0261 |         """
0262 |         Works with:
0263 |         - SICQL-style: (ctx, doc, y)  -> model(ctx, doc)[head]
0264 |         - MRQ-style:   (X, y, w?)     -> model.predictor(X)
0265 |         - MRQ pairs 2-tuple: (X, y)   -> model.predictor(X)
0266 |         """
0267 |         preds_all, acts_all = [], []
0268 |         model.eval()
0269 |         for batch in dataloader:
0270 |             # Unpack defensively
0271 |             if len(batch) == 3:
0272 |                 a, b, c = batch
0273 |                 # Heuristic: MRQ triple if model has predictor AND first elem looks like a feature matrix
0274 |                 if hasattr(model, "predictor") and isinstance(a, torch.Tensor) and a.dim() >= 2:
0275 |                     X, y = a.to(device), b.to(device)
0276 |                     out = model.predictor(X)
0277 |                     p = out.view(-1).detach().cpu().numpy()
0278 |                     a_np = y.view(-1).detach().cpu().numpy()
0279 |                 else:
0280 |                     # SICQL triple: (ctx, doc, y)
0281 |                     ctx, doc, y = a.to(device), b.to(device), c.to(device)
0282 |                     outs = model(ctx, doc)
0283 |                     # prefer 'q_value' head, else first value
0284 |                     if isinstance(outs, dict):
0285 |                         out = outs.get("q_value", next(iter(outs.values())))
0286 |                     else:
0287 |                         out = outs
0288 |                     p = out.view(-1).detach().cpu().numpy()
0289 |                     a_np = y.view(-1).detach().cpu().numpy()
0290 | 
0291 |             elif len(batch) == 2:
0292 |                 # MRQ pair: (X, y)
0293 |                 X, y = batch
0294 |                 X, y = X.to(device), y.to(device)
0295 |                 if hasattr(model, "predictor"):
0296 |                     out = model.predictor(X)
0297 |                 else:
0298 |                     out = X.sum(dim=-1)
0299 |                 p = out.view(-1).detach().cpu().numpy()
0300 |                 a_np = y.view(-1).detach().cpu().numpy()
0301 | 
0302 |             else:
0303 |                 # Fallback: try to handle like MRQ features
0304 |                 X = batch[0].to(device)
0305 |                 out = model.predictor(X) if hasattr(model, "predictor") else X.sum(dim=-1)
0306 |                 p = out.view(-1).detach().cpu().numpy()
0307 |                 a_np = batch[1].to(device).view(-1).detach().cpu().numpy()
0308 | 
0309 |             # Optionally map logits → probabilities
0310 |             if apply_sigmoid:
0311 |                 p = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-np.clip(p, -50.0, 50.0)))
0312 |             preds_all.append(p)
0313 |             acts_all.append(a_np)
0314 | 
0315 |         if not preds_all:
0316 |             return np.array([]), np.array([])
0317 | 
0318 |         return np.concatenate(preds_all, axis=0), np.concatenate(acts_all, axis=0)
0319 | 
0320 |     @torch.no_grad()
0321 |     def binary_cls_metrics(self, dataloader, forward_fn):
0322 |         Ls, Ys = [], []
0323 |         for batch in dataloader:
0324 |             if len(batch) == 3:
0325 |                 X, y, _ = batch
0326 |             else:
0327 |                 X, y    = batch
0328 |             logits = forward_fn(X).view(-1).detach().cpu().numpy()
0329 |             Ls.append(logits)
0330 |             Ys.append(y.view(-1).detach().cpu().numpy().astype(np.float32))
0331 |         if not Ls:
0332 |             return {"pair_acc": float("nan"), "auc": float("nan"), "logloss": float("nan"), "pos_rate": float("nan")}
0333 |         L = np.concatenate(Ls)
0334 |         Y = np.concatenate(Ys)
0335 |         pair_acc = float(((L > 0).astype(np.float32) == Y).mean())
0336 |         pos_rate = float((L > 0).mean())
0337 |         # rank-based AUC (safe)
0338 |         try:
0339 |             order = np.argsort(L)
0340 |             ranks = np.empty_like(order)
0341 |             ranks[order] = np.arange(len(L))
0342 |             pos = (Y == 1).astype(np.float64)
0343 |             neg = 1.0 - pos
0344 |             n_pos, n_neg = pos.sum(), neg.sum()
0345 |             auc = float(((ranks[pos == 1]).sum() - n_pos*(n_pos-1)/2) / max(n_pos*n_neg, 1.0)) if n_pos>0 and n_neg>0 else float("nan")
0346 |         except Exception:
0347 |             auc = float("nan")
0348 |         # logloss
0349 |         P = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-L))
0350 |         eps = 1e-7
0351 |         logloss = float(-np.mean(Y*np.log(P+eps) + (1-Y)*np.log(1-P+eps)))
0352 |         return {"pair_acc": pair_acc, "auc": auc, "logloss": logloss, "pos_rate": pos_rate}
0353 | 
0354 |     # ----------------------------- Early stopping / priors -----------------------------
0355 |     def early_stop_update(self, best, current, patience, min_delta):
0356 |         if current < best - min_delta:
0357 |             return current, 0, False
0358 |         patience += 1
0359 |         return best, patience, patience >= self.early_stopping_patience
0360 | 
0361 |     def init_pos_weight_and_bias(self, dataloader, out_layer, clamp=(0.2, 5.0)):
0362 |         ys = []
0363 |         for batch in dataloader:
0364 |             if len(batch) == 3:
0365 |                 _, y, _ = batch
0366 |             elif len(batch) == 2:
0367 |                 _, y = batch
0368 |             else:
0369 |                 continue
0370 |             ys.append(y.detach().cpu().view(-1))
0371 |         y_all = torch.cat(ys) if ys else torch.tensor([])
0372 |         p_pos = float((y_all > 0.5).float().mean()) if y_all.numel() > 0 else 0.5
0373 |         eps = 1e-6
0374 |         pos_weight = float((1.0 - p_pos) / max(p_pos, eps))
0375 |         pos_weight = float(min(max(pos_weight, clamp[0]), clamp[1]))
0376 |         self.pos_weight_tensor = torch.tensor(pos_weight, device=self.device)
0377 |         try:
0378 |             prior_logit = math.log(p_pos / max(1.0 - p_pos, eps))
0379 |             if hasattr(out_layer, "bias") and out_layer.bias is not None:
0380 |                 with torch.no_grad():
0381 |                     out_layer.bias.fill_(prior_logit)
0382 |         except Exception:
0383 |             pass
0384 |         return p_pos, pos_weight

0420 |         pearson = float(np.corrcoef(preds_v, acts_v)[0, 1]) if (np.std(preds_v) > 1e-12 and np.std(acts_v) > 1e-12) else float("nan")
0421 |         spearman = self._spearmanr(preds_v, acts_v)

0425 | 
0426 |         lc_head = [float(x) for x in (losses[:5] if losses else [])]

0451 |

0001 | # stephanie/trainers/contrastive_knowledge_trainer.py
0002 | from __future__ import annotations
0003 | 
0004 | import torch
0005 | import torch.nn as nn
0006 | import torch.optim as optim
0007 | from torch.utils.data import Dataset
0008 | 
0009 | 
0010 | class KnowledgePairDataset(Dataset):
0011 |     """
0012 |     Builds pairs of (turn_a, turn_b) where turn_a is more 'knowledgeable' than turn_b.
0013 |     """
0014 |     def __init__(self, cases, tokenizer, max_len=512):
0015 |         self.pairs = []
0016 |         for i in range(len(cases)):
0017 |             for j in range(len(cases)):
0018 |                 if cases[i]["stars"] > cases[j]["stars"]:
0019 |                     self.pairs.append((cases[i], cases[j]))
0020 |         self.tokenizer = tokenizer
0021 |         self.max_len = max_len
0022 | 
0023 |     def __len__(self):
0024 |         return len(self.pairs)
0025 | 
0026 |     def __getitem__(self, idx):
0027 |         case_a, case_b = self.pairs[idx]
0028 |         a_enc = self.tokenizer(case_a["text"], truncation=True, max_length=self.max_len, return_tensors="pt")
0029 |         b_enc = self.tokenizer(case_b["text"], truncation=True, max_length=self.max_len, return_tensors="pt")
0030 |         return a_enc, b_enc, 1.0  # label always 1: a > b
0031 | 
0032 | 
0033 | class ContrastiveKnowledgeModel(nn.Module):
0034 |     def __init__(self, encoder, hidden_dim=256):
0035 |         super().__init__()
0036 |         self.encoder = encoder  # e.g., transformer encoder
0037 |         self.fc = nn.Linear(encoder.config.hidden_size, 1)
0038 | 
0039 |     def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask):
0040 |         outputs = self.encoder(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask)
0041 |         pooled = outputs.last_hidden_state[:, 0]  # [CLS] token
0042 |         return self.fc(pooled)
0043 | 
0044 | 
0045 | class ContrastiveTrainer:
0046 |     def __init__(self, model, lr=1e-5):
0047 |         self.model = model
0048 |         self.optimizer = optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=lr)
0049 |         self.criterion = nn.MarginRankingLoss(margin=0.5)
0050 | 
0051 |     def train(self, dataloader, epochs=3, device="cuda"):
0052 |         self.model.to(device)
0053 |         for epoch in range(epochs):
0054 |             for batch in dataloader:
0055 |                 (a_enc, b_enc, label) = batch
0056 |                 a_enc = {k: v.squeeze(0).to(device) for k, v in a_enc.items()}
0057 |                 b_enc = {k: v.squeeze(0).to(device) for k, v in b_enc.items()}
0058 |                 label = torch.tensor([1.0], device=device)  # a > b
0059 | 
0060 |                 score_a = self.model(**a_enc)
0061 |                 score_b = self.model(**b_enc)
0062 | 
0063 |                 loss = self.criterion(score_a, score_b, label)
0064 |                 self.optimizer.zero_grad()
0065 |                 loss.backward()
0066 |                 self.optimizer.step()
0067 | 
0068 |             print(f"Epoch {epoch}: Loss {loss.item()}")

0011 |     def __init__(self, cfg, memory, container, logger):
0012 |         super().__init__(cfg, memory, container, logger)
0013 |         self.model_type = "ebt"
0014 |         self.num_actions = 3 #cfg.get("num_actions", 3)

0016 |     def train(self, samples, dimension):

0018 |         if not dl:
0019 |             return {"error": f"Insufficient samples for {dimension}"}

0021 |         from torch import nn
0022 |         from torch.optim.lr_scheduler import ReduceLROnPlateau

0025 | 
0026 |         model = EBTModel(self.dim, self.hdim, self.num_actions, self.device).to(self.device)
0027 |         model.train()
0028 | 
0029 |         optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=self.cfg.get("lr", 2e-5))
0030 |         scheduler = ReduceLROnPlateau(optimizer, mode="min", factor=0.5, patience=2)
0031 | 
0032 |         mse = nn.MSELoss()
0033 | 
0034 |         def expectile_loss(diff, tau=0.7):
0035 |             return (torch.where(diff > 0, tau * diff.pow(2), (1 - tau) * diff.pow(2))).mean()
0036 | 
0037 |         q_losses, v_losses, pi_losses, entropies = [], [], [], []
0038 | 
0039 |         for epoch in range(self.cfg.get("epochs", 10)):

0047 |                 adv = (outputs["q_value"] - outputs["state_value"]).detach()

0051 |                 pi_loss = -(torch.log(policy_probs) * adv).mean() - 0.01 * entropy

0053 |                 loss = q_loss * self.cfg.get("q_weight", 1.0) + \
0054 |                        v_loss * self.cfg.get("v_weight", 0.5) + \
0055 |                        pi_loss * self.cfg.get("pi_weight", 0.3)

0057 |                 optimizer.zero_grad()
0058 |                 loss.backward()
0059 |                 optimizer.step()

0061 |                 total_q += q_loss.item()
0062 |                 total_v += v_loss.item()
0063 |                 total_pi += pi_loss.item()
0064 |                 entropies.append(entropy.item())

0066 |             avg_q = total_q / len(dl)
0067 |             avg_v = total_v / len(dl)
0068 |             avg_pi = total_pi / len(dl)

0089 |             "pi_loss": pi_losses[-1],

0093 |     def _save_model(self, model, dimension):

0216 |     def _create_dataloader(self, samples, dimension):
0217 |         """
0218 |         Accepts either:
0219 |         • singleton: {"title": str, "output": str, "score": float}
0220 |         • pairwise : {"title": str, "output_a": str, "output_b": str,
0221 |                         "value_a": float, "value_b": float}
0222 |         • HRM/raw  : {"goal_text": str, "scorable_text": str, "target_score" or "score": float}
0223 | 
0224 |         Builds a TensorDataset of (x_concat, y_norm) where:
0225 |         x_concat = concat([ctx_emb, doc_emb])  # shape [2*D]
0226 |         y_norm   = normalized target in [0,1], shape [1]
0227 |         Uses robust percentiles (p_lo..p_hi) for stability.
0228 |         """
0229 |         # ---- collect raw (goal, doc, value) triples ----
0230 |         triples = []      # (goal_text, doc_text, value)
0231 |         kept, skipped = 0, 0
0232 | 
0233 |         def _maybe_push(title, out, val):
0234 |             nonlocal kept, skipped
0235 |             if title and out and (val is not None):
0236 |                 try:
0237 |                     triples.append((title, out, float(val)))
0238 |                     kept += 1
0239 |                 except Exception:
0240 |                     skipped += 1
0241 |             else:
0242 |                 skipped += 1
0243 | 
0244 |         for s in self.progress(samples, desc="Packing HRM triples"):
0245 |             # normalize keys across MRQ/SICQL/HRM shapes
0246 |             title = (s.get("goal_text") or s.get("title") or "").strip()
0247 |             # singleton path
0248 |             if "output" in s and ("score" in s or "target_score" in s):
0249 |                 out = (s.get("scorable_text") or s.get("output") or "").strip()
0250 |                 val = s.get("target_score", s.get("score", None))
0251 |                 _maybe_push(title, out, val)
0252 |                 continue
0253 |             # pairwise path
0254 |             if all(k in s for k in ("output_a", "output_b", "value_a", "value_b")):
0255 |                 a_out = (s.get("output_a") or "").strip()
0256 |                 b_out = (s.get("output_b") or "").strip()
0257 |                 a_val = s.get("value_a", None)
0258 |                 b_val = s.get("value_b", None)
0259 |                 if a_out or b_out:
0260 |                     if a_out and (a_val is not None):
0261 |                         _maybe_push(title, a_out, a_val)
0262 |                     if b_out and (b_val is not None):
0263 |                         _maybe_push(title, b_out, b_val)
0264 |                 else:
0265 |                     skipped += 1
0266 |                 continue
0267 |             # explicit HRM/raw path
0268 |             if ("goal_text" in s and "scorable_text" in s and
0269 |                 ("target_score" in s or "score" in s)):
0270 |                 out = (s.get("scorable_text") or "").strip()
0271 |                 val = s.get("target_score", s.get("score"))
0272 |                 _maybe_push(title, out, val)
0273 |                 continue
0274 |             # otherwise unrecognized
0275 |             skipped += 1
0276 | 
0277 |         if kept < self.min_samples:
0278 |             self.logger.log("HRMDataError", {
0279 |                 "message": f"Insufficient samples after parsing: kept={kept}, skipped={skipped}",
0280 |                 "kept": kept, "skipped": skipped, "threshold": self.min_samples
0281 |             })
0282 |             return None
0283 | 
0284 |         # ---- robust scaling over raw targets ----
0285 |         raw_vals = [v for _, _, v in triples]
0286 |         lo = float(np.percentile(raw_vals, self.scaler_p_lo)) if raw_vals else 0.0
0287 |         hi = float(np.percentile(raw_vals, self.scaler_p_hi)) if raw_vals else 1.0
0288 |         if hi - lo < 1e-9:
0289 |             hi = lo + 1.0
0290 | 
0291 |         self._scaler_stats[dimension] = {"lo": lo, "hi": hi}
0292 |         self.logger.log("HRMTargetScaling", {
0293 |             "dimension": dimension, "p_lo": self.scaler_p_lo, "p_hi": self.scaler_p_hi,
0294 |             "lo": lo, "hi": hi, "n": len(raw_vals)
0295 |         })
0296 | 
0297 |         def _norm(v: float) -> float:
0298 |             x = (v - lo) / (hi - lo)
0299 |             return 0.0 if x < 0.0 else 1.0 if x > 1.0 else float(x)
0300 | 
0301 |         # ---- encode & pack tensors ----
0302 |         xs, ys = [], []
0303 |         for goal_text, doc_text, value in triples:
0304 |             try:
0305 |                 ctx = torch.tensor(self.memory.embedding.get_or_create(goal_text),
0306 |                                 dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device)
0307 |                 doc = torch.tensor(self.memory.embedding.get_or_create(doc_text),
0308 |                                 dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device)
0309 |                 x = torch.cat([ctx, doc], dim=-1)                 # [2*D]
0310 |                 y = torch.tensor([_norm(value)], dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device)  # [1]
0311 |                 xs.append(x)
0312 |                 ys.append(y)
0313 |             except Exception as e:

0316 | 
0317 |         if len(xs) < self.min_samples:

0319 |                 "message": f"Insufficient valid encoded samples: {len(xs)} < {self.min_samples}",
0320 |                 "after_encoding_kept": len(xs), "skipped_total": skipped
0321 |             })
0322 |             return None
0323 | 
0324 |         X = torch.stack(xs)      # [N, 2*D]
0325 |         Y = torch.stack(ys)      # [N, 1]
0326 |         dataset = TensorDataset(X, Y)
0327 |         loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=self.batch_size, shuffle=True)
0328 | 
0329 |         log.info("HRMDataLoaderCreated dimension %s num_samples %d num_batches %d kept %d skipped %d",
0330 |             dimension,
0331 |             len(dataset),
0332 |             len(loader),
0333 |             kept, skipped
0334 |         )
0335 |         return loader

0351 |                 "lr": self.lr, "epochs": self.epochs, "batch_size": self.batch_size,
0352 |                 "dim": self.dim, "hdim": self.hdim,
0353 |                 "h_dim": self.h_dim, "l_dim": self.l_dim,
0354 |                 "n_cycles": self.n_cycles, "t_steps": self.t_steps,

0362 |     def _grad_global_norm(self) -> float:
0363 |         num, den = 0.0, 0.0
