0025 |     margin: float = 0.2,
0026 | ) -> torch.Tensor:
0027 |     """DPO-lite loss: -log σ(β*(Δ - m)) implemented as softplus(-β*(Δ - m))"""
0028 |     return F.softplus(-(beta * (s_pos - s_neg - margin))).mean()
0029 | 
0030 | 
0031 | def _l2(x: torch.Tensor, eps: float = 1e-12) -> torch.Tensor:
0032 |     """L2 normalize tensor"""
0033 |     n = x.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
0034 |     return x / (n + eps)
0035 | 
0036 | 
0037 | class KnowledgeTrainer(BaseTrainer):
0038 |     """
0039 |     Pairwise trainer for the 'knowledge' dimension with dual-head architecture:
0040 |     - Human head: trained on human star ratings (-5..+5)
0041 |     - AI head: trained on AI scores (0..100) with calibration
0042 | 
0043 |     Supports:
0044 |     - Contrastive DPO-lite training
0045 |     - AI score calibration to match human judgment
0046 |     - Alignment loss between heads
0047 |     - Proper metrics tracking
0048 |     """
0049 | 
0050 |     def __init__(self, cfg, memory, container, logger):
0051 |         super().__init__(cfg, memory, container, logger)
0052 | 
0053 |         # Configuration
0054 |         self.model_type = "knowledge"
0055 |         self.epochs = cfg.get("epochs", 30)
0056 |         self.lr = cfg.get("lr", 1e-4)
0057 |         self.batch_size = cfg.get("batch_size", 4)
0058 |         self.min_samples = cfg.get("min_samples", 16)
0059 |         self.use_tuner = cfg.get("use_tuner", True)
0060 |         self.use_early_stopping = cfg.get("early_stopping", True)
0061 |         self.early_stopping_patience = cfg.get("patience", 3)
0062 |         self.early_stopping_min_delta = cfg.get("min_delta", 1e-4)
0063 |         self.beta = cfg.get("beta", 2.0)
0064 |         self.margin = cfg.get("margin", 0.2)
0065 |         self.ai_pair_weight = cfg.get("ai_pair_weight", 0.35)
0066 |         self.align_lambda = cfg.get("align_lambda", 0.05)
0067 |         self.hrm_weight = cfg.get("hrm_weight", 0.1)
0068 |         self.min_figure_score = cfg.get("min_figure_score", 0.8)
0069 | 
0070 |         # Auxiliary features (must match pair builder output)
0071 |         self.aux_features = cfg.get(
0072 |             "aux_features",
0073 |             [
0074 |                 "human_stars",
0075 |                 "pseudo_stars",
0076 |                 "artifact_quality",
0077 |                 "turn_pos_ratio",
0078 |                 "has_retrieval",
0079 |                 "retrieval_fidelity",
0080 |                 "text_len_norm",
0081 |             ],
0082 |         )
0083 | 
0084 |         # Initialize model
0085 |         self.model = KnowledgeModel(
0086 |             dim=self.dim,
0087 |             hdim=self.hdim,
0088 |             embedding_store=self.memory.embedding,
0089 |             aux_feature_names=self.aux_features,
0090 |             device=str(self.device),
0091 |         )
0092 | 
0093 |         # Initialize calibrator
0094 |         self.calibrator = ScoreCalibrator()
0095 |         self._load_calibrator()
0096 | 
0097 |         # Logging
0098 |         self.logger.log(
0099 |             "KnowledgeTrainerInitialized",
0100 |             {
0101 |                 "embedding_type": self.embedding_type,
0102 |                 "device": str(self.device),
0103 |                 "aux_features": self.aux_features,
0104 |                 "ai_pair_weight": self.ai_pair_weight,
0105 |                 "align_lambda": self.align_lambda,
0106 |             },
0107 |         )
0108 | 
0109 |     # --- dataloader helpers ---
0110 |     def _aux_vec(self, meta: dict) -> torch.Tensor:
0111 |         """Convert meta dict to tensor for auxiliary features"""
0112 |         vals = []
0113 |         for n in self.aux_features:
0114 |             try:
0115 |                 vals.append(float(meta.get(n, 0.0)))
0116 |             except Exception:
0117 |                 vals.append(0.0)
0118 |         return torch.tensor(vals, device=self.device, dtype=torch.float32)
0119 | 
0120 |     def _pairs_to_dataset(self, pairs):
0121 |         """Convert pairs to TensorDataset"""
0122 |         G, A, B, AUXA, AUXB, S, W = [], [], [], [], [], [], []
0123 | 
0124 |         for p in pairs:
0125 |             goal = p.get("prompt") or p.get("goal_text") or ""
0126 |             oa, ob = p.get("output_a", ""), p.get("output_b", "")
0127 |             ma, mb = p.get("meta_a", {}) or {}, p.get("meta_b", {}) or {}
0128 |             label_source = p.get("label_source", "human")
0129 |             pair_weight = p.get("pair_weight", 1.0)
0130 | 
0131 |             if not (goal and oa and ob):
0132 |                 continue
0133 | 
0134 |             try:
0135 |                 # Get embeddings (L2 normalized)
0136 |                 ge = torch.tensor(
0137 |                     self.memory.embedding.get_or_create(goal),
0138 |                     device=self.device,
0139 |                     dtype=torch.float32,
0140 |                 )
0141 |                 ea = torch.tensor(
0142 |                     self.memory.embedding.get_or_create(oa),
0143 |                     device=self.device,
0144 |                     dtype=torch.float32,
0145 |                 )
0146 |                 eb = torch.tensor(
0147 |                     self.memory.embedding.get_or_create(ob),
0148 |                     device=self.device,
0149 |                     dtype=torch.float32,
0150 |                 )
0151 |                 ge, ea, eb = _l2(ge), _l2(ea), _l2(eb)
0152 | 
0153 |                 # Auxiliary features
0154 |                 auxa = self._aux_vec(ma)
0155 |                 auxb = self._aux_vec(mb)
0156 | 
0157 |                 # Label source and weight
0158 |                 source = 1.0 if label_source == "human" else 0.0
0159 |                 weight = pair_weight
0160 | 
0161 |                 G.append(ge)
0162 |                 A.append(ea)
0163 |                 B.append(eb)
0164 |                 AUXA.append(auxa)
0165 |                 AUXB.append(auxb)
0166 |                 S.append(source)
0167 |                 W.append(weight)
0168 | 
0169 |             except Exception as e:
0170 |                 self.logger.log("KnowledgePairPrepError", {"error": str(e)})
0171 |                 continue
0172 | 
0173 |         if len(G) < self.min_samples:
0174 |             self.logger.log(
0175 |                 "InsufficientSamples",
0176 |                 {"sample_count": len(G), "threshold": self.min_samples},
0177 |             )
0178 |             return None
0179 | 
0180 |         ds = TensorDataset(
0181 |             torch.stack(G),
0182 |             torch.stack(A),
0183 |             torch.stack(B),
0184 |             torch.stack(AUXA),
0185 |             torch.stack(AUXB),
0186 |             torch.tensor(S, device=self.device, dtype=torch.float32),
0187 |             torch.tensor(W, device=self.device, dtype=torch.float32),
0188 |         )
0189 |         return ds
0190 | 
0191 |     def _create_dataloaders(self, pairs):
0192 |         """Split pairs into train/validation dataloaders"""
0193 |         ds = self._pairs_to_dataset(pairs)
0194 |         if ds is None:
0195 |             return None, None
0196 | 
0197 |         n_total = len(ds)
0198 |         n_val = max(int(0.1 * n_total), 1)
0199 |         n_train = max(n_total - n_val, 1)
0200 | 
0201 |         train_ds, val_ds = random_split(ds, [n_train, n_val])
0202 | 
0203 |         train_dl = DataLoader(
0204 |             train_ds, batch_size=self.batch_size, shuffle=True
0205 |         )
0206 |         val_dl = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=self.batch_size, shuffle=False)
0207 | 
0208 |         return train_dl, val_dl
0209 | 
0210 |     # --- metrics & evaluation ---
0211 |     @torch.no_grad()
0212 |     def _pair_acc(self, dl, head: str = "human") -> float:
0213 |         """Calculate pairwise accuracy for a specific head"""
0214 |         if dl is None:
0215 |             return float("nan")
0216 | 
0217 |         self.model.eval()
0218 |         correct, total = 0, 0
0219 | 
0220 |         for G, A, B, AUXA, AUXB, _, _ in dl:
0221 |             # Encode
0222 |             z_a = self.model.encoder(G, A)
0223 |             z_b = self.model.encoder(G, B)
0224 |             z_a = self.model.aux_proj(z_a, AUXA)
0225 |             z_b = self.model.aux_proj(z_b, AUXB)
0226 | 
0227 |             # Score with correct head
0228 |             if head == "human":
0229 |                 s_a = self.model.score_h(z_a)
0230 |                 s_b = self.model.score_h(z_b)
0231 |             else:  # "ai"
0232 |                 s_a = self.model.score_a(z_a)
0233 |                 s_b = self.model.score_a(z_b)
0234 | 
0235 |             # Count correct predictions
0236 |             correct += (s_a > s_b).sum().item()
0237 |             total += s_a.size(0)
0238 | 
0239 |         return (correct / total) if total else float("nan")
0240 | 
0241 |     @torch.no_grad()
0242 |     def _alignment_mse(self, dl) -> float:
0243 |         """Calculate MSE between human and AI heads on the same pairs"""
0244 |         if dl is None:
0245 |             return float("nan")
0246 | 
0247 |         self.model.eval()
0248 |         total_mse = 0.0
0249 |         count = 0
0250 | 
0251 |         for G, A, B, AUXA, AUXB, _, _ in dl:
0252 |             # Encode once
0253 |             z_a = self.model.encoder(G, A)
0254 |             z_b = self.model.encoder(G, B)
0255 |             z_a = self.model.aux_proj(z_a, AUXA)
0256 |             z_b = self.model.aux_proj(z_b, AUXB)
0257 | 
0258 |             # Get scores from both heads
0259 |             s_h_a = self.model.score_h(z_a)
0260 |             s_h_b = self.model.score_h(z_b)
0261 |             s_a_a = self.model.score_a(z_a)
0262 |             s_a_b = self.model.score_a(z_b)
0263 | 
0264 |             # Calculate MSE of relative scores
0265 |             diff_h = s_h_a - s_h_b
0266 |             diff_a = s_a_a - s_a_b
0267 |             mse = F.mse_loss(diff_h, diff_a)
0268 | 
0269 |             total_mse += mse.item()
0270 |             count += 1
0271 | 
0272 |         return total_mse / count if count > 0 else float("nan")
0273 | 
0274 |     @torch.no_grad()
0275 |     def _disagreement_rate(self, dl) -> float:
0276 |         """Rate at which human and AI heads disagree on pair ordering (elementwise across the batch)."""
0277 |         if dl is None:
0278 |             return float("nan")
0279 | 
0280 |         self.model.eval()
0281 |         disagreements = 0
0282 |         total = 0
0283 | 
0284 |         for G, A, B, AUXA, AUXB, _, _ in dl:
0285 |             # Encode once
0286 |             z_a = self.model.encoder(G, A)
0287 |             z_b = self.model.encoder(G, B)
0288 |             z_a = self.model.aux_proj(z_a, AUXA)
0289 |             z_b = self.model.aux_proj(z_b, AUXB)
0290 | 
0291 |             # Scores from both heads (shape: [batch] or [batch,1])
0292 |             s_h_a = self.model.score_h(z_a)
0293 |             s_h_b = self.model.score_h(z_b)
0294 |             s_a_a = self.model.score_a(z_a)
0295 |             s_a_b = self.model.score_a(z_b)
0296 | 
0297 |             # Elementwise order comparisons -> boolean vectors
0298 |             h_order = (s_h_a > s_h_b).view(-1)
0299 |             a_order = (s_a_a > s_a_b).view(-1)
0300 | 
0301 |             # Count disagreements elementwise
0302 |             disagreements += (h_order != a_order).sum().item()
0303 |             total += h_order.numel()
0304 | 
0305 |         return disagreements / total if total > 0 else float("nan")
0306 | 
0307 |     # --- training ---
0308 |     def _train_epoch(self, dl):
0309 |         self.model.train()
0310 |         opt = self.optimizer
0311 |         tot_loss, n_batches = 0.0, 0
0312 | 
0313 |         for G, A, B, AUXA, AUXB, source, weight in dl:
0314 |             z_a = self.model.encoder(G, A)
0315 |             z_b = self.model.encoder(G, B)
0316 |             z_a = self.model.aux_proj(z_a, AUXA)
0317 |             z_b = self.model.aux_proj(z_b, AUXB)
0318 | 
0319 |             s_h_a = self.model.score_h(z_a)
0320 |             s_h_b = self.model.score_h(z_b)
0321 |             s_a_a = self.model.score_a(z_a)
0322 |             s_a_b = self.model.score_a(z_b)
0323 | 
0324 |             # per-sample losses
0325 |             lh = dpo_lite_loss_per_sample(s_h_a, s_h_b, beta=self.beta, margin=self.margin)
0326 |             la = dpo_lite_loss_per_sample(s_a_a, s_a_b, beta=self.beta, margin=self.margin)
0327 | 
0328 |             # weights
0329 |             is_human = (source > 0.5).float()           # (batch,)
0330 |             human_w  = weight * is_human                # (batch,)
0331 |             ai_w     = weight * (1.0 - is_human)        # (batch,)
0332 | 
0333 |             # alignment + small reg (unweighted global)
0334 |             align = F.mse_loss(s_h_a - s_h_b, s_a_a - s_a_b)
0335 |             reg   = 1e-4 * (s_h_a.square().mean() + s_h_b.square().mean()
0336 |                             + s_a_a.square().mean() + s_a_b.square().mean())
0337 | 
0338 |             # combine with sample weights
0339 |             loss = ( (lh * human_w).sum() / (human_w.sum() + 1e-8)
0340 |                 + self.ai_pair_weight * (la * ai_w).sum() / (ai_w.sum() + 1e-8)
0341 |                 + self.align_lambda * align
0342 |                 + reg )
0343 | 
0344 |             opt.zero_grad()
0345 |             loss.backward()
0346 |             torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
0347 |                 list(self.model.encoder.parameters())
0348 |                 + list(self.model.aux_proj.parameters())
0349 |                 + list(self.model.predictor_h.parameters())
0350 |                 + list(self.model.predictor_a.parameters()),
0351 |                 0.5,
0352 |             )
0353 |             opt.step()
0354 | 
0355 |             tot_loss += float(loss.item())
0356 |             n_batches += 1
0357 | 
0358 |         return tot_loss / max(1, n_batches)
0359 | 
0360 |     def _load_calibrator(self):
0361 |         """Load calibrator or initialize with CORRECT default ranges"""
0362 |         calibrator_path = self.cfg.get("calibrator_path")
0363 |         if calibrator_path:
0364 |             try:
0365 |                 self.calibrator = ScoreCalibrator.load(calibrator_path)
0366 |                 self.logger.log("CalibratorLoaded", {"path": calibrator_path})
0367 |                 return
0368 |             except Exception as e:
0369 |                 self.logger.log("CalibratorLoadFailed", {"error": str(e)})
0370 |         
0371 |         # Initialize with CORRECT ranges
0372 |         self.logger.log("CalibratorUsingDefaults", {})
0373 |         # Map: AI 0,40,50,75,100 → Human -5,0,1,3,5 (conservative)
0374 |         human_scores = [-5, 0, 1, 3, 5]
0375 |         ai_scores = [0, 40, 50, 75, 100]
0376 |         self.calibrator.fit(human_scores, ai_scores)
0377 | 
0378 |     def train(self, pairs, dimension: str = "knowledge"):
0379 |         """Train the knowledge model on contrastive pairs"""
0380 |         # Split into train/validation
0381 |         dl_train, dl_val = self._create_dataloaders(pairs)
0382 |         if dl_train is None:
0383 |             return {"error": "insufficient_data", "dimension": dimension}
0384 | 
0385 |         # Setup optimizer
0386 |         self.optimizer = optim.AdamW(
0387 |             list(self.model.encoder.parameters())
0388 |             + list(self.model.aux_proj.parameters())
0389 |             + list(self.model.predictor_h.parameters())
0390 |             + list(self.model.predictor_a.parameters()),
0391 |             lr=self.lr,
0392 |             weight_decay=1e-4,
0393 |         )
0394 | 
0395 |         # Training loop
0396 |         best_val_metric = -math.inf
0397 |         patience = 0
0398 |         best_state = None
0399 |         val_pair_acc_h = float("nan")
0400 |         val_pair_acc_a = float("nan")
0401 |         alignment_mse = float("nan")
0402 |         disagreement_rate = float("nan")
0403 | 
0404 |         for epoch in range(self.epochs):
0405 |             # Train one epoch
0406 |             train_loss = self._train_epoch(dl_train)
0407 | 
0408 |             # Evaluate on validation
0409 |             val_pair_acc_h = (
0410 |                 self._pair_acc(dl_val, "human") if dl_val else float("nan")
0411 |             )
0412 |             val_pair_acc_a = (
0413 |                 self._pair_acc(dl_val, "ai") if dl_val else float("nan")
0414 |             )
0415 |             alignment_mse = (
0416 |                 self._alignment_mse(dl_val) if dl_val else float("nan")
0417 |             )
0418 |             disagreement_rate = (
0419 |                 self._disagreement_rate(dl_val) if dl_val else float("nan")
0420 |             )
0421 | 
0422 |             # Use human pair accuracy as primary metric
0423 |             val_metric = (
0424 |                 val_pair_acc_h
0425 |                 if not math.isnan(val_pair_acc_h)
0426 |                 else -train_loss
0427 |             )
0428 | 
0429 |             # Log progress
0430 |             self.logger.log(
0431 |                 "KnowledgeTrainingEpoch",
0432 |                 {
0433 |                     "epoch": epoch + 1,
0434 |                     "train_loss": train_loss,
0435 |                     "val_pair_acc_h": val_pair_acc_h,
0436 |                     "val_pair_acc_a": val_pair_acc_a,
0437 |                     "alignment_mse": alignment_mse,
0438 |                     "disagreement_rate": disagreement_rate,
0439 |                 },
0440 |             )
0441 | 
0442 |             # Early stopping
0443 |             if val_metric > best_val_metric + self.early_stopping_min_delta:
0444 |                 best_val_metric = val_metric
0445 |                 patience = 0
0446 | 
0447 |                 # Save best model state
0448 |                 best_state = {
0449 |                     "encoder": {
0450 |                         k: v.cpu()
0451 |                         for k, v in self.model.encoder.state_dict().items()
0452 |                     },
0453 |                     "aux_proj": {
0454 |                         k: v.cpu()
0455 |                         for k, v in self.model.aux_proj.state_dict().items()
0456 |                     },
0457 |                     "predictor_h": {
0458 |                         k: v.cpu()
0459 |                         for k, v in self.model.predictor_h.state_dict().items()
0460 |                     },
0461 |                     "predictor_a": {
0462 |                         k: v.cpu()
0463 |                         for k, v in self.model.predictor_a.state_dict().items()
0464 |                     },
0465 |                 }
0466 |             else:
0467 |                 patience += 1
0468 |                 if (
0469 |                     self.use_early_stopping
0470 |                     and patience >= self.early_stopping_patience
0471 |                 ):
0472 |                     self.logger.log("EarlyStopping", {"patience": patience})
0473 |                     break
0474 | 
0475 |         # Restore best model
0476 |         if best_state is not None:
0477 |             self.model.encoder.load_state_dict(best_state["encoder"])
0478 |             self.model.aux_proj.load_state_dict(best_state["aux_proj"])
0479 |             self.model.predictor_h.load_state_dict(best_state["predictor_h"])
0480 |             self.model.predictor_a.load_state_dict(best_state["predictor_a"])
0481 | 
0482 |         # Save model
0483 |         locator = self.get_locator(dimension)
0484 |         self.model.save(
0485 |             encoder_path=locator.encoder_file(),
0486 |             head_h_path=locator.model_file(),     # human head
0487 |             head_a_path=locator.q_head_file(),    # AI head
0488 |             auxproj_path=locator.auxproj_file(),  # ← add this
0489 |             manifest_path=locator.meta_file(),# ← and this (optional but recommended)
0490 |             extra={
0491 |                 "trained_pairs": len(pairs),
0492 |                 "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
0493 |                 "embedding_type": self.embedding_type,
0494 |                 "version": self.version,
0495 |                 "aux_features": self.aux_features,
0496 |             },
0497 |         )
0498 | 
0499 |         # Calibrate tuner on validation set
0500 |         if self.use_tuner and dl_val is not None:
0501 |             tuner = RegressionTuner(dimension=dimension, logger=self.logger)
0502 |             trained_count = 0
0503 | 
0504 |             with torch.no_grad():
0505 |                 for G, A, B, AUXA, AUXB, _, _ in dl_val:
0506 |                     # Get scores from human head (gold standard)
0507 |                     z_a = self.model.encoder(G, A)
0508 |                     z_b = self.model.encoder(G, B)
0509 |                     z_a = self.model.aux_proj(z_a, AUXA)
0510 |                     z_b = self.model.aux_proj(z_b, AUXB)
0511 |                     s_a = self.model.score_h(z_a)
0512 |                     s_b = self.model.score_h(z_b)
0513 | 
0514 |                     # Train on relative differences
0515 |                     diffs = (s_a - s_b).cpu().numpy().tolist()
0516 |                     for d in diffs:
0517 |                         tuner.train_single(float(d), 1.0)  # target delta ~ 1.0
0518 |                         trained_count += 1
0519 | 
0520 |             if trained_count > 0:
0521 |                 tuner.save(locator.tuner_file())
0522 |                 self.logger.log(
0523 |                     "TunerSaved",
0524 |                     {
0525 |                         "file": locator.tuner_file(),
0526 |                         "trained_samples": trained_count,
0527 |                     },
0528 |                 )
0529 | 
0530 |         # Prepare metadata
0531 |         meta = {
0532 |             "dimension": dimension,
0533 |             "model_type": "knowledge",
0534 |             "model_path": locator.model_file(),
0535 |             "q_head_path": locator.q_head_file(),
0536 |             "encoder_path": locator.encoder_file(),
0537 |             "tuner_path": locator.tuner_file() if self.use_tuner else None,
0538 |             "target_type": self.target_type,

0540 |             "version": self.version,
0541 |             "dim": self.dim,

0543 |             "aux_features": self.aux_features,
0544 |             "min_value": 0.0,
0545 |             "max_value": 1.0,
0546 |             "avg_loss": float(train_loss),
0547 |             "best_val_pair_acc_h": float(val_pair_acc_h)
0548 |             if not math.isnan(val_pair_acc_h)
0549 |             else None,
0550 |             "best_val_pair_acc_a": float(val_pair_acc_a)
0551 |             if not math.isnan(val_pair_acc_a)
0552 |             else None,
0553 |             "alignment_mse": float(alignment_mse)
0554 |             if not math.isnan(alignment_mse)
0555 |             else None,
0556 |             "disagreement_rate": float(disagreement_rate)
0557 |             if not math.isnan(disagreement_rate)
0558 |             else None,
0559 |             "trained_pairs": len(pairs),
0560 |             "beta": self.beta,
0561 |             "margin": self.margin,
0562 |             "ai_pair_weight": self.ai_pair_weight,
0563 |             "align_lambda": self.align_lambda,
0564 |             "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
0565 |         }
0566 | 
0567 |         # Save metadata
0568 |         self._save_meta_file(meta, dimension)

0581 |             version=self.version,
0582 |             embedding_type=self.memory.embedding.name,
0583 |             config={
0584 |                 "lr": self.lr,
0585 |                 "epochs": self.epochs,
0586 |                 "batch_size": self.batch_size,
0587 |                 "beta": self.beta,
0588 |                 "margin": self.margin,
0589 |                 "ai_pair_weight": self.ai_pair_weight,
0590 |                 "align_lambda": self.align_lambda,
0591 |             },
0592 |             sample_count=len(pairs),

0594 |         )
0595 | 
0596 |         return meta
0597 | 
0598 | def dpo_lite_loss_per_sample(s_pos: torch.Tensor, s_neg: torch.Tensor, beta: float = 2.0, margin: float = 0.2):
0599 |     # returns vector loss (batch,)
0600 |     return F.softplus(-(beta * (s_pos - s_neg - margin)))

0096 |             targets, 
0097 |             pos_weight=self.pos_weight
0098 |         )
0099 | 
0100 | 
0101 | # ==============================
0102 | # Hybrid SICQL Adapter (Critical Component)
0103 | # ==============================
0104 | 
0105 | class HybridSICQLAdapter:
0106 |     def __init__(self, memory, actor_lm, tokenizer, critic_head=None, device=None):
0107 |         self._device = torch.device(device or ("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"))
0108 |         self.memory = memory
0109 | 
0110 |         # --- Actor setup ---
0111 |         self.actor = actor_lm.to(self._device)
0112 |         self.actor.train()
0113 | 
0114 |         # Reference actor (frozen)
0115 |         self.actor_ref = copy.deepcopy(actor_lm).to(self._device)
0116 |         self.actor_ref.eval()
0117 |         for p in self.actor_ref.parameters():
0118 |             p.requires_grad_(False)
0119 | 
0120 |         # --- Critic setup (supports both SICQL + HuggingFace critics) ---
0121 |         self.critic = critic_head.to(self._device) if critic_head is not None else None
0122 |         self.critic_ref = None
0123 |         self.critic_type = None
0124 | 
0125 |         if self.critic is not None:
0126 |             # Detect critic type
0127 |             if hasattr(self.critic, "q_head") and hasattr(self.critic, "encoder"):
0128 |                 # Looks like SICQL InContextQModel
0129 |                 self.critic_type = "sicql"
0130 |                 self.critic.train()
0131 | 
0132 |                 self.critic_ref = type(self.critic)(
0133 |                     encoder=copy.deepcopy(self.critic.encoder),
0134 |                     q_head=copy.deepcopy(self.critic.q_head),
0135 |                     v_head=copy.deepcopy(self.critic.v_head),
0136 |                     pi_head=copy.deepcopy(self.critic.pi_head),
0137 |                     embedding_store=self.memory.embedding,
0138 |                     device=self._device,
0139 |                 ).to(self._device)
0140 |                 self.critic_ref.load_state_dict(self.critic.state_dict())
0141 |                 self.critic_ref.eval()
0142 |                 for p in self.critic_ref.parameters():
0143 |                     p.requires_grad_(False)
0144 | 
0145 |             else:
0146 |                 # Assume HuggingFace-style sequence classification model
0147 |                 self.critic_type = "hf"
0148 |                 self.critic.train()
0149 |                 self.critic_ref = copy.deepcopy(self.critic).to(self._device)
0150 |                 self.critic_ref.eval()
0151 |                 for p in self.critic_ref.parameters():
0152 |                     p.requires_grad_(False)
0153 | 
0154 |         # --- Tokenizer setup ---
0155 |         self.tok = tokenizer
0156 |         if getattr(self.tok, "pad_token", None) is None:
0157 |             if getattr(self.tok, "eos_token", None) is not None:
0158 |                 self.tok.pad_token = self.tok.eos_token
0159 |             else:
0160 |                 self.tok.add_special_tokens({"pad_token": "[PAD]"})
0161 |                 self.actor.resize_token_embeddings(len(self.tok))
0162 |                 self.actor_ref.resize_token_embeddings(len(self.tok))
0163 | 
0164 |         self.memory = memory
0165 | 
0166 |     def device(self):
0167 |         return self._device
0168 | 
0169 |     # ---------- Actor (HF LM) ----------
0170 |     @torch.no_grad()
0171 |     def sample_group(self, prompt, group_size, max_new_tokens=256, temperature=0.6, top_p=0.95):
0172 |         """Generate multiple responses from the HuggingFace LM."""
0173 |         inputs = self.tok(
0174 |             prompt,
0175 |             return_tensors="pt",
0176 |             padding=True,
0177 |             truncation=True,
0178 |             max_length=1024
0179 |         ).to(self._device)
0180 | 
0181 |         responses = []
0182 |         for _ in range(group_size):
0183 |             out = self.actor.generate(
0184 |                 **inputs,
0185 |                 do_sample=True,
0186 |                 temperature=temperature,
0187 |                 top_p=top_p,
0188 |                 max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens,
0189 |                 pad_token_id=self.tok.pad_token_id or self.tok.eos_token_id,
0190 |                 eos_token_id=self.tok.eos_token_id,
0191 |             )
0192 |             prompt_len = inputs["input_ids"].size(1)
0193 |             response_ids = out[0, prompt_len:]
0194 |             response = self.tok.decode(response_ids, skip_special_tokens=True)
0195 |             responses.append(response)
0196 |         return responses
0197 | 
0198 |     def logprob_sum(self, prompt, response):
0199 |         """Compute logprob sum with online actor LM."""
0200 |         return self._sum_logprobs(self.actor, prompt, response)
0201 | 
0202 |     @torch.no_grad()
0203 |     def logprob_sum_ref(self, prompt, response):
0204 |         """Compute logprob sum with frozen actor reference."""
0205 |         return self._sum_logprobs(self.actor_ref, prompt, response).detach()
0206 | 
0207 |     def _sum_logprobs(self, model, prompt, response):
0208 |         """Sum log probabilities for actor outputs."""
0209 |         full_text = prompt + response
0210 |         enc = self.tok(full_text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True, max_length=2048).to(self._device)
0211 |         input_ids = enc["input_ids"]
0212 |         attention_mask = enc["attention_mask"]
0213 | 
0214 |         outputs = model(input_ids=input_ids, attention_mask=attention_mask, labels=input_ids)
0215 |         logits = outputs.logits
0216 |         log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
0217 | 
0218 |         shift_logits = log_probs[..., :-1, :].contiguous()
0219 |         shift_labels = input_ids[..., 1:].contiguous()
0220 |         token_log_probs = torch.gather(shift_logits, dim=-1, index=shift_labels.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
0221 | 
0222 |         prompt_len = len(self.tok(prompt, return_tensors="pt")["input_ids"][0])
0223 |         response_log_probs = token_log_probs[:, prompt_len - 1:]
0224 |         return response_log_probs.sum(dim=1).squeeze()
0225 | 
0226 |     # ---------- Critic (SICQL InContextQModel) ----------
0227 |     def _critic_logit(self, model, prompt, response):
0228 |         """Compute Q-value logit from SICQL critic (InContextQModel)."""
0229 |         if model is None:
0230 |             raise ValueError("Critic head required for critic mode")
0231 |         if self.memory is None:
0232 |             raise ValueError("Memory with embedding system required for critic")
0233 | 
0234 |         # Get embeddings
0235 |         prompt_emb_np = self.memory.embedding.get_or_create(prompt)
0236 |         response_emb_np = self.memory.embedding.get_or_create(response)
0237 |         prompt_emb = torch.tensor(prompt_emb_np, device=self._device, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0)
0238 |         response_emb = torch.tensor(response_emb_np, device=self._device, dtype=torch.float32).unsqueeze(0)
0239 | 
0240 |         out = model(prompt_emb, response_emb)
0241 |         return out["q_value"].squeeze()
0242 | 
0243 |     def critic_logit(self, prompt, response):
0244 |         return self._critic_logit(self.critic, prompt, response)
0245 | 
0246 |     @torch.no_grad()
0247 |     def critic_logit_ref(self, prompt, response):
0248 |         return self._critic_logit(self.critic_ref, prompt, response).detach()
0249 | 
0250 |     # ---------- Ref sync ----------
0251 |     def hard_reset_ref(self):
0252 |         """Reset references to current models."""
0253 |         self.actor_ref.load_state_dict(self.actor.state_dict())
0254 |         self.actor_ref.eval()
0255 |         if self.critic and self.critic_ref:
0256 |             self.critic_ref.load_state_dict(self.critic.state_dict())
0257 |             self.critic_ref.eval()
0258 | 
0259 | 
0260 | 
0261 | # ==============================
0262 | # PACS Trainer Core
0263 | # ==============================
0264 | 
0265 | class PACSCoreTrainer:
0266 |     """PACS trainer implementing RLVR via Supervised with RLOO regularization"""
0267 |     
0268 |     def __init__(
0269 |         self,
0270 |         policy: HybridSICQLAdapter,
0271 |         cfg: PACSConfig,
0272 |         verifier: Callable[[str, str, Optional[Dict[str, Any]]], int],
0273 |         logger: Optional[Callable[[Dict[str, Any]], None]] = None,
0274 |         online_training: bool = False
0275 |     ):
0276 |         """
0277 |         Args:
0278 |             policy: Policy adapter (HybridSICQLAdapter)
0279 |             cfg: PACS configuration
0280 |             verifier: Function to verify (prompt, response, meta) → {0,1}
0281 |             logger: Optional logging function
0282 |         """
0283 |         self.policy = policy
0284 |         self.cfg = cfg
0285 |         self.verifier = verifier
0286 |         self.logger = logger or (lambda d: None)
0287 |         self.online_training = online_training
0288 | 
0289 |         # Determine which parameters to train
0290 |         if cfg.score_mode == "logprob":
0291 |             params = self.policy.actor.parameters()
0292 |         elif cfg.score_mode == "critic":
0293 |             if self.policy.critic is None:
0294 |                 raise ValueError("critic_head required for score_mode='critic'")
0295 |             params = self.policy.critic.parameters()
0296 |         else:
0297 |             raise ValueError("score_mode must be 'logprob' or 'critic'")
0298 |         
0299 |         # Optimizer
0300 |         self.optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
0301 |             params, 
0302 |             lr=cfg.lr, 
0303 |             weight_decay=cfg.weight_decay
0304 |         )
0305 |         
0306 |         # Learning rate scheduler
0307 |         self.scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(
0308 |             self.optimizer, 
0309 |             mode="min", 
0310 |             factor=0.5, 
0311 |             patience=5
0312 |         )
0313 |         
0314 |         # Loss function
0315 |         # Use BCEWithLogitsLoss to maintain numerical stability. 
0316 |         # The paper's Equation 1 shows the loss is computed with σ(ψ), 
0317 |         # but PyTorch's BCEWithLogitsLoss combines sigmoid + BCE in a numerically stable way.
0318 |         self.loss_fn = WeightedBCEWithLogits(pos_weight=cfg.pos_weight)
0319 |         
0320 |         # Training state
0321 |         self._step = 0
0322 |         self.best_loss = float("inf")
0323 |         self.early_stop_counter = 0
0324 | 
0325 |     # ---- Helpers ----
0326 |     def _rhat_vector(self, prompt: str, responses: List[str]) -> torch.Tensor:
0327 |         """
0328 |         Compute r̂ for each response in group based on chosen score_mode.
0329 |         In both modes:
0330 |         r̂ = β·(score_online - score_ref)
0331 |         """
0332 |         vals = []
0333 |         
0334 |         if self.cfg.score_mode == "logprob":
0335 |             for r in responses:
0336 |                 lp = self.policy.logprob_sum(prompt, r)          # requires grad
0337 |                 lpr = self.policy.logprob_sum_ref(prompt, r)     # no grad
0338 |                 vals.append(self.cfg.beta * (lp - lpr))
0339 |         else:  # critic
0340 |             for r in responses:
0341 |                 lg = self.policy.critic_logit(prompt, r)         # requires grad
0342 |                 lgr = self.policy.critic_logit_ref(prompt, r)    # no grad
0343 |                 vals.append(self.cfg.beta * (lg - lgr))
0344 |         
0345 |         return torch.stack(vals)  # (G,)
0346 |     
0347 |     def _psi_rloo(self, rhat: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
0348 |         """
0349 |         Compute ψ using RLOO (leave-one-out) regularization.
0350 |         
0351 |         ψ_i = r̂_i − mean_{j≠i} r̂_j
0352 |         """
0353 |         G = rhat.numel()
0354 |         if G <= 1:
0355 |             return rhat
0356 |             
0357 |         # Compute mean of all r̂ values
0358 |         total = rhat.sum()
0359 |         
0360 |         # Compute leave-one-out mean for each element
0361 |         psi = rhat - (total - rhat) / (G - 1)
0362 |         return psi
0363 |     
0364 |     def _verify_labels(
0365 |         self, 
0366 |         prompt: str, 
0367 |         responses: List[str], 
0368 |         meta: Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
0369 |     ) -> torch.Tensor:
0370 |         """Verify responses and return labels (0 or 1)"""
0371 |         labels = []
0372 |         for r in responses:
0373 |             try:
0374 |                 labels.append(float(self.verifier(prompt, r, meta)))
0375 |             except Exception as e:
0376 |                 print(f"Verification failed: {e}")
0377 |                 labels.append(0.0)
0378 |         
0379 |         return torch.tensor(labels, dtype=torch.float32, device=self.policy.device())
0380 |     
0381 |     def _log(self, d: Dict[str, Any]):
0382 |         """Log metrics with step counter"""
0383 |         d = {"step": self._step, **d}
0384 |         self.logger(d)
0385 |     
0386 |     def _check_early_stopping(self, loss: float) -> bool:
0387 |         """Check if early stopping criteria are met"""
0388 |         if loss < self.best_loss - self.cfg.early_stopping_min_delta:
0389 |             self.best_loss = loss
0390 |             self.early_stop_counter = 0
0391 |             return False
0392 |         
0393 |         self.early_stop_counter += 1
0394 |         return self.early_stop_counter >= self.cfg.early_stopping_patience
0395 | 
0396 |     # ---- Training API ----
0397 |     def train(
0398 |         self, 
0399 |         dataset: RLVRDataset, 
0400 |         max_steps: Optional[int] = None
0401 |     ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
0402 |         """
0403 |         Train policy using PACS with RLOO regularization.
0404 |         
0405 |         Args:
0406 |             dataset: RLVRDataset containing training samples
0407 |             max_steps: Maximum number of training steps
0408 |             
0409 |         Returns:
0410 |             Training statistics
0411 |         """
0412 |         # Training metrics
0413 |         metrics = {
0414 |             "losses": [],
0415 |             "psi_means": [],
0416 |             "rhat_means": [],
0417 |             "label_rates": [],
0418 |             "acc_proxies": [],
0419 |             "entropies": []
0420 |         }
0421 |         
0422 |         # Training loop
0423 |         step = 0
0424 |         while max_steps is None or step < max_steps:
0425 |             try:
0426 |                 # Sample random item from dataset
0427 |                 item = dataset[random.randint(0, len(dataset) - 1)]
0428 | 
0429 |                 if self.online_training:
0430 |                     self._train_on_item(item, metrics)
0431 |                 else:
0432 |                     self._train_on_item_offline(item, metrics)
0433 |                 
0434 |                 # Periodic reference model reset
0435 |                 if self.cfg.steps_per_reset and (self._step % self.cfg.steps_per_reset == 0):
0436 |                     self.policy.hard_reset_ref()
0437 |                 
0438 |                 # Log metrics periodically
0439 |                 if self._step % self.cfg.log_every == 0:
0440 |                     self._log({
0441 |                         "loss": metrics["losses"][-1] if metrics["losses"] else 0.0,
0442 |                         "psi_mean": metrics["psi_means"][-1] if metrics["psi_means"] else 0.0,
0443 |                         "rhat_mean": metrics["rhat_means"][-1] if metrics["rhat_means"] else 0.0,
0444 |                         "label_pos_rate": metrics["label_rates"][-1] if metrics["label_rates"] else 0.0,
0445 |                         "acc_proxy": metrics["acc_proxies"][-1] if metrics["acc_proxies"] else 0.0,
0446 |                         "mode": self.cfg.score_mode,
0447 |                         "entropy": metrics["entropies"][-1] if metrics["entropies"] else 0.0
0448 |                     })
0449 |                 
0450 |                 step += 1
0451 |                 self._step += 1
0452 |                 
0453 |             except Exception as e:
0454 |                 print(f"Training error at step {self._step}: {e}")
0455 |                 continue
0456 |         
0457 |         # Return training statistics
0458 |         return {
0459 |             "avg_loss": float(np.mean(metrics["losses"])) if metrics["losses"] else 0.0,
0460 |             "avg_psi": float(np.mean(metrics["psi_means"])) if metrics["psi_means"] else 0.0,
0461 |             "avg_rhat": float(np.mean(metrics["rhat_means"])) if metrics["rhat_means"] else 0.0,
0462 |             "pos_rate": float(np.mean(metrics["label_rates"])) if metrics["label_rates"] else 0.0,
0463 |             "acc_proxy": float(np.mean(metrics["acc_proxies"])) if metrics["acc_proxies"] else 0.0,
0464 |             "entropy": float(np.mean(metrics["entropies"])) if metrics["entropies"] else 0.0,
0465 |             "steps": self._step
0466 |         }
0467 |     
0468 | 
0469 |     def _train_on_item_offline(self, item: RLVRItem, metrics: Dict[str, list]) -> None:
0470 |         """
0471 |         Train directly on dataset rewards (offline supervised PACS).
0472 |         
0473 |         Uses RLVRItem.prompt, RLVRItem.response, and RLVRItem.reward
0474 |         as the training signal without generating new responses.
0475 |         """
0476 |         prompt = item.prompt
0477 |         response = item.response
0478 |         reward_val = float(item.reward)
0479 | 
0480 |         # Convert reward into tensor
0481 |         reward = torch.tensor([reward_val], device=self.policy.device(), dtype=torch.float32)
0482 | 
0483 |         # --- Compute r̂ (online vs reference) ---
0484 |         if self.cfg.score_mode == "logprob":
0485 |             lp = self.policy.logprob_sum(prompt, response)          # requires grad
0486 |             lpr = self.policy.logprob_sum_ref(prompt, response)     # no grad
0487 |             rhat = self.cfg.beta * (lp - lpr)
0488 |         else:  # critic mode
0489 |             lg = self.policy.critic_logit(prompt, response)         # requires grad
0490 |             lgr = self.policy.critic_logit_ref(prompt, response)    # no grad
0491 |             rhat = self.cfg.beta * (lg - lgr)
0492 | 
0493 |         psi = rhat.unsqueeze(0)  # keep batch dimension
0494 | 
0495 |         # --- Compute supervised loss ---
0496 |         loss = self.loss_fn(psi, reward)
0497 | 
0498 |         # --- Optimization ---
0499 |         self.optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
0500 |         loss.backward()
0501 |         if self.cfg.grad_clip:
0502 |             torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
0503 |                 self.optimizer.param_groups[0]["params"], 
0504 |                 self.cfg.grad_clip
0505 |             )
0506 |         self.optimizer.step()
0507 |         self.scheduler.step(loss.item())
0508 | 
0509 |         # --- Metrics ---
0510 |         with torch.no_grad():
0511 |             psi_val = float(psi.item())
0512 |             pred = (torch.sigmoid(psi) > 0.5).float()
0513 |             acc_proxy = float((pred == reward).float().mean().item())
0514 | 
0515 |             metrics["losses"].append(float(loss.item()))
0516 |             metrics["psi_means"].append(psi_val)
0517 |             metrics["rhat_means"].append(float(rhat.item()))
0518 |             metrics["label_rates"].append(reward_val)
0519 |             metrics["acc_proxies"].append(acc_proxy)
0520 | 
0521 |         # --- Log ---
0522 |         self._log({
0523 |             "mode": f"{self.cfg.score_mode}-offline",
0524 |             "loss": float(loss.item()),
0525 |             "psi": psi_val,
0526 |             "rhat": float(rhat.item()),
0527 |             "reward": reward_val,
0528 |             "acc_proxy": acc_proxy,
0529 |             "prompt_snippet": prompt[:80] + ("..." if len(prompt) > 80 else "")
0530 |         })
0531 | 
0532 |     
0533 |     def _train_on_item(self, item: RLVRItem, metrics: Dict[str, list]) -> None:
0534 |         """Train on a single dataset item and update metrics"""
0535 |         prompt = item.prompt
0536 |         meta = item.meta
0537 |         
0538 |         # Generate response group
0539 |         responses = self.policy.sample_group(
0540 |             prompt,
0541 |             group_size=self.cfg.group_size,
0542 |             max_new_tokens=self.cfg.max_new_tokens,
0543 |             temperature=self.cfg.temperature,
0544 |             top_p=self.cfg.top_p,
0545 |         )
0546 |         
0547 |         # Verify responses
0548 |         labels = self._verify_labels(prompt, responses, meta)
0549 |         
0550 |         # Compute r̂ and ψ
0551 |         rhat = self._rhat_vector(prompt, responses)  # (G,)
0552 |         psi = self._psi_rloo(rhat)
0553 |         
0554 |         # Compute loss
0555 |         loss = self.loss_fn(psi, labels)
0556 |         
0557 |         # Detach psi for component calculations
0558 |         psi_detached = psi.detach()
0559 |         psi_sigmoid = torch.sigmoid(psi_detached)
0560 |         
0561 |         # Calculate actor component magnitude
0562 |         with torch.no_grad():
0563 |             # Actor component: policy improvement term
0564 |             # [l(q, o; πθ)]∇θ log πθ(o|q)
0565 |             cross_entropy_loss = -(labels * torch.log(psi_sigmoid + 1e-8) + 
0566 |                                 (1 - labels) * torch.log(1 - psi_sigmoid + 1e-8))
0567 |             actor_component = cross_entropy_loss.mean().item()
0568 |             
0569 |             # Critic component: reward estimation term
0570 |             # (R(q, o) - σ(ψ(q, o; πθ)))∇θψ(q, o; πθ)
0571 |             critic_raw = (labels - psi_sigmoid).mean().item()  # Prediction error
0572 |             critic_grad = psi.mean().item()  # Gradient magnitude
0573 |             critic_component = critic_raw * critic_grad  # Full critic update
0574 |             
0575 |             # Calculate coupling ratio (absolute values to handle sign)
0576 |             coupling_ratio = abs(actor_component) / (abs(critic_component) + 1e-8)
0577 |             
0578 |             # Track policy entropy for exploration analysis
0579 |             policy_entropy = -torch.mean(psi_sigmoid * torch.log(psi_sigmoid + 1e-8) + 
0580 |                                         (1 - psi_sigmoid) * torch.log(1 - psi_sigmoid + 1e-8)).item()
0581 |             sequence_entropy = self.policy.calculate_response_entropy(prompt, responses)
0582 | 
0583 |         # Optimization
0584 |         self.optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
0585 |         loss.backward()
0586 |         
0587 |         # Gradient clipping
0588 |         if self.cfg.grad_clip is not None:
0589 |             torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(
0590 |                 self.optimizer.param_groups[0]["params"], 
0591 |                 self.cfg.grad_clip
0592 |             )
0593 |         
0594 |         self.optimizer.step()
0595 |         
0596 |         # Update learning rate
0597 |         self.scheduler.step(loss.item())
0598 |         
0599 |         # Compute metrics
0600 |         with torch.no_grad():
0601 |             psi_mean = float(psi.mean().item())
0602 |             rhat_mean = float(rhat.mean().item())
0603 |             label_pos_rate = float(labels.mean().item())
0604 |             preds = (torch.sigmoid(psi) > 0.5).float()
0605 |             acc_proxy = float((preds == labels).float().mean().item())
0606 |             entropy = self.policy.calculate_response_entropy(prompt, responses)
0607 |         
0608 |         grad_analysis = self._analyze_gradients(psi, labels)
0609 | 
0610 |         metrics["actor_components"].append(grad_analysis["actor_component"])
0611 |         metrics["critic_raws"].append(grad_analysis["critic_raw"])
0612 |         metrics["critic_grads"].append(grad_analysis["critic_grad"])
0613 |         metrics["critic_components"].append(grad_analysis["critic_component"])
0614 |         metrics["coupling_ratios"].append(grad_analysis["coupling_ratio"])
0615 |         metrics["binary_entropies"].append(grad_analysis["binary_entropy"])
0616 |         metrics["losses"].append(float(loss.item()))
0617 |         metrics["psi_means"].append(psi_mean)
0618 |         metrics["rhat_means"].append(rhat_mean)
0619 |         metrics["label_rates"].append(label_pos_rate)
0620 |         metrics["acc_proxies"].append(acc_proxy)
0621 |         metrics["entropies"].append(entropy)
0622 |         metrics["policy_entropies"].append(policy_entropy)
0623 |         metrics["sequence_entropies"].append(sequence_entropy)
0624 |         metrics["response_entropy"].append(

0644 |     def _analyze_gradients(self, psi: torch.Tensor, labels: torch.Tensor) -> Dict[str, float]:
0645 |         """Analyze gradient components as in PACS paper Equation 6"""
0646 |         # Compute sigmoid once for efficiency
0647 |         psi_sigmoid = torch.sigmoid(psi)
0648 |         
0649 |         # 1. ACTOR component: policy improvement term
0650 |         # [l(q, o; πθ)]∇θ log πθ(o|q)
0651 |         cross_entropy_loss = -(labels * torch.log(psi_sigmoid + 1e-8) + 
0652 |                             (1 - labels) * torch.log(1 - psi_sigmoid + 1e-8))
0653 |         actor_component = cross_entropy_loss.mean().item()
0654 |         
0655 |         # 2. CRITIC component breakdown
0656 |         prediction_error = (labels - psi_sigmoid)
0657 |         critic_raw = prediction_error.mean().item()  # R - σ(ψ)
0658 |         critic_grad = psi.mean().item()  # ∇θψ
0659 |         critic_component = (prediction_error * psi).mean().item()  # Full critic update
0660 |         
0661 |         # 3. Coupling ratio (normalized for stability)
0662 |         coupling_ratio = abs(actor_component) / (abs(critic_component) + 1e-8)
0663 |         
0664 |         # 4. Binary entropy (prediction confidence)
0665 |         binary_entropy = -torch.mean(
0666 |             psi_sigmoid * torch.log(psi_sigmoid + 1e-8) + 
0667 |             (1 - psi_sigmoid) * torch.log(1 - psi_sigmoid + 1e-8)
0668 |         ).item()
0669 |         
0670 |         return {
0671 |             "actor_component": actor_component,
0672 |             "critic_raw": critic_raw,
0673 |             "critic_grad": critic_grad,
0674 |             "critic_component": critic_component,
0675 |             "coupling_ratio": coupling_ratio,
0676 |             "binary_entropy": binary_entropy
0677 |         }

0974 |     def _calculate_policy_entropy(self, policy, dataset, tokenizer, sample_size: int = 100) -> float:
0975 |         """
0976 |         Calculate average entropy of the actor policy over a subset of dataset.
0977 |         """
0978 |         import random
0979 |         subset = random.sample(dataset, min(sample_size, len(dataset)))
0980 | 
0981 |         entropies = []
0982 |         for item in subset:
0983 |             prompt, response = item.prompt, item.response
0984 |             if not response:
0985 |                 continue
0986 | 
0987 |             logits = self._get_logits(policy, prompt, response, tokenizer, device=policy._device)
0988 |             # take only the response part
0989 |             resp_len = len(tokenizer.encode(response))
0990 |             resp_logits = logits[:, -resp_len:, :]
0991 | 
0992 |             probs = F.softmax(resp_logits, dim=-1)
0993 |             entropy = -(probs * probs.log()).sum(dim=-1).mean().item()
0994 |             entropies.append(entropy)
0995 | 
0996 |         return float(sum(entropies) / len(entropies)) if entropies else 0.0
0997 | 
0998 |     def _get_logits(self, policy, prompt: str, response: str, tokenizer, device="cuda"):
0999 |         """Tokenize prompt+response and run through actor LM to get logits."""
1000 |         inputs = tokenizer(prompt + response, return_tensors="pt").to(device)
1001 |         with torch.no_grad():
1002 |             outputs = policy.actor(**inputs)
1003 |             logits = outputs.logits  # shape: [batch, seq_len, vocab_size]
1004 |         return logits
1005 | 
1006 |     def _calculate_policy_stability(self, policy, dataset, sample_size: int = 100) -> float:
1007 |         subset = random.sample(dataset, min(sample_size, len(dataset)))
1008 |         rewards, kl_divs = [], []
1009 | 
1010 |         for item in subset:
1011 |             prompt, response = item.prompt, item.response
1012 |             if not response:
1013 |                 continue
1014 | 
1015 |             # Current policy logits
1016 |             logits_cur = self._get_logits(policy, prompt, response, policy.tok, device=policy._device)
1017 |             probs_cur = F.softmax(logits_cur, dim=-1)
1018 | 
1019 |             # Reference policy logits
1020 |             logits_ref = self._get_logits(policy, prompt, response, policy.tok, device=policy._device)
1021 |             probs_ref = F.softmax(logits_ref, dim=-1)
1022 | 
1023 |             kl = F.kl_div(probs_ref.log(), probs_cur, reduction="batchmean").item()
1024 |             kl_divs.append(kl)
1025 | 
1026 |             if policy.critic is not None:
1027 |                 reward = policy.critic_logit(prompt, response).item()
1028 |                 rewards.append(reward)
1029 | 
1030 |         reward_var = np.var(rewards) if rewards else 0.0
1031 |         kl_mean = np.mean(kl_divs) if kl_divs else 0.0
1032 |         return 1.0 / (1.0 + reward_var + kl_mean)

0136 |     def get_training_pairs_by_dimension(

0149 |         Length rule (when text_max is provided):

0151 |           - For singletons: drop if scorable/output length > text_max

0187 | 
0188 |                     if "output" in row:

0190 |                         out = (row.get("output") or "").strip()

0202 |                             continue

0209 |                             dropped_len += 1
0210 |                     else:

0213 | 
0214 |                 cleaned = filtered
0215 | 
0216 |             # 3) Trim to requested limit

0218 | 
0219 |             if self.logger:
0220 |                 if text_max:
0221 |                     self.logger.log("PreferencePairsLengthFilter",
0222 |                                     {"dimension": dimension,
0223 |                                      "text_max": int(text_max),
0224 |                                      "kept": kept_len,
0225 |                                      "dropped": dropped_len,
0226 |                                      "returned": len(result),
0227 |                                      "requested_limit": int(limit),
0228 |                                      "fetched": int(fetch_n)})
0229 |                 else:
0230 |                     self.logger.log("PreferencePairsNoLengthFilter",
0231 |                                     {"dimension": dimension,
0232 |                                      "returned": len(result),
0233 |                                      "requested_limit": int(limit)})
0234 | 
0235 |             return {dimension: result}
0236 | 
0237 |         except Exception as e:

0243 | def _is_valid_text(x: str | None) -> bool:

0245 | 
0246 | def _within_len(s: Optional[str], maxlen: int) -> bool:

0248 | 
0249 | def _is_valid_score(v) -> bool:

0255 | 
0256 | def _clean_pair_dict(s: dict) -> dict | None:

0261 |     # singleton

0281 |                 "output_b": s.get("output_b") if (b_ok and math.isfinite(vb01)) else None,
0282 |                 "value_b": vb01 if (b_ok and math.isfinite(vb01)) else None,
0283 |             }
0284 |         return None
0285 | 
0286 |     # explicit HRM/MRQ form

0001 | # stephanie/scoring/prompt_pair_builder.py
0002 | from __future__ import annotations
0003 | 
0004 | from collections import defaultdict
0005 | 
0006 | from sqlalchemy.sql import text
0007 | 
0008 | 
0009 | class PromptPreferencePairBuilder:
0010 |     """
0011 |     Builds preference training pairs from scored prompt-response pairs
0012 |     for MR.Q or reward model training. Operates per dimension.
0013 |     """
0014 | 
0015 |     def __init__(self, db, logger=None):
0016 |         self.db = db
0017 |         self.logger = logger
0018 | 
0019 |     def get_training_pairs_by_dimension(
0020 |         self, goal: str = None, limit: int = 10000
0021 |     ) -> dict:
0022 |         """
0023 |         Returns a dictionary of training pairs grouped by dimension.
0024 | 
0025 |         Output Format:
0026 |         {
0027 |             "clarity": [
0028 |                 {
0029 |                     "prompt": "...",
0030 |                     "output_a": "...",  # preferred
0031 |                     "output_b": "...",  # less preferred
0032 |                     "value_a": 8.2,
0033 |                     "value_b": 4.5
0034 |                 },
0035 |                 ...
0036 |             ],
0037 |             ...
0038 |         }
0039 |         """
0040 |         query = text(
0041 |             """
0042 |             WITH scored_prompts AS (
0043 |                 SELECT
0044 |                     s.dimension,
0045 |                     s.score,
0046 |                     e.pipeline_run_id,
0047 |                     p.id AS prompt_id,
0048 |                     p.prompt_text,
0049 |                     p.response_text,
0050 |                     ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
0051 |                         PARTITION BY s.dimension, p.id ORDER BY s.score DESC
0052 |                     ) AS rank_high,
0053 |                     ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
0054 |                         PARTITION BY s.dimension, p.id ORDER BY s.score ASC
0055 |                     ) AS rank_low
0056 |                 FROM scores s
0057 |                 JOIN evaluations e ON s.evaluation_id = e.id
0058 |                 JOIN prompts p ON e.pipeline_run_id = p.pipeline_run_id
0059 |                 WHERE s.score IS NOT NULL
0060 |                 {goal_filter}
0061 |             )
0062 |             SELECT
0063 |                 dimension,
0064 |                 prompt_text,
0065 |                 response_text,
0066 |                 score,
0067 |                 rank_type,
0068 |                 prompt_id
0069 |             FROM (
0070 |                 SELECT
0071 |                     dimension,
0072 |                     prompt_text,
0073 |                     response_text,
0074 |                     score,
0075 |                     'top' AS rank_type,
0076 |                     prompt_id
0077 |                 FROM scored_prompts
0078 |                 WHERE rank_high = 1
0079 |                   AND prompt_text IS NOT NULL
0080 |                   AND response_text IS NOT NULL
0081 |                   AND prompt_text <> ''
0082 |                   AND response_text <> ''
0083 |                   
0084 |                 UNION ALL
0085 | 
0086 |                 SELECT
0087 |                     dimension,
0088 |                     prompt_text,
0089 |                     response_text,
0090 |                     score,
0091 |                     'bottom' AS rank_type,
0092 |                     prompt_id
0093 |                 FROM scored_prompts
0094 |                 WHERE rank_low = 1
0095 |             ) AS ranked_pairs
0096 |             ORDER BY dimension, prompt_id
0097 |             LIMIT :limit
0098 |         """.replace("{goal_filter}", "AND p.goal_text = :goal" if goal else "")
0099 |         )
0100 | 
0101 |         params = {"limit": limit}
0102 |         if goal:
0103 |             params["goal"] = goal
0104 | 
0105 |         try:
0106 |             rows = self.db.execute(query, params).fetchall()
0107 |         except Exception as e:
0108 |             if self.logger:
0109 |                 self.logger.error(
0110 |                     "Failed to get training pairs", extra={"error": str(e)}
0111 |                 )
0112 |             return {}
0113 | 
0114 |         grouped = defaultdict(dict)
0115 |         results_by_dimension = defaultdict(list)
0116 | 
0117 |         for row in rows:
0118 |             key = (row.dimension, row.prompt_id)
0119 |             grouped[key][row.rank_type] = row
0120 | 
0121 |         for (dimension, _), data in grouped.items():
0122 |             if "top" in data and "bottom" in data:
0123 |                 results_by_dimension[dimension].append(
0124 |                     {
0125 |                         "prompt": data["top"].prompt_text,
0126 |                         "output_a": data["top"].response_text,
0127 |                         "output_b": data["bottom"].response_text,
0128 |                         "value_a": float(data["top"].score),
0129 |                         "value_b": float(data["bottom"].score),
0130 |                     }
0131 |                 )
0132 | 
0133 |         return dict(results_by_dimension)

0080 |         • singleton: {"title": str, "output": str, "score": float}
0081 |         • pairwise : {"title": str, "output_a": str, "output_b": str,
0082 |                         "value_a": float, "value_b": float}
0083 | 
0084 |         Builds a TensorDataset of (ctx_emb, doc_emb, score) on self.device.
0085 |         """
0086 |         import torch
0087 | 
0088 |         ctxs, docs, ys = [], [], []
0089 |         kept, skipped = 0, 0
0090 | 
0091 |         def _push(title, out, val):
0092 |             nonlocal kept
0093 |             g = torch.tensor(self.memory.embedding.get_or_create(title), dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device)
0094 |             d = torch.tensor(self.memory.embedding.get_or_create(out),   dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device)
0095 |             y = torch.tensor(float(val), dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device)
0096 |             ctxs.append(g)
0097 |             docs.append(d)
0098 |             ys.append(y)
0099 |             kept += 1
0100 | 
0101 |         for s in self.progress(samples, desc="Packing SICQL triples"):
0102 |             try:
0103 |                 title = (s.get("title") or "").strip()
0104 |                 if not title:
0105 |                     skipped += 1
0106 |                     continue
0107 | 
0108 |                 if "output" in s and "score" in s:
0109 |                     out = (s.get("output") or "").strip()
0110 |                     val = s.get("score")
0111 |                     if out and val is not None:
0112 |                         _push(title, out, val)
0113 |                     else:
0114 |                         skipped += 1
0115 | 
0116 |                 elif all(k in s for k in ("output_a", "output_b", "value_a", "value_b")):
0117 |                     a_out = (s.get("output_a") or "").strip()
0118 |                     b_out = (s.get("output_b") or "").strip()
0119 |                     a_val = s.get("value_a")
0120 |                     b_val = s.get("value_b")
0121 | 
0122 |                     # skip if both missing
0123 |                     if not a_out and not b_out:
0124 |                         skipped += 1
0125 |                         continue
0126 | 
0127 |                     # push A and/or B if present
0128 |                     if a_out and a_val is not None:
0129 |                         _push(title, a_out, a_val)
0130 |                     if b_out and b_val is not None:
0131 |                         _push(title, b_out, b_val)
0132 |                 else:
0133 |                     skipped += 1
0134 | 
0135 |             except Exception as e:
0136 |                 skipped += 1
0137 |                 if self.logger:
0138 |                     self.logger.log("SICQLSampleError", {"error": str(e)})
0139 | 
0140 |         if kept < self.min_samples:
0141 |             if self.logger:
0142 |                 self.logger.log("InsufficientSamples", {"kept": kept, "threshold": self.min_samples})
0143 |             return None
0144 | 
0145 |         X_ctx = torch.stack(ctxs)   # [N, D]
0146 |         X_doc = torch.stack(docs)   # [N, D]
0147 |         y     = torch.stack(ys)     # [N]
0148 | 
0149 |         dataset = TensorDataset(X_ctx, X_doc, y)
0150 |         return DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=self.batch_size, shuffle=True)
0151 |

0153 |     def _load_tuners(self):
0154 |         """Load regression tuners for each dimension"""
0155 |         for dim in self.dimensions:
0156 |             tuner_path = super().get_locator(dim).tuner_file()
0157 |             if os.path.exists(tuner_path):
0158 |                 self.tuners[dim] = RegressionTuner(dimension=dim)
0159 |                 self.tuners[dim].load(tuner_path)
0160 |             else:
0161 |                 self.tuners[dim] = None
0162 |                 self.logger.log(
0163 |                     "TunerMissing", {"dimension": dim, "path": tuner_path}
0164 |                 )

0166 |     def _build_model(self, dimension):

0169 |         if locator.model_exists():
0170 |             # Load existing model
0171 |             encoder = TextEncoder(dim=self.dim, hdim=self.hdim).to(self.device)
0172 |             q_head = QHead(zsa_dim=self.dim, hdim=self.hdim).to(self.device)
0173 |             v_head = VHead(zsa_dim=self.dim, hdim=self.hdim).to(self.device)
0174 |             pi_head = PolicyHead(
0175 |                 zsa_dim=self.dim, hdim=self.hdim, num_actions=3
0176 |             ).to(self.device)
0177 | 
0178 |             # Load weights
0179 |             encoder.load_state_dict(
0180 |                 torch.load(locator.encoder_file(), map_location=self.device)
0181 |             )
0182 |             q_head.load_state_dict(
0183 |                 torch.load(locator.q_head_file(), map_location=self.device)
0184 |             )
0185 |             v_head.load_state_dict(
0186 |                 torch.load(locator.v_head_file(), map_location=self.device)
0187 |             )
0188 |             pi_head.load_state_dict(
0189 |                 torch.load(locator.pi_head_file(), map_location=self.device)
0190 |             )
0191 | 
0192 |             # Build model
0193 |             sicql_model = InContextQModel(
0194 |                 encoder=encoder,
0195 |                 q_head=q_head,
0196 |                 v_head=v_head,
0197 |                 pi_head=pi_head,
0198 |                 embedding_store=self.memory.embedding,
0199 |                 device=self.device,
0200 |             )
0201 |             return sicql_model
0202 | 
0203 |         # Build new model
0204 |         self.dim = self.memory.embedding.dim
0205 |         self.hdim = self.memory.embedding.hdim
0206 | 
0207 |         encoder = TextEncoder(dim=self.dim, hdim=self.hdim).to(self.device)
0208 |         q_head = QHead(zsa_dim=self.dim, hdim=self.hdim).to(self.device)
0209 |         v_head = VHead(zsa_dim=self.dim, hdim=self.hdim).to(self.device)
0210 |         pi_head = PolicyHead(
0211 |             zsa_dim=self.dim, hdim=self.hdim, num_actions=3
0212 |         ).to(self.device)
0213 | 
0214 |         return InContextQModel(
0215 |             encoder=encoder,
0216 |             q_head=q_head,
0217 |             v_head=v_head,
0218 |             pi_head=pi_head,
0219 |             embedding_store=self.memory.embedding,
0220 |             device=self.device,
0221 |         )

0223 |     
0224 |     def _train_epoch(self, model, dataloader, epoch_idx=None):
0225 |         """Train for one epoch with all heads"""
0226 |         model.train()
0227 |         total_q_loss = 0.0
0228 |         total_v_loss = 0.0
0229 |         total_pi_loss = 0.0
0230 |         count = 0
0231 | 
0232 |         for ctx_emb, doc_emb, scores in tqdm(dataloader, desc=f"Training index {epoch_idx}"):
0233 |             ctx_emb = ctx_emb.to(self.device)
0234 |             doc_emb = doc_emb.to(self.device)
0235 |             scores = scores.to(self.device)
0236 | 
0237 |             outputs = model(ctx_emb, doc_emb)
0238 | 
0239 |             q_loss = F.mse_loss(outputs["q_value"], scores)
0240 | 
0241 |             v_loss = (
0242 |                 self._expectile_loss(
0243 |                     scores - outputs["state_value"], tau=self.expectile_tau
0244 |                 )
0245 |                 if self.use_qmax
0246 |                 else torch.tensor(0.0, device=self.device)
0247 |             )
0248 | 
0249 |             pi_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=self.device)
0250 |             if self.use_gild and "action_logits" in outputs:
0251 |                 advantage = (
0252 |                     outputs["q_value"] - outputs["state_value"]
0253 |                 ).detach()
0254 |                 weights = torch.exp(self.beta * advantage)
0255 |                 weights = weights / weights.sum()
0256 | 
0257 |                 # Corrected reshape
0258 |                 weights = weights.unsqueeze(-1)  # Ensure (batch_size, 1)
0259 | 
0260 |                 log_probs = F.log_softmax(outputs["action_logits"], dim=-1)
0261 |                 pi_loss = -(log_probs * weights).mean()
0262 | 
0263 |                 # Optional entropy regularization
0264 |                 entropy = -(log_probs.exp() * log_probs).sum(dim=-1).mean()
0265 |                 pi_loss += self.entropy_weight * entropy
0266 | 
0267 |             loss = (
0268 |                 q_loss * self.cfg.get("q_weight", 1.0)
0269 |                 + v_loss * self.cfg.get("v_weight", 0.5)
0270 |                 + pi_loss * self.cfg.get("pi_weight", 0.3)
0271 |             )
0272 | 
0273 |             self.optimizer.zero_grad()
0274 |             loss.backward()
0275 |             torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 0.5)
0276 |             self.optimizer.step()
0277 | 
0278 |             total_q_loss += q_loss.item() * ctx_emb.size(0)
0279 |             total_v_loss += v_loss.item() * ctx_emb.size(0)
0280 |             total_pi_loss += pi_loss.item() * ctx_emb.size(0)
0281 |             count += ctx_emb.size(0)
0282 | 
0283 |         avg_q = total_q_loss / count
0284 |         avg_v = total_v_loss / count
0285 |         avg_pi = total_pi_loss / count
0286 | 
0287 |         if self.use_qmax:
0288 |             self.scheduler["q"].step(avg_q)
0289 |         if self.use_gild:
0290 |             self.scheduler["pi"].step(avg_pi)
0291 | 
0292 |         return {"q": avg_q, "v": avg_v, "pi": avg_pi, "total": loss.item()}
0293 | 
0294 |     def _expectile_loss(self, diff, tau=0.7):
0295 |         """Compute expectile loss for V-head"""
0296 |         return torch.where(
0297 |             diff > 0, tau * diff.pow(2), (1 - tau) * diff.pow(2)
0298 |         ).mean()
0299 | 
0300 |     def _should_stop_early(self, current_avg):
0301 |         """Check for early stopping"""
0302 |         if not self.use_early_stopping:
0303 |             return False
0304 | 
0305 |         if current_avg < self.best_loss - self.early_stopping_min_delta:
0306 |             self.best_loss = current_avg
0307 |             self.early_stop_counter = 0
0308 |         else:
0309 |             self.early_stop_counter += 1
0310 | 
0311 |         return self.early_stop_counter >= self.early_stopping_patience
0312 | 
0313 |     def _validate_tensor(self, tensor, name):
0314 |         """Validate tensor before use"""
0315 |         if tensor is None:
0316 |             self.logger.log(
0317 |                 "InvalidTensor",
0318 |                 {"tensor_name": name, "reason": "tensor_is_none"},
0319 |             )
0320 |             return False
0321 | 
0322 |         if torch.isnan(tensor).any():
0323 |             self.logger.log(
0324 |                 "NaNInTensor", {"tensor_name": name, "tensor": tensor.tolist()}
0325 |             )
0326 |             return False
0327 | 
0328 |         return True
0329 | 
0330 |     def _calculate_policy_logits(self, model):
0331 |         """Calculate policy logits from policy head weights"""
0332 |         with torch.no_grad():
0333 |             policy_weights = model.pi_head.get_policy_weights()
0334 |             policy_probs = F.softmax(policy_weights, dim=-1)
0335 |             return policy_probs.tolist()
0336 | 
0337 |     def _calculate_policy_stability(self, policy_logits):
0338 |         """Calculate policy stability from logits"""
0339 |         if not policy_logits:
0340 |             return 0.0
0341 |         policy_probs = F.softmax(torch.tensor(policy_logits), dim=-1)
0342 |         return policy_probs.max().item()
0343 | 
0344 |     def _calculate_policy_entropy(self, policy_logits):
0345 |         """Calculate policy entropy for versioning"""
0346 |         if not policy_logits:
0347 |             return 0.0
0348 |         policy_probs = F.softmax(torch.tensor(policy_logits), dim=-1)
0349 |         return (
0350 |             -torch.sum(policy_probs * torch.log(policy_probs + 1e-8), dim=-1)
0351 |             .mean()
0352 |             .item()
0353 |         )

0355 |     def train(self, samples, dim):
0356 |         """
0357 |         Train SICQL model for a dimension
0358 |         Args:
0359 |             samples: List of training samples
0360 |             dim: Dimension to train
0361 |         Returns:
0362 |             Training statistics and model
0363 |         """
0364 |         self.logger.log("DimensionTrainingStarted", {"dimension": dim})
0365 | 
0366 |         # Prepare data
0367 |         dataloader = self._create_sicql_dataloader(samples)
0368 |         if not dataloader:
0369 |             return {"error": "insufficient_data", "dimension": dim}
0370 | 
0371 |         # Build model
0372 |         model = self._build_model(dim)
0373 |         model.train()
0374 | 
0375 |         # Optimizer for all heads
0376 |         self.optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=self.lr)
0377 |         self.scheduler = {
0378 |             "q": ReduceLROnPlateau(
0379 |                 self.optimizer, mode="min", factor=0.5, patience=2
0380 |             ),
0381 |             "v": ReduceLROnPlateau(
0382 |                 self.optimizer, mode="min", factor=0.5, patience=2
0383 |             ),
0384 |             "pi": ReduceLROnPlateau(
0385 |                 self.optimizer, mode="min", factor=0.5, patience=2
0386 |             ),
0387 |         }
0388 | 
0389 |         # Training stats
0390 |         stats = {
0391 |             "q_losses": [],
0392 |             "v_losses": [],
0393 |             "pi_losses": [],
0394 |             "policy_entropies": [],
0395 |             "avg_q_loss": 0.0,
0396 |             "avg_v_loss": 0.0,
0397 |             "avg_pi_loss": 0.0,
0398 |             "policy_entropy": 0.0,
0399 |             "policy_stability": 0.0,
0400 |         }
0401 | 
0402 |         # Training loop
0403 |         losses = []
0404 |         best = float("inf")
0405 |         wait = 0
0406 | 
0407 |         epoch_iter = self.progress(range(1, self.epochs + 1), desc=f"SICQL[{dim}] epochs", leave=False)
0408 |         for epoch in epoch_iter:
0409 |             epoch_stats = self._train_epoch(model, dataloader, epoch_idx=epoch)
0410 |             q_avg = float(epoch_stats["q"])
0411 |             v_avg = float(epoch_stats["v"])
0412 |             pi_avg = float(epoch_stats["pi"])
0413 |             losses.append(q_avg)
0414 | 
0415 |             # record per-epoch stats
0416 |             stats["q_losses"].append(q_avg)
0417 |             stats["v_losses"].append(v_avg)
0418 |             stats["pi_losses"].append(pi_avg)
0419 | 
0420 |             # policy entropy snapshot (optional but helpful)
0421 |             try:
0422 |                 with torch.no_grad():
0423 |                     w = model.pi_head.get_policy_weights()
0424 |                     p = F.softmax(w, dim=-1)
0425 |                     entropy = float(-(p * torch.log(p + 1e-8)).sum())
0426 |                 stats["policy_entropies"].append(entropy)
0427 |             except Exception:
0428 |                 pass
0429 | 
0430 |             # update epoch bar
0431 |             self.progress_postfix(
0432 |                 epoch_iter, q=q_avg, v=v_avg, pi=pi_avg,
0433 |                 best=(best if best < float("inf") else q_avg)
0434 |             )
0435 | 
0436 |             # (optional) step schedulers on epoch metrics
0437 |             try:
0438 |                 self.scheduler["q"].step(q_avg)
0439 |                 self.scheduler["v"].step(v_avg)
0440 |                 self.scheduler["pi"].step(pi_avg)
0441 |             except Exception:
0442 |                 pass
0443 | 
0444 |             # single early-stopper
0445 |             if q_avg < best - self.early_stopping_min_delta:
0446 |                 best, wait = q_avg, 0
0447 |             else:
0448 |                 wait += 1
0449 |                 if self.use_early_stopping and wait >= self.early_stopping_patience:
0450 |                     self.logger.log("SICQLEarlyStopping", {"epoch": epoch, "best_loss": best})
0451 |                     break
0452 | 
0453 |             # per-epoch log
0454 |             self.logger.log("SICQLTrainingEpoch", {
0455 |                 "epoch": epoch, "q_loss": q_avg, "v_loss": v_avg, "pi_loss": pi_avg
0456 |             })
0457 | 
0458 |         # Final stats (guard against empty lists)
0459 |         stats["avg_q_loss"] = float(np.mean(stats["q_losses"])) if stats["q_losses"] else float("nan")
0460 |         stats["avg_v_loss"] = float(np.mean(stats["v_losses"])) if stats["v_losses"] else float("nan")
0461 |         stats["avg_pi_loss"] = float(np.mean(stats["pi_losses"])) if stats["pi_losses"] else float("nan")
0462 |         stats["policy_entropy"] = float(np.mean(stats["policy_entropies"])) if stats["policy_entropies"] else float("nan")
0463 |         stats["policy_stability"] = (
0464 |             max(stats["policy_entropies"]) if stats["policy_entropies"] else float("nan")
0465 |         )
0466 | 
0467 |         # Save model
0468 |         meta = self._save_model(model, dim, stats)
0469 |         stats.update(meta)
0470 | 
0471 |         # Log to database (match your method's signature)
0472 |         self._log_training_stats(dim, meta)
0473 | 
0474 |         self.logger.log("DimensionTrainingComplete", {
0475 |             "dimension": dim,
0476 |             "final_q_loss": stats["avg_q_loss"],
0477 |             "final_v_loss": stats["avg_v_loss"],
0478 |             "final_pi_loss": stats["avg_pi_loss"],
0479 |         })
0480 | 
0481 |         # Final stats
0482 |         stats["avg_q_loss"] = np.mean(stats["q_losses"])
0483 |         stats["avg_v_loss"] = np.mean(stats["v_losses"])
0484 |         stats["avg_pi_loss"] = np.mean(stats["pi_losses"])
0485 |         stats["policy_entropy"] = np.mean(stats["policy_entropies"])
0486 |         stats["policy_stability"] = (
0487 |             max(stats["policy_entropies"])
0488 |             if stats["policy_entropies"]
0489 |             else 0.0
0490 |         )
0491 | 
0492 |         # Save model
0493 |         meta = self._save_model(model, dim, stats)
0494 |         stats.update(meta)
0495 | 
0496 |         # Log to database
0497 |         self._log_training_stats(dim, meta, samples=samples, dataloader=dataloader)
0498 | 
0499 |         self.logger.log(
0500 |             "DimensionTrainingComplete",
0501 |             {
0502 |                 "dimension": dim,
0503 |                 "final_q_loss": stats["avg_q_loss"],
0504 |                 "final_v_loss": stats["avg_v_loss"],
0505 |                 "final_pi_loss": stats["avg_pi_loss"],
0506 |             },
0507 |         )
0508 | 
0509 |         # Cache model
0510 |         self.models[dim] = model
0511 |         return stats
