```python
0513 |     def _log_training_stats(
0514 |         self,
0515 |         dim: str,
0516 |         meta: dict,
0517 |         *,
0518 |         samples: list | None = None,
0519 |         dataloader=None,
0520 |         pipeline_run_id: int | None = None,
0521 |         goal_id: int | None = None,
0522 |         model_version_id: int | None = None,
0523 |     ):
0524 |         """
0525 |         Log SICQL training stats using TrainingStats.add_from_result schema.
0526 | 
0527 |         Expects in `meta` (already computed in `train`):
0528 |         - avg_q_loss, avg_v_loss, avg_pi_loss
0529 |         - policy_entropy, policy_stability, policy_logits
0530 |         - (optionally) last_q_loss, last_v_loss, last_pi_loss
0531 |         - version (required)
0532 |         """
0533 | 
0534 |         # Derive counts
0535 |         sample_count = len(samples) if samples is not None else 0
0536 |         valid_samples = 0
0537 |         if dataloader is not None and getattr(dataloader, "dataset", None) is not None:
0538 |             try:
0539 |                 valid_samples = len(dataloader.dataset)
0540 |             except Exception:
0541 |                 valid_samples = 0
0542 |         invalid_samples = max(sample_count - valid_samples, 0) if sample_count else 0
0543 | 
0544 |         # Per-epoch “last” losses are optional—fall back to averages
0545 |         stats_payload = {
0546 |             "q_loss":      meta.get("last_q_loss", meta.get("avg_q_loss")),
0547 |             "v_loss":      meta.get("last_v_loss", meta.get("avg_v_loss")),
0548 |             "pi_loss":     meta.get("last_pi_loss", meta.get("avg_pi_loss")),
0549 |             "avg_q_loss":  meta.get("avg_q_loss"),
0550 |             "avg_v_loss":  meta.get("avg_v_loss"),
0551 |             "avg_pi_loss": meta.get("avg_pi_loss"),
0552 |             "policy_entropy":   meta.get("policy_entropy"),
0553 |             "policy_stability": meta.get("policy_stability"),
0554 |             "policy_logits":    meta.get("policy_logits"),
0555 |         }
0556 | 
0557 |         self.memory.training_stats.add_from_result(
0558 |             stats=stats_payload,
0559 |             model_type="sicql",
0560 |             target_type=self.target_type,
0561 |             dimension=dim,
0562 |             version=meta["version"],
0563 |             embedding_type=self.embedding_type,
0564 |             config={
0565 |                 "lr": self.lr,
0566 |                 "epochs": self.epochs,
0567 |                 "batch_size": self.batch_size,
0568 |                 "use_tuner": self.use_tuner,
0569 |                 "use_early_stopping": self.use_early_stopping,
0570 |                 "patience": self.early_stopping_patience,
0571 |                 "min_delta": self.early_stopping_min_delta,
0572 |                 "dim": self.dim,
0573 |                 "hdim": self.hdim,
0574 |                 "expectile_tau": getattr(self, "expectile_tau", 0.7),
0575 |                 "use_gild": getattr(self, "use_gild", True),
0576 |                 "beta": getattr(self, "beta", 1.0),
0577 |                 "entropy_weight": getattr(self, "entropy_weight", 0.01),
0578 |                 "use_qmax": getattr(self, "use_qmax", True),
0579 |             },
0580 |             sample_count=sample_count,
0581 |             valid_samples=valid_samples,
0582 |             invalid_samples=invalid_samples,
0583 |             goal_id=goal_id,
0584 |             model_version_id=model_version_id,
0585 |             start_time=meta.get("start_time"),      # if you stored it
0586 |             end_time=meta.get("end_time"),          # if you stored it
0587 |             pipeline_run_id=pipeline_run_id,
0588 |         )

0590 | 
0591 |     def _train_sicql(self, model, dataloader, output_dir):
0592 |         """Train SICQL model with all heads"""
0593 |         model.train()
0594 |         best_loss = float("inf")
0595 |         patience_counter = 0
0596 | 
0597 |         # Build optimizers
0598 |         optimizers = {
0599 |             "encoder": optim.Adam(model.encoder.parameters(), lr=self.lr, weight_decay=1e-5),
0600 |             "q_head": optim.Adam(model.q_head.parameters(), lr=self.lr, weight_decay=1e-5),
0601 |             "v_head": optim.Adam(model.v_head.parameters(), lr=self.lr, weight_decay=1e-5),
0602 |             "pi_head": optim.Adam(model.pi_head.parameters(), lr=self.lr, weight_decay=1e-5),
0603 |         }
0604 | 
0605 |         # Build schedulers
0606 |         self.scheduler = {
0607 |             "encoder": ReduceLROnPlateau(
0608 |                 optimizers["encoder"], mode="min", factor=0.5, patience=2
0609 |             ),
0610 |             "q_head": ReduceLROnPlateau(
0611 |                 optimizers["q_head"], mode="min", factor=0.5, patience=2
0612 |             ),
0613 |             "v_head": ReduceLROnPlateau(

0778 |     def run(self, context: dict) -> dict:

0802 |     def _get_samples(self, context, documents, dim):

0813 |                         "output": scorable.text,

0815 |                     }

0817 |         return samples
0818 | 
0819 |     def _update_belief_cartridge(self, context, dim, stats):

0821 |         policy_logits = stats.get("policy_logits", [0.3, 0.7, 0.0])
```

```python
0220 |             if "x" in s and "y" in s and "z" in s and "target" in s:
0221 |                 _push(s["x"], s["y"], s["target"], z_text=s.get("z"), halt_t=s.get("halt_target", 1.0), slen=s.get("seq_len", 0))
0222 |                 continue
0223 | 
0224 |             # Singleton (SICQL/MRQ style)
0225 |             title = (s.get("goal_text") or s.get("title") or "").strip()
0226 |             if "output" in s and ("score" in s or "target_score" in s):
0227 |                 out = (s.get("scorable_text") or s.get("output") or "").strip()
0228 |                 val = s.get("target_score", s.get("score"))
0229 |                 if title and out and (val is not None):
0230 |                     _push(title, out, val, z_text=title)
0231 |                 else:
0232 |                     dropped += 1
0233 |                 continue
0234 | 
0235 |             # Pairwise
0236 |             if all(k in s for k in ("output_a","output_b","value_a","value_b")):
0237 |                 a_out = (s.get("output_a") or "").strip()
0238 |                 b_out = (s.get("output_b") or "").strip()
0239 |                 a_val = s.get("value_a")
0240 |                 b_val = s.get("value_b")
0241 |                 if title:
0242 |                     if a_out and a_val is not None:
0243 |                         _push(title, a_out, a_val, z_text=title)
0244 |                     if b_out and b_val is not None:
0245 |                         _push(title, b_out, b_val, z_text=title)
0246 |                 else:
0247 |                     dropped += 1
0248 |                 continue
0249 | 
0250 |             # HRM/raw
0251 |             if ("goal_text" in s and "scorable_text" in s and ("target_score" in s or "score" in s)):
0252 |                 out = (s.get("scorable_text") or "").strip()
0253 |                 val = s.get("target_score", s.get("score"))
0254 |                 _push(title, out, val, z_text=title)
0255 |                 continue
0256 | 
0257 |             dropped += 1
0258 | 
0259 |             if use_tqdm:
0260 |                 it.set_postfix(kept=kept, drop=dropped)
0261 | 
0262 |         if use_tqdm and hasattr(it, "close"):
0263 |             it.close()
0264 | 
0265 |         # Log label distribution for analysis
0266 |         if self.logger and self.log_label_histogram:
0267 |             exact = {int(k): int(v) for k, v in sorted(label_counts.items())}
0268 |             bucketed = self._bucketize_counts(label_counts, self.label_hist_bucket)
0269 |             self.logger.log("TinyPlusLabelHistogram", {
0270 |                 "kept": int(kept), "dropped": int(dropped),
0271 |                 "exact": exact, "bucket_size": int(self.label_hist_bucket),
0272 |                 "bucketed": bucketed
0273 |             })
0274 | 
0275 |         if kept < self.min_samples:
0276 |             return None, kept, dropped
0277 | 
0278 |         # Create TensorDataset and DataLoader
0279 |         dataset = TensorDataset(
0280 |             torch.stack(xs), torch.stack(ys), torch.stack(zs),
0281 |             torch.tensor(y01, dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device).unsqueeze(-1),
0282 |             torch.tensor(halt_targets, dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device).unsqueeze(-1),
0283 |             torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int32, device=self.device),
0284 |         )
0285 |         loader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=self.batch_size, shuffle=True)
0286 |         return loader, kept, dropped
0287 | 
0288 |     # ------------------------------
0289 |     # Loss Functions
0290 |     # ------------------------------
0291 | 
0292 |     @staticmethod
0293 |     def _heteroscedastic_regression_loss(score: torch.Tensor, target01: torch.Tensor, log_var: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
0294 |         """
0295 |         Compute heteroscedastic regression loss with uncertainty estimation.
0296 |         
0297 |         This loss adapts to the uncertainty in predictions by learning
0298 |         a variance term that scales the regression loss.
0299 |         
0300 |         Args:
0301 |             score: Predicted scores [B, 1]
0302 |             target01: Ground truth scores in [0, 1] [B, 1]
0303 |             log_var: Learned log variance [B, 1]
0304 |             
0305 |         Returns:
0306 |             Scalar loss value
0307 |         """
0308 |         log_var = log_var.clamp(-5.0, 5.0)  # defensive clamp to avoid precision explosion
0309 |         inv_var = torch.exp(-log_var)
0310 |         diff2   = (score - target01).pow(2)
0311 |         return (inv_var * diff2 + log_var).mean()
0312 | 
0313 |     @staticmethod
0314 |     def _cosine_recon_loss(y_recon: torch.Tensor, y_true: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
0315 |         """
0316 |         Compute cosine reconstruction loss.
0317 |         
0318 |         Measures how well the model can reconstruct the input embedding,
0319 |         encouraging meaningful internal representations.
0320 |         
0321 |         Args:
0322 |             y_recon: Reconstructed embedding
0323 |             y_true: Original embedding
0324 |             
0325 |         Returns:
0326 |             Cosine distance loss in range [0, 1]
0327 |         """
0328 |         # 1 - cosine in [0,2] → clamp to [0,1]
0329 |         cos = F.cosine_similarity(y_recon, y_true, dim=-1, eps=1e-8).unsqueeze(-1)
0330 |         return (1 - cos).clamp(0, 1).mean()
0331 | 
0332 |     # ------------------------------
0333 |     # Epoch training
0334 |     # ------------------------------
0335 | 
0336 |     def _train_epoch(self, model: TinyModel, dataloader: DataLoader, epoch_idx: int) -> float:
0337 |         """
0338 |         Train model for one epoch.
0339 |         
0340 |         Args:
0341 |             model: TinyRecursionModel instance
0342 |             dataloader: Training data loader
0343 |             epoch_idx: Current epoch index
0344 |             
0345 |         Returns:
0346 |             Average training loss for the epoch
0347 |         """
0348 |         model.train()
0349 |         total_loss = 0.0
0350 |         count = 0
0351 | 
0352 |         use_tqdm = bool(self.show_progress and tqdm is not None)
0353 |         it = tqdm(dataloader, desc=f"Epoch {epoch_idx}", unit="batch", leave=False) if use_tqdm else dataloader
0354 | 
0355 |         for step, batch in enumerate(it, start=1):
0356 |             x, y, z, target01, halt_target, seq_len = batch
0357 | 
0358 |             # Forward pass with auxiliary outputs
0359 |             logits, halt_logits, _, aux = model(x, y, z, seq_len=seq_len, return_aux=True)
0360 | 
0361 |             # Main loss: heteroscedastic regression on score/log_var
0362 |             L_main = self._heteroscedastic_regression_loss(aux["score"], target01, aux["log_var"])
0363 | 
0364 |             # Auxiliary losses for multi-objective training
0365 |             buckets = _bucket3(target01.squeeze(-1))
0366 |             L_aux3  = F.cross_entropy(aux["aux3_logits"], buckets)  # 3-class classification
0367 |             L_dis   = F.smooth_l1_loss(aux["disagree_hat"], (target01 - aux["score"].detach()).abs())  # Disagreement prediction
0368 |             L_recon = self._cosine_recon_loss(aux["y_recon"], y)  # Reconstruction quality
0369 |             L_cons  = F.mse_loss(aux["consistency_hat"], aux["consistency_target"])  # Consistency regularization
0370 | 
0371 |             # Optional losses (weight=0 means disabled)
0372 |             L_sae = torch.zeros((), device=self.device)
0373 |             if self.w_sae_recon > 0.0 and "concept_vec" in aux:
0374 |                 L_sae = aux["concept_vec"].abs().mean()  # Sparse autoencoder reconstruction
0375 | 
0376 |             L_ood = torch.zeros((), device=self.device)
0377 |             if self.w_ood > 0.0 and "ood_hat" in aux:
0378 |                 L_ood = F.binary_cross_entropy(aux["ood_hat"], torch.ones_like(aux["ood_hat"]))  # OOD detection
0379 | 
0380 |             L_halt = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(halt_logits.unsqueeze(-1), halt_target)  # Halting regularization
0381 | 
0382 |             # Check components for finiteness & sanity
0383 |             all_terms = torch.stack([
0384 |                 L_main.detach(),
0385 |                 L_aux3.detach(),
0386 |                 L_dis.detach(),
0387 |                 L_recon.detach(),
0388 |                 L_cons.detach(),
0389 |                 L_sae.detach(),
0390 |                 L_ood.detach(),
0391 |                 L_halt.detach()
0392 |             ])
0393 |             if (not torch.isfinite(all_terms).all()) or (all_terms.abs().max() > 1e6):
0394 |                 if self.logger:
0395 |                     self.logger.log("TinyPlusNaNBatch", {
0396 |                         "epoch": epoch_idx,
0397 |                         "step": step,
0398 |                         "any_nan": bool(not torch.isfinite(all_terms).all()),
0399 |                         "max_abs": float(all_terms.abs().max().item())
0400 |                     })
0401 |                 self.optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
0402 |                 continue  # skip this batch
0403 | 
0404 |             # Combined loss with weighting
0405 |             loss = (
0406 |                 L_main
0407 |                 + self.w_aux3 * L_aux3
0408 |                 + self.w_disagree * L_dis
0409 |                 + self.w_recon * L_recon
0410 |                 + self.w_cons * L_cons
0411 |                 + self.w_sae_recon * L_sae
0412 |                 + self.w_ood * L_ood
0413 |                 + self.halt_lambda * L_halt
0414 |             )
0415 | 
0416 |             if (not torch.isfinite(loss)) or (abs(loss.item()) > 1e7):
0417 |                 if self.logger:
0418 |                     self.logger.log("TinyPlusUnstableLoss", {
0419 |                         "epoch": epoch_idx,
0420 |                         "step": step,
0421 |                         "loss": float(loss.item()) if torch.isfinite(loss) else float('nan')
0422 |                     })
0423 |                 self.optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
0424 |                 continue
0425 | 
0426 |             # Backward pass with gradient clipping
0427 |             self.optimizer.zero_grad()
0428 |             loss.backward()
0429 |             torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), self.grad_clip)
0430 |             self.optimizer.step()
0431 | 
0432 |             bsz = x.size(0)
0433 |             total_loss += loss.item() * bsz
0434 |             count += bsz
0435 | 
0436 |             # Progress reporting
0437 |             if use_tqdm:
0438 |                 it.set_postfix(loss=f"{loss.item():.4f}")
0439 |             elif self.logger and (step % self.log_every_steps == 0):
0440 |                 self.logger.log("TinyPlusBatch", {
0441 |                     "epoch": epoch_idx,
0442 |                     "step": step,
0443 |                     "loss": float(loss.item()),
0444 |                     "L_main": float(L_main.item()),
0445 |                     "L_aux3": float(L_aux3.item()),
0446 |                     "L_dis": float(L_dis.item()),
0447 |                     "L_recon": float(L_recon.item()),
0448 |                     "L_cons": float(L_cons.item()),
0449 |                     "L_sae": float(L_sae.item()),
0450 |                     "L_ood": float(L_ood.item()),
0451 |                     "L_halt": float(L_halt.item()),
0452 |                 })
0453 | 
0454 |         if use_tqdm and hasattr(it, "close"):
0455 |             it.close()
0456 | 
0457 |         return total_loss / max(1, count)
0458 | 
0459 |     # ------------------------------
0460 |     # Validation
0461 |     # ------------------------------
0462 | 
0463 |     @torch.no_grad()
0464 |     def _validate(self, model: TinyModel, dataloader: Optional[DataLoader]) -> Dict[str, float]:
0465 |         """
0466 |         Run validation and compute comprehensive metrics.
0467 |         
0468 |         Args:
0469 |             model: Model to validate
0470 |             dataloader: Validation data loader
0471 |             
0472 |         Returns:
0473 |             Dictionary of validation metrics
0474 |         """
0475 |         if not dataloader:
0476 |             return {}
0477 | 
0478 |         model.eval()
0479 |         scores, targets = [], []
0480 |         # 10 metric lists for comprehensive validation
0481 |         entropies, uncerts, disagree, recon_sim, cons_hat, temp01, jac, spars, ood, len_eff = (
0482 |             [] for _ in range(10)
0483 |         )
0484 | 
0485 |         for x, y, z, target01, _, seq_len in dataloader:
0486 |             _, _, _, aux = model(x, y, z, seq_len=seq_len, return_aux=True)
0487 |             s = aux["score"].detach().cpu().view(-1)
0488 |             t = target01.detach().cpu().view(-1)
0489 | 
0490 |             scores.append(s)
0491 |             targets.append(t)
0492 |             # Collect various auxiliary metrics for analysis
0493 |             entropies.append(aux["entropy_aux"].detach().cpu().view(-1))
0494 |             uncerts.append(aux["uncertainty"].detach().cpu().view(-1))
0495 |             disagree.append(aux["disagree_hat"].detach().cpu().view(-1))
0496 |             recon_sim.append(aux["recon_sim"].detach().cpu().view(-1))
0497 |             cons_hat.append(aux["consistency_hat"].detach().cpu().view(-1))
0498 |             temp01.append(aux["temp01"].detach().cpu().view(-1))
0499 |             jac.append(aux["jacobian_fd"].detach().cpu().view(-1))
0500 |             spars.append(aux["concept_sparsity"].detach().cpu().view(-1))
0501 |             ood.append(aux["ood_hat"].detach().cpu().view(-1))
0502 |             len_eff.append(aux["len_effect"].detach().cpu().view(-1))
0503 | 
0504 |         s = torch.cat(scores); t = torch.cat(targets)
0505 |         mae = F.l1_loss(s, t).item()
0506 |         rmse = torch.sqrt(F.mse_loss(s, t)).item()
0507 | 
0508 |         def mean_cat(arrs):
0509 |             """Helper to compute mean of concatenated tensor list."""
0510 |             return float(torch.cat(arrs).mean().item()) if arrs else 0.0
0511 | 
0512 |         return {
0513 |             "mae": mae,
0514 |             "rmse": rmse,
0515 |             "entropy_aux_mean":     mean_cat(entropies),
0516 |             "uncertainty_mean":     mean_cat(uncerts),
0517 |             "disagree_hat_mean":    mean_cat(disagree),
0518 |             "recon_sim_mean":       mean_cat(recon_sim),
0519 |             "consistency_hat_mean": mean_cat(cons_hat),
0520 |             "temp01_mean":          mean_cat(temp01),
0521 |             "jacobian_fd_mean":     mean_cat(jac),
0522 |             "concept_sparsity_mean":mean_cat(spars),
0523 |             "ood_hat_mean":         mean_cat(ood),
0524 |             "len_effect_mean":      mean_cat(len_eff),
0525 |         }

0527 |     # ------------------------------
0528 |     # Train/val split
0529 |     # ------------------------------
0530 | 
0531 |     def _create_train_val_split(self, samples: List[Dict[str, Any]]):
0532 |         """
0533 |         Split samples into training and validation sets.
0534 |         
0535 |         Args:
0536 |             samples: List of sample dictionaries
0537 |             
0538 |         Returns:
0539 |             Tuple of (train_samples, val_samples)
0540 |         """
0541 |         if not samples:
0542 |             return [], []
0543 |         if self.validation_ratio <= 0 or len(samples) < 10:
0544 |             return samples, []
0545 |         g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(self.seed)
0546 |         idx = torch.randperm(len(samples), generator=g).tolist()
0547 |         split = int(len(samples) * (1 - self.validation_ratio))
0548 |         return [samples[i] for i in idx[:split]], [samples[i] for i in idx[split:]]
0549 | 
0550 |     # ------------------------------
0551 |     # Main train loop (per dimension)
0552 |     # ------------------------------
0553 | 
0554 |     def train(self, samples, dimension):
0555 |         """
0556 |         Main training loop for a specific quality dimension.
0557 |         
0558 |         Args:
0559 |             samples: Training samples for the dimension
0560 |             dimension: Quality dimension name
0561 |             
0562 |         Returns:
0563 |             Training results dictionary
0564 |         """
0565 |         # Split data
0566 |         train_samples, val_samples = self._create_train_val_split(samples)
0567 | 
0568 |         # Create data loaders
0569 |         dataloader, kept, dropped = self._create_dataloader(train_samples)
0570 |         val_loader, val_kept, val_dropped = (None, 0, 0)
0571 |         if val_samples:
0572 |             val_loader, val_kept, val_dropped = self._create_dataloader(val_samples)
0573 | 
0574 |         if not dataloader:
0575 |             return {"error": "insufficient_data", "kept": kept, "dropped": dropped}
0576 | 
0577 |         # Optimizer
0578 |         self.optimizer = optim.AdamW(self.model.parameters(), lr=self.lr, weight_decay=1e-2)
0579 | 
0580 |         best_metric = float("inf")
0581 |         patience, wait = int(self.cfg.get("patience", 3)), 0
0582 |         train_losses: List[float] = []
0583 |         saved_best = False
0584 | 
0585 |         locator = self.get_locator(dimension)  # create once; base_path will be ensured
0586 | 
0587 |         # Training loop with early stopping
0588 |         for epoch in range(1, self.epochs + 1):
0589 |             avg_loss = self._train_epoch(self.model, dataloader, epoch_idx=epoch)
0590 |             avg_loss = float(avg_loss)
0591 |             # Ensure epoch loss is finite for serialization/meta
0592 |             if not math.isfinite(avg_loss):
0593 |                 avg_loss = float(train_losses[-1]) if train_losses else 0.0
0594 |                 if self.logger:
0595 |                     self.logger.log("TinyPlusNaNEpoch", {"epoch": epoch})
0596 |             train_losses.append(avg_loss)
0597 | 
0598 |             # Validation
0599 |             val_metrics = self._validate(self.model, val_loader) if val_loader else {}
0600 |             if self.logger:
0601 |                 payload = {"epoch": epoch, "train_loss": float(avg_loss)}
0602 |                 payload.update({f"val_{k}": v for k, v in val_metrics.items()})
0603 |                 self.logger.log("TinyPlusEpoch", payload)
0604 | 
0605 |             # Early stopping metric: prefer val MAE, fallback to train loss
0606 |             stop_metric = val_metrics.get("mae", avg_loss) if val_metrics else avg_loss
0607 |             if not math.isfinite(stop_metric):
0608 |                 if self.logger:
0609 |                     self.logger.log("TinyPlusNonFiniteMetric", {"epoch": epoch})
0610 |                 stop_metric = float("inf")
0611 | 
0612 |             improved = (not math.isfinite(best_metric)) or (stop_metric < best_metric - 1e-6)
0613 |             if improved:
0614 |                 best_metric = stop_metric
0615 |                 wait = 0
0616 |                 best_path = locator.model_file(suffix="_tiny.pt")
0617 |                 try:
0618 |                     torch.save(self.model.state_dict(), best_path)
0619 |                     saved_best = True
0620 |                     if self.logger:
0621 |                         self.logger.log("TinyPlusSaveCheckpoint", {"epoch": epoch, "path": best_path, "metric": float(best_metric)})
0622 |                 except Exception as e:
0623 |                     if self.logger:
0624 |                         self.logger.log("TinyPlusSaveError", {"epoch": epoch, "path": best_path, "error": str(e)})
0625 |             else:
0626 |                 wait += 1
0627 |                 if wait >= patience:
0628 |                     if self.logger:
0629 |                         self.logger.log("TinyPlusEarlyStopping", {"epoch": epoch, "best_metric": float(best_metric)})
0630 |                     break
0631 | 
0632 |         # ---- ALWAYS save a 'last' checkpoint ----
0633 |         last_path = locator.model_file(suffix="_tiny_last.pt")
0634 |         try:
0635 |             torch.save(self.model.state_dict(), last_path)
0636 |             if self.logger:
0637 |                 self.logger.log("TinyPlusSaveLast", {"path": last_path})
0638 |         except Exception as e:
0639 |             if self.logger:
0640 |                 self.logger.log("TinyPlusSaveLastError", {"path": last_path, "error": str(e)})
0641 | 
0642 |         # If no 'best' was saved during training, backfill it now:
0643 |         best_path = locator.model_file(suffix="_tiny.pt")
0644 |         if not saved_best or not os.path.exists(best_path):
0645 |             try:
0646 |                 torch.save(self.model.state_dict(), best_path)
0647 |                 if self.logger:
0648 |                     self.logger.log("TinyPlusBackfillBest", {"path": best_path})
0649 |             except Exception as e:
0650 |                 if self.logger:
0651 |                     self.logger.log("TinyPlusBackfillBestError", {"path": best_path, "error": str(e)})
0652 | 
0653 |         # --- Save training metadata -------------------------------------------
0654 |         safe_config = {
0655 |             "lr": self.lr,
0656 |             "epochs": self.epochs,
0657 |             "batch_size": self.batch_size,
0658 |             "halt_lambda": self.halt_lambda,
0659 |             "n_layers": self.cfg.get("n_layers", 2),
0660 |             "n_recursions": self.n_recursions,
0661 |             "use_attention": self.use_attention,
0662 |             "dropout": self.dropout,
0663 |             "seed": self.seed,
0664 |             "vocab_size": int(self.cfg.get("vocab_size", 101)),
0665 |             "w_aux3": self.w_aux3,
0666 |             "w_disagree": self.w_disagree,
0667 |             "w_recon": self.w_recon,
0668 |             "w_consistency": self.w_cons,
0669 |             "w_sae_recon": self.w_sae_recon,
0670 |             "w_ood": self.w_ood,
0671 |             "grad_clip": self.grad_clip,
0672 |         }
0673 | 
0674 |         # Ensure train_loss_curve is finite-only floats
0675 |         finite_curve = []
0676 |         last_finite = 0.0
0677 |         for v in train_losses:
0678 |             if math.isfinite(v):
0679 |                 last_finite = float(v)
0680 |             finite_curve.append(float(last_finite))
0681 | 
0682 |         meta = {
0683 |             "dimension": dimension,
0684 |             "model_type": "tiny_recursion",
0685 |             "expects_triplet": True,
0686 |             "embedding_type": self.embedding_type,
0687 |             "input_dim": self.dim,
0688 |             "concat_input_dim": self.dim * 2,
0689 |             "version": self.version,
0690 |             "epochs": self.epochs,
0691 |             "avg_loss": float(min(finite_curve or [best_metric])),
0692 |             "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
0693 |             "cfg": dict(self.cfg),
0694 |             "kept": int(kept),
0695 |             "best_metric": float(best_metric),
0696 |             "train_loss_curve": [float(x) for x in finite_curve],
0697 |             "dropped": int(dropped),
0698 |             "val_kept": int(val_kept),
0699 |             "val_dropped": int(val_dropped),
0700 |         }
0701 |         self._save_meta_file(meta, dimension)
0702 | 
0703 |         # TrainingStatsStore integration
0704 |         self.memory.training_stats.add_from_result(
0705 |             stats={
0706 |                 "avg_q_loss": float(min(finite_curve or [best_metric])),
0707 |                 "avg_loss":   float(min(finite_curve or [best_metric])),
0708 |             },
0709 |             model_type=self.model_type,
0710 |             target_type=self.target_type,
0711 |             dimension=dimension,
0712 |             version=self.version,
0713 |             embedding_type=self.embedding_type,
0714 |             config=safe_config,
0715 |             sample_count=len(samples),
0716 |             valid_samples=int(kept),
0717 |             invalid_samples=int(dropped),
0718 |             start_time=datetime.now(),
0719 |         )
0720 | 
0721 |         return {
0722 |             "best_metric": float(best_metric),
0723 |             "train_loss_curve": [float(x) for x in finite_curve],
0724 |             "kept": int(kept),
0725 |             "dropped": int(dropped),
0726 |             "val_kept": int(val_kept),
0727 |             "val_dropped": int(val_dropped),
0728 |         }

0731 |     # Helper Methods
0732 |     # ------------------------------
0733 | 
0734 |     def _bucketize_label(self, y: int) -> int:
0735 |         """
0736 |         Bucketize label for histogram analysis.
0737 |         
0738 |         If bucket_size > 0, map 0..100 → 0..num_bins-1 using fixed-width bins.
0739 |         Ensure vocab_size >= num_bins when you enable bucketing.
0740 |         
0741 |         Args:
0742 |             y: Original label value
0743 |             
0744 |         Returns:
0745 |             Bucket index
0746 |         """
0747 |         b = int(self.bucket_size)
0748 |         if b <= 0:
0749 |             return max(0, min(100, y))              # <<< clamp to 0..100
0750 |         num_bins = (101 + b - 1) // b               # e.g., b=10 -> 11 bins (0..10)
0751 |         yb = min(max(y, 0) // b, num_bins - 1)
0752 |         return yb
0753 | 
0754 |     def _bucketize_counts(self, counts: Counter, bucket: int) -> dict:
0755 |         """
0756 |         Convert exact label counts to bucketized counts for visualization.
0757 |         
0758 |         Args:
0759 |             counts: Counter of exact label values
0760 |             bucket: Bucket size
0761 |             
0762 |         Returns:
0763 |             Dictionary mapping bucket ranges to counts
0764 |         """
0765 |         if bucket <= 1:
0766 |             return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in sorted(counts.items())}
0767 | 
0768 |         buckets = {}
0769 |         for label, c in counts.items():
0770 |             try:
0771 |                 l = int(label)
0772 |             except Exception:
0773 |                 continue
0774 |             start = (l // bucket) * bucket
0775 |             end = min(100, start + bucket - 1)
0776 |             key = f"{start}-{end}"
0777 |             buckets[key] = buckets.get(key, 0) + int(c)
0778 | 
0779 |         # Ensure all possible buckets are represented
0780 |         start = 0
0781 |         while start <= 100:
0782 |             end = min(100, start + bucket - 1)
0783 |             key = f"{start}-{end}"
0784 |             buckets.setdefault(key, 0)
0785 |             start += bucket
0786 | 
0787 |         return dict(sorted(buckets.items(), key=lambda kv: int(kv[0].split('-')[0])))
```

```python
0019 |

0021 | def _get_viz(container):
0022 |     try:
0023 |         return container.get("vpm_visualization")
0024 |     except Exception:
0025 |         return None
0026 | 
0027 | # ---------------- Dataset ----------------
0028 | class VPMFrameDataset(Dataset):
0029 |     """
0030 |     Expects files under data_dir:
0031 |       frames/*.png or *.npy
0032 |       labels/*.json with {"reg":[...], "cls": int}
0033 |     If no labels found, will synthesize zeros.
0034 |     """
0035 |     def __init__(self, root: Path, in_ch: int = 1, patch: int = 8, mask_ratio: float = 0.15):
0036 |         self.root = Path(root)
0037 |         self.in_ch = in_ch
0038 |         self.patch = patch
0039 |         self.mask_ratio = float(mask_ratio)
0040 | 
0041 |         frame_dir = self.root / "frames"
0042 |         self.paths = sorted([p for p in frame_dir.glob("*.png")] + [p for p in frame_dir.glob("*.npy")])
0043 |         self.label_dir = self.root / "labels"
0044 | 
0045 |         if not self.paths:
0046 |             raise RuntimeError(f"No frames found under {frame_dir}")
0047 | 
0048 |     def __len__(self) -> int:
0049 |         return len(self.paths)
0050 | 
0051 |     def _load_frame(self, p: Path) -> np.ndarray:
0052 |         if p.suffix == ".npy":
0053 |             arr = np.load(p)
0054 |             # Expect (H,W) or (C,H,W)
0055 |             if arr.ndim == 2:
0056 |                 arr = arr[None, ...]   # (1,H,W)
0057 |             elif arr.ndim == 3 and arr.shape[0] not in (1,3):
0058 |                 # assume HWC
0059 |                 arr = np.transpose(arr, (2,0,1))
0060 |             return arr.astype(np.float32)
0061 |         else:
0062 |             img = Image.open(p)
0063 |             if self.in_ch == 1:
0064 |                 img = img.convert("L")
0065 |                 arr = np.array(img, dtype=np.float32)[None, ...]  # (1,H,W)
0066 |             else:
0067 |                 img = img.convert("RGB")
0068 |                 arr = np.transpose(np.array(img, dtype=np.float32), (2,0,1))  # (3,H,W)
0069 |             return arr
0070 | 
0071 |     def _load_label(self, p: Path) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, int]:
0072 |         j = (self.label_dir / (p.stem + ".json"))
0073 |         if j.exists():
0074 |             try:
0075 |                 obj = json.loads(j.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
0076 |                 reg = np.array(obj.get("reg", []), dtype=np.float32)
0077 |                 cls = int(obj.get("cls", 0))
0078 |                 return reg, cls
0079 |             except Exception:
0080 |                 pass
0081 |         return np.zeros((5,), dtype=np.float32), 0
0082 | 
0083 |     def __getitem__(self, idx: int):
0084 |         p = self.paths[idx]
0085 |         x = self._load_frame(p)
0086 |         if x.max() > 1.0:
0087 |             x = x / 255.0
0088 | 
0089 | 
0090 |         C, H, W = x.shape
0091 |         # ensure channel count
0092 |         if C == 1 and self.in_ch == 3:
0093 |             x = np.repeat(x, 3, axis=0)
0094 |         elif C != self.in_ch:
0095 |             if self.in_ch == 1:
0096 |                 x = x.mean(axis=0, keepdims=True)
0097 |             elif C == 3 and self.in_ch > 3:
0098 |                 x = np.concatenate([x, np.zeros((self.in_ch-3, H, W), dtype=np.float32)], axis=0)
0099 |             else:
0100 |                 x = np.repeat(x, self.in_ch // C + 1, axis=0)[:self.in_ch]
0101 | 
0102 |         reg, cls = self._load_label(p)
0103 |         # mask length N = (H/patch)*(W/patch)
0104 |         h, w = H // self.patch, W // self.patch
0105 |         N = h * w
0106 |         m = np.zeros((N,), dtype=bool)
0107 |         k = max(1, int(self.mask_ratio * N))
0108 |         # random masked indices
0109 |         idxs = np.random.choice(N, size=k, replace=False)
0110 |         m[idxs] = True
0111 | 
0112 |         return torch.from_numpy(x), torch.from_numpy(reg), torch.tensor(cls, dtype=torch.long), torch.from_numpy(m)
0113 | 
0114 | 
0115 | # ---------------- Trainer ----------------
0116 | class VPMViTTrainer(BaseAgent):
0117 |     """
0118 |     Trains VPM-ViT on VPM frames with multi-task loss:
0119 |       - Regression on 5 dims
0120 |       - Risk class (3-way)
0121 |       - MPM (masked token reconstruction)
0122 |     """
0123 |     def __init__(self, cfg: DictConfig, memory, container, logger):
0124 |         super().__init__(cfg, memory, container, logger)
0125 |         self.model_cfg = cfg.model
0126 |         self.opt_cfg = cfg.optimizer
0127 |         self.sched_cfg = cfg.scheduler
0128 |         self.train_cfg = cfg.training
0129 | 
0130 |         # Build model
0131 |         self.model: VPMViT = VPMViT(**self.model_cfg.params)
0132 |         self.device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
0133 |         self.model.to(self.device)
0134 | 
0135 |         # Optimizer
0136 |         opt_cls = self._resolve(self.opt_cfg["class"])
0137 |         self.optimizer = opt_cls(self.model.parameters(), **self.opt_cfg.params)
0138 | 
0139 |         # Scheduler
0140 |         sched_cls = self._resolve(self.sched_cfg["class"])
0141 |         self.scheduler = sched_cls(self.optimizer, **self.sched_cfg.params)
0142 | 
0143 |         # Losses
0144 |         self.reg_loss_fn = nn.SmoothL1Loss(beta=1.0)
0145 |         self.cls_loss_fn = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
0146 | 
0147 |         # Optional viz
0148 |         self.vpm_viz = _get_viz(container)
0149 | 
0150 |     def _resolve(self, dotted: str):
0151 |         mod, name = dotted.rsplit(".", 1)
0152 |         return getattr(importlib.import_module(mod), name)
0153 | 
0154 |     def _dataloader(self, data_dir: Path) -> DataLoader:
0155 |         ds = VPMFrameDataset(
0156 |             data_dir,
0157 |             in_ch=self.model_cfg.params.in_ch,
0158 |             patch=self.model_cfg.params.patch,
0159 |             mask_ratio=self.train_cfg.get("mask_ratio", 0.15),
0160 |         )
0161 |         return DataLoader(ds, batch_size=self.train_cfg.batch_size, shuffle=True, num_workers=self.train_cfg.get("num_workers", 0))
0162 | 
0163 |     def run(self, context: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
0164 |         data_dir = Path(context.get("data_dir", "data/vpm"))
0165 |         out_path = Path(context.get("model_save_path", "models/vpm_vit_final.pth"))
0166 |         out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0167 | 
0168 |         loader = self._dataloader(data_dir)
0169 |         scaler = torch.cuda.amp.GradScaler(enabled=True)
0170 | 
0171 |         self.model.train()
0172 |         for epoch in range(int(self.train_cfg.epochs)):
0173 |             ep_loss = 0.0
0174 |             reg_mae, cls_correct, cls_total = 0.0, 0, 0
0175 | 
0176 |             for vpm, reg_t, cls_t, mask in loader:
0177 |                 vpm = vpm.to(self.device).float()
0178 |                 reg_t = reg_t.to(self.device).float()
0179 |                 cls_t = cls_t.to(self.device).long()
0180 |                 mask = mask.to(self.device)
0181 | 
0182 |                 self.optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
0183 |                 with torch.cuda.amp.autocast(enabled=True):
0184 |                     out = self.model(vpm, mask=mask)
0185 |                     loss = 0.0
0186 |                     if "reg" in out:
0187 |                         loss_reg = self.reg_loss_fn(out["reg"], reg_t)
0188 |                         loss += self.train_cfg.loss_weights.reg * loss_reg
0189 |                         reg_mae += torch.abs(out["reg"] - reg_t).mean().item()
0190 |                     if "cls" in out:
0191 |                         loss_cls = self.cls_loss_fn(out["cls"], cls_t)
0192 |                         loss += self.train_cfg.loss_weights.cls * loss_cls
0193 |                         cls_pred = out["cls"].argmax(dim=-1)
0194 |                         cls_correct += (cls_pred == cls_t).sum().item()
0195 |                         cls_total += cls_t.numel()
0196 |                     if "mpm_rec" in out:
0197 |                         # target tokens: (B,N,D) -> masked -> (M,D)
0198 |                         with torch.no_grad():
0199 |                             target_tok = self.model.patch_embed(vpm)  # (B,N,D)
0200 |                             target_tok = target_tok[mask]
0201 |                         loss_mpm = self.reg_loss_fn(out["mpm_rec"], target_tok)
0202 |                         loss += self.train_cfg.loss_weights.mpm * loss_mpm
0203 | 
0204 |                 scaler.scale(loss).backward()
0205 |                 torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(self.model.parameters(), self.train_cfg.grad_clip)
0206 |                 scaler.step(self.optimizer)
0207 |                 scaler.update()
0208 | 
0209 |                 ep_loss += float(loss.item())
0210 | 
0211 |             self.scheduler.step()
0212 |             n_batches = len(loader)
0213 |             avg_loss = ep_loss / max(1, n_batches)
0214 |             avg_mae = reg_mae / max(1, n_batches)
0215 |             acc = (cls_correct / max(1, cls_total)) if cls_total else 0.0
0216 | 
0217 |             # Log
0218 |             self.logger.log("VPMViTTrainingEpoch", {
0219 |                 "epoch": epoch,
0220 |                 "avg_loss": avg_loss,
0221 |                 "reg_mae": avg_mae,
0222 |                 "cls_acc": acc,
0223 |                 "lr": float(self.scheduler.get_last_lr()[0]),
0224 |             })
0225 |             if self.vpm_viz:
0226 |                 self.vpm_viz.track_metrics("vpm-vit-training", {
0227 |                     "epoch": epoch, "loss": avg_loss, "reg_mae": avg_mae, "cls_acc": acc,
0228 |                     "lr": float(self.scheduler.get_last_lr()[0]),
0229 |                 })
0230 | 
0231 |         torch.save({
0232 |             "state_dict": self.model.state_dict(),
0233 |             "config": dict(self.model_cfg.params),
0234 |             "dims": context.get("dims", ["reasoning","knowledge","clarity","faithfulness","coverage"]),
0235 |             "risk_labels": context.get("risk_labels", ["OK","WATCH","RISK"]),
0236 |         }, out_path)
0237 | 
0238 |         return {"status": "completed", "final_model": str(out_path)}
```

```python
0001 | # stephanie/scoring/contrastive_dimensional_tuner.py
0002 | from __future__ import annotations
0003 | 
0004 | import numpy as np
0005 | from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
0006 | 
0007 | 
0008 | class ContrastiveDimensionalTuner:
0009 |     """
0010 |     Learns weights for each scoring dimension using contrastive learning.
0011 |     Given pairs of scored examples (A vs B) and a preference, it learns which dimensions matter most.
0012 |     """
0013 | 
0014 |     def __init__(self, dimensions, logger=None):
0015 |         """
0016 |         Args:
0017 |             dimensions (list of str): List of dimension names (e.g., ["correctness", "clarity"]).
0018 |             logger (optional): Optional logger to record training events.
0019 |         """
0020 |         self.dimensions = dimensions
0021 |         self.logger = logger
0022 |         self.X = []  # Feature differences (vector of deltas across dimensions)
0023 |         self.y = []  # Labels: 1 if A preferred over B, 0 otherwise
0024 |         self.model = None
0025 | 
0026 |     def add_training_pair(self, scores_a: dict, scores_b: dict, preferred: str):
0027 |         """
0028 |         Adds a training example.
0029 | 
0030 |         Args:
0031 |             scores_a (dict): Scores for option A, keyed by dimension.
0032 |             scores_b (dict): Scores for option B, keyed by dimension.
0033 |             preferred (str): "A" or "B", indicating which output was preferred.
0034 |         """
0035 |         delta = np.array([scores_a[dim] - scores_b[dim] for dim in self.dimensions])
0036 | 
0037 |         # If B is preferred, invert the delta
0038 |         if preferred.upper() == "B":
0039 |             delta = -delta
0040 |             label = 1  # B preferred (inverted delta)
0041 |         else:
0042 |             label = 1  # A preferred (original delta)
0043 | 
0044 |         self.X.append(delta)
0045 |         self.y.append(label)
0046 | 
0047 |         if self.logger:
0048 |             self.logger.log(
0049 |                 "ContrastiveTrainingPairAdded",
0050 |                 {"delta": delta.tolist(), "preferred": preferred},
0051 |             )
0052 | 
0053 |     def train(self):
0054 |         """
0055 |         Trains a logistic regression model using the current contrastive data.
0056 |         """
0057 |         if len(self.X) < 3:
0058 |             if self.logger:
0059 |                 self.logger.log(
0060 |                     "ContrastiveTrainingSkipped",
0061 |                     {"reason": "Not enough data", "num_examples": len(self.X)},
0062 |                 )
0063 |             return
0064 | 
0065 |         X_array = np.array(self.X)
0066 |         y_array = np.array(self.y)
0067 | 
0068 |         self.model = LogisticRegression()
0069 |         self.model.fit(X_array, y_array)
0070 | 
0071 |         if self.logger:
0072 |             self.logger.log(
0073 |                 "ContrastiveModelTrained", {"coefficients": self.get_weights()}
0074 |             )
0075 | 
0076 |     def get_weights(self) -> dict:
0077 |         """
0078 |         Returns the learned dimension weights (if trained).
0079 | 
0080 |         Returns:
0081 |             dict: Mapping from dimension to learned weight.
0082 |         """
0083 |         if self.model is None:
0084 |             return {dim: 1.0 for dim in self.dimensions}  # fallback: equal weights
0085 | 
0086 |         weights = self.model.coef_[0]
0087 |         return {dim: round(float(w), 4) for dim, w in zip(self.dimensions, weights)}
0088 | 
0089 |     def score(self, dimension_scores: dict) -> float:
0090 |         """
0091 |         Calculates a single weighted score from per-dimension scores.
0092 | 
0093 |         Args:
0094 |             dimension_scores (dict): Scores keyed by dimension.
0095 | 
0096 |         Returns:
0097 |             float: Weighted total score.
0098 |         """
0099 |         weights = self.get_weights()
0100 |         total = sum(
0101 |             dimension_scores[dim] * weights.get(dim, 1.0) for dim in self.dimensions
0102 |         )
0103 |         return round(total, 4)
```

```python
0001 | # stephanie/scoring/transforms/prompt_score_regressor.py
0002 | from __future__ import annotations
0003 | 
0004 | import os
0005 | 
0006 | import joblib
0007 | import numpy as np
0008 | from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge
0009 | from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
0010 | from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
0011 | 
0012 | 
0013 | class PromptScoreRegressor:
0014 |     def __init__(self, model_path="prompt_score_regressor.pkl"):
0015 |         self.model_path = model_path
0016 |         self.models = {}  # dimension -> trained model
0017 | 
0018 |     def train(self, embeddings, score_dicts):
0019 |         """
0020 |         embeddings: List[List[float]]
0021 |         score_dicts: List[Dict[str, float]] (one per embedding)
0022 |         """
0023 |         if not score_dicts:
0024 |             raise ValueError("No score dictionaries provided for training.")
0025 | 
0026 |         # Infer all dimensions from the first sample
0027 |         dimensions = list(score_dicts[0].keys())
0028 |         X = np.array(embeddings)
0029 | 
0030 |         for dim in dimensions:
0031 |             y = np.array([score[dim] for score in score_dicts])
0032 |             model = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), Ridge(alpha=1.0))
0033 |             self.models[dim] = model.fit(X, y)
0034 | 
0035 |         if self.model_path:
0036 |             joblib.dump(self.models, self.model_path)
0037 | 
0038 |     def load(self):
0039 |         if os.path.exists(self.model_path):
0040 |             self.models = joblib.load(self.model_path)
0041 |         else:
0042 |             raise FileNotFoundError(f"No model found at {self.model_path}")
0043 | 
0044 |     def predict(self, embedding):
0045 |         if not self.models:
0046 |             raise ValueError("Models not trained or loaded.")
0047 | 
0048 |         scores = {}
0049 |         for dim, model in self.models.items():
0050 |             scores[dim] = float(model.predict([embedding])[0])
0051 |         return scores
0052 | 
0053 |     def predict_batch(self, embeddings):
0054 |         """
0055 |         Returns: List[Dict[dimension -> score]]
0056 |         """
0057 |         if not self.models:
0058 |             raise ValueError("Models not trained or loaded.")
0059 | 
0060 |         results = []
0061 |         for emb in embeddings:
0062 |             results.append(self.predict(emb))
0063 |         return results
```

```python
0009 | class RewardRegistry:
0010 |     """
0011 |     Per-goal lightweight reward weight tuner (EMA). Keeps the "one reward"
0012 |     shape but lets weights drift by goal_id based on components of *validated*
0013 |     winners (k, c, g).
```
